jobs.title: Визуален Мърчандайзер Русе
jobs.description:
КАКВО ЩЕ ПРАВИШ

​

Като Визуален мърчандайзер ще се грижиш за създаването и поддържането на среда, която вдъхновява клиентите ни да откриват и развиват своя личен стил. Заедно с екипа на магазина ще работиш в посока осигуряване на най-вълнуващото преживяване за клиентите. Действайки в съответствие с нашите ценности, ще допринасяш както за своя успех, така и за този на компанията.

Ти ще:

• Следиш актуалните модни тенденции и техники за стилизиране, за да предвидиш нуждите на клиентите.
• Анализираш продажбите, идентифицираш възможности за подобрение, следиш за правилното презентиране на продуктите в магазина, заедно с мениджърския екип.
• Избираш нови таланти, провеждаш обучения и развиваш екипа, като същевременно насърчаваш приобщаваща култура, екипна работа, професионално развитие и иновативно мислене.
• Представяш себе си и компанията по позитивен начин по време на всяко взаимодействие с клиенти.
• Имаш възможност да вземеш участие в бъдещи проекти свързани с нашите магазини, подкрепяйки нашия Sales Market.
• Промотираш активно лоялната ни програма.

С КОГО ЩЕ РАБОТИШ

Магазините ни са сърцето на компанията – мястото, където клиентите се запознават с нашата марка от първа ръка. Като част от динамичния екип в магазина, всяка роля – от продавач-консултант и ръководител отдел до управител, визуален мърчандайзер и главен касиер – допринася за създаването на вдъхновяваща и приветстваща обстановка. Ще имаш възможност да си сътрудничиш с колеги от различни магазини, да обменяте опит и да постигате успехи заедно. Работейки с твоя екип, ще имаш ключова роля в това да помагаш на клиентите да се чувстват уверени и свободни да изразят себе си чрез най-новите модни тенденции и класически модели. Изграждайки значима връзка с клиентите в нашите магазини, ние създаваме достъпна и устойчива мода за всички.

КОЙ СИ ТИ

Ние търсим човек с…​

• ​Опит във визуалния мърчандайзинг в сферата на търговията.

• Познания за управление, анализ и действие, използвайки различни системи и отчети.

И човек, който е…​

• С проявен интерес към модните тенденции и динамиката на пазара.
• Мотивиран да създаде неповторимо клиентско преживяване, като с увереност препоръчва и продава нашите продукти.
• Комуникативен, креативен и любопитен.
• Уверен и вдъхновяващ лидер, който развива екипа си постигайки отлични резултати.
• Адаптивен, аналитичен и ориентиран към постигане на резултати.

КОИ СМЕ НИЕ

H&M Group е международна група от утвърдени модни марки и инициативи. Нашата цел е да докажем, че няма компромис между изключителния дизайн, достъпните цени и устойчивите решения. Стремим се да направим модата достъпна за всички, като поставяме клиентите в центъра на всяко наше решение.

Нашият екип се състои от хиляди отдадени и талантливи професионалисти, обединени от обща култура и ценности. Заедно използваме силата, различията и знанията си, за да изградим бъдещето на модната индустрия, като го направим по-приобщаващо и устойчиво.

​

ЗАЩО ЩЕ ОБИКНЕШ РАБОТАТА СИ ПРИ НАС ​​

В H&M Group се гордеем с това, че сме динамична и приветстваща компания. Предлагаме на нашите служители атрактивни придобивки и множество възможности за професионално развитие по целия свят.

• 25% служителска отстъпка за всички марки от H&M Group, както в магазините, така и онлайн (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories и ARKET);
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Научи повече за програмата ни тук;
• Ваучери за храна на стойност 78€;
• Осигуровки върху реално брутно възнаграждение;
• Допълнително здравно осигуряване;
• Възможност за издаване на Multisport карта на преференциална цена;
• Обучения и възможност за световно кариерно развитие в компанията;
• Програма “Препоръчай приятел” с включен бонус;
• Бонусна система, формираща се от определени условия;
• Платен отпуск при сключване на брак;
• H&M карта-подарък при раждане на бебе;
• Ваучер при навършване на 10 години в компанията;
• Възнаграждение при пенсиониране;

ПРИСЪЕДИНИ СЕ КЪМ НАС

Нашите ценности, приобщаваща и сплотена култура ни различават от всички останали. Но най-важни са хората, които ни правят това, което сме.

Това е постоянна позиция на пълен работен ден, намираща се в град Русе.

Очакваме твоята кандидатура като ни изпратиш актуално CV на английски език. Поради политиката за личните данни, приемаме кандидатури единствено през кариерната ни страница.

Направи следващата крачка в кариерното си развитие с нас. Пътешествието започва тук.

* Стремим се да имаме справедлив и прозрачен процес и затова любезно молим да не прилагаш мотивационно писмо към кандидатурата си, тъй като то често съдържа информация, която лесно би могла да бъде разбрана пристрастно.

jobs.title: Regional Director - South West (copy)
jobs.description:
Regional Director – South West
Location: South West UK (Exeter / Truro)
Type: Full-time. Office-based.

👋 I’m Oren, Co-founder of Zen Educate

We’re looking for a Regional Director to join our commercial leadership team as part of our next chapter of growth in the UK.

If you’re passionate about improving children’s lives, building teams, developing effective managers, and using technology to solve slow archaic inefficiencies, then keep reading.

Why we exist

Education is the cornerstone of a thriving society. Schools do their utmost to provide children with positive experiences, but having the right staff is essential to fulfilling that promise – that’s where we come in. Whether it’s a year 1 teacher to greet her “good morning” or a Teaching Assistant to support him in the break times, Zen helps schools find the right educators faster without breaking the bank.

Schools in the UK spend over £2bn a year on agency staff. Zen is an all-in-one digital platform that gives schools full control over how they find, vet, and manage temporary educators. School leaders can search, book, and manage staff in real time, while gaining full visibility and control over their spend and compliance.

To go with our technology, we practice a culture of “we care more”, so that ultimately, by improving staffing in schools, we’re delivering thousands of smiles to children’s faces every single day. What we need now is to reach the next level in school awareness and adoption. That’s where you come in.

What we are looking for

We’ve built strong foundations already:
We are one of the leading suppliers in our industry and one of the fastest growing companies in the UK
A high-performing team in place across the South West of England, craving leadership.
A differentiated product that makes a genuine impact on the lives of educators, pupils, and the education system

We’re now looking to level up even further. You’ll be excited about this role if you:
Set a high bar for your team and are skilled at coaching both managers and ICs to be the best version of themselves as possible.
Are a proven leader that is just as obsessed about building systems and leading teams as you are about hitting growth targets. 
Are as comfortable aligning strategy and process with central supporting functions as you are with rolling out initiatives in your region. 

Some traits that usually correlate with success in this role

You’re passionate about making real world impact on the education system
You think BIG, not only incrementally. In three years your region will be
unrecognisable from where it is now
You’re process-led and hyper-structured. You plan meticulously and build playbooks to
deliver commercial results, rather than relying on herculean individual efforts
You can align teams, not just ideas
You love finding simple answers to complex problems
You love looking around corners and out-maneuvering the competition

What your first 6-12 months might look like:

Take over a high performing team from a successful leader who is progressing within the company. 
Become an expert in our customers’ pain points, how we solve them and where our platform can add value. Use this to inform the standards you set for your managers and your team. 
Establish the biggest opportunity to increase growth in each of your teams and put in place the plan to pursue it. 
Develop playbooks and operating procedures that ensure both a great customer experience and operational efficiency. 

Who you’ll work with
We’re a 500+ (and growing!) team operating across the UK, US, and Canada. We’re well funded, growing fast, and have tremendous unit economics. Simply put, we’re doing really well by doing good. As such, we’re a passionate group of missionaries rather than mercenaries. We’re looking to find someone who shares our passion for the mission of making education better.


What you might like or dislike

Every place makes trade-offs based on what they value and where they are in their journey.
Here’s a list of things you might find useful in figuring out if this is the right role for you. If we end up chatting, feel free to dig deeper into any of them.

Slope and passion over Y Intercept. High-trajectory individuals with a passion for what they do very quickly lap those with a higher initial starting point in their domain but slower trajectory. That means Executives at Zen often end up spending more time up-front investing in the upskilling of colleagues from non-traditional backgrounds but it quickly pays dividends many times over.

Building the system rather than individual heroics: having great players on the pitch is critical. However, a great system trumps the best salesperson without one. We’ve got a product with genuine product market-fit that makes our customers lives better. We’re looking for someone who can level up the system in getting the word out across the South West. 

First principles reasoning rather than replicating other companies best practices: we believe every situation has nuance. Experience is an input in decision making, but not the only one. The leaders that do best are endlessly curious and deconstruct problems to first principles. They’re not just making decisions because they’ve seen them work at previous companies, they experiment a lot and double down only on the successful ones.


Interested? Let’s go!
If you’ve made it this far and you’re excited then hit apply. If the timing isn’t right or you’re not sure it’s a right fit, reach out anyway. We’re always open to talking to those who believe in our mission.
Let’s build something that actually matters!

jobs.title: Senior Procurement Specialist
jobs.location: Hybrid (Boston, MA); Hybrid (HQ - San Mateo, CA)
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

As B-Stock's first dedicated procurement hire, you will own how we buy: every software renewal, new tool request, and indirect services contract across the company. Your job is to make sure we pay the right price for the right scope, and that every dollar of vendor spend has a clear business case behind it. You'll lead renewal negotiations end to end, act as the commercial lead with vendors so our teams can keep strong day-to-day relationships with their vendors, and build the playbooks, approval workflows, and business-case frameworks that let teams buy quickly while staying within policy. You'll also apply AI to accelerate contract review, benchmarking, and spend analysis, building toward a more automated procurement function over time. This person would report to the VP of Strategy & Business Operations and partner closely with Finance, Engineering, Legal, Accounts Payable, and all business teams.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the renewal calendar for all SaaS and indirect vendors. Start every material renewal 90+ days out with a usage review, benchmark pricing, and a negotiation plan.

• Lead commercial negotiations: price, seat and tier right-sizing, multi-year terms, price-increase caps, payment terms, auto-renewal and termination rights. Be the firm voice with vendors so business owners don't have to be.

• Build and roll out a procurement playbook: intake process, approval matrix and signing authority, negotiation guides by vendor category, standard terms, and redline fallbacks, in partnership with Finance and Legal.

• Develop a business-case framework and templates (cost, usage, ROI, overlap with existing tools, exit path) that teams use before requesting new spend, and make sure approved cases get implemented and measured.

• Maintain a single source of truth for vendor spend, contracts, owners, and renewal dates. Report savings and cost avoidance to leadership using a consistent methodology.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS, JOB SKILLS, ABILITIES

• 5+ years in procurement, strategic sourcing, vendor management, or a finance/operations role where you personally negotiated software and services contracts

• Track record of measurable savings. You can point to specific renewals you negotiated down and explain how you did it.

• Strong commercial and analytical skills: you model total cost of ownership, read usage data, compare pricing structures, and build a business case in a spreadsheet

• Experience building processes from scratch: intake, approval workflows, playbooks, and templates that other teams actually adopt

• Hands-on experience applying AI tools within analytical or operating workflows to build automations or multi-step processes, and comfort quickly adopting new AI capabilities as they emerge

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience as a first or early procurement hire at a growth-stage or mid-size company

• Familiarity with GTM and marketing tech stacks (CRM, sales engagement, marketing automation, data enrichment)

• Experience with procurement or spend-management tools (e.g., Vendr, Zip, Coupa, Ramp, Tropic)

The pay rate for this role will range between $100,000 to $130,000, per annum. We consider many factors when determining salary offers, such as the applicant’s work experience, education and training, skills, market data, and internal equity.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS

• Competitive compensation packages, including bonus and options

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Paid Time Off, telecommuting, and matching 401(K)

• Support for continuing education

• Team offsites, social events, and extracurricular activities are a staple

• Snacks, drinks, and the occasional box of donuts

THE COMPANY

B-Stock is the world's largest B2B re-commerce platform, connecting sellers and buyers of returned, trade-in, and overstock inventory. Our customers range from today’s top brands and retailers that want best-in-class inventory resale management to tens of thousands of entrepreneurs looking to purchase valuable merchandise for their resale businesses.

While the amount of returned and overstock inventory continues to grow, there is also growing pressure on retailers and consumers to adopt a more circular economy and keep products in use as long as possible. Accordingly, the need for re-commerce solutions - to find products a second life - has never been greater! At B-Stock we’re proud to play a large part in powering resale, reuse, and the circular economy through our platform: annually we sell over 130 million items across all categories and conditions, equating to 400 million pounds of inventory.

We believe there is tremendous value in and demand for this inventory - no matter the category, condition, or location. With hundreds of thousands transactions completed annually, B-Stock gives buyers a simple and direct way to buy valuable products directly from retailers and offers sellers a technology-driven replacement for traditional resale methods, while boosting operational efficiency, recovery rates, and cycle time.

Led by eBay veterans and backed by top investors including Spectrum Equity, True Ventures, and Susquehanna Growth Equity, B-Stock shows no signs of slowing down. Our core values have shaped the company we are today and will continue to drive our success for many years to come.

For more information, visit bstock.com/careers/

OUR VALUES

Make Each Dollar Count
Whether it’s the recovery amount or a buyer’s budget, money matters to all of our clients. And because each dollar matters to them, it matters to us.

Take Our Work Seriously, Not Ourselves
Everything at B-Stock continues to grow - everything but our egos, that is. We’re not afraid to let loose and laugh (often at ourselves).

Do The Hard Things Today That Will Pay Off Tomorrow
We’re willing to sacrifice and endure, fail and adapt to reach our long-term goals.

Use Trust As The Best Measure Of Success
The trust we earn along the way is more valuable than money. Without trust from both our buyers and sellers, our business won’t succeed.

Find Strength In Numbers
Use our passion for data to provide value to our customers, improve ourselves, and develop new ways to delight our buyers and sellers.

jobs.description:
About the Team

The Decision Systems team helps DoorDash teams make faster, more rigorous, and more trustworthy decisions. We build the analytical systems, statistical methods, and product experiences that power experimentation, causal inference, rollout analysis, metric interpretation, and business impact measurement across DoorDash’s three-sided marketplace. Curie is DoorDash’s experiment analysis product within Decision Systems. It sits at the center of how teams move from hypothesis to analysis to confident action, helping decision makers understand experiments, rollouts, metric movements, and marketplace impact while preserving scientific rigor, velocity, trust, and interpretability. Our work spans experimentation platforms, causal inference, variance reduction, switchback experimentation, metric systems, and AI-assisted analysis workflows. We partner closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and operators across DoorDash to translate advanced methods into reliable, scalable systems that improve decision quality and product velocity. Some of the work done in the team was published in articles such as: Design-Aware Variance Reduction for Switchback Experiments: A Comparative Study, Power-Optimal Covariate Adjustment for Switchback Experiments, CUPED on Steroids: Multivariate Covariate Adjustment for Switchback Experiments.

About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Applied Scientist to provide scientific leadership for DoorDash’s Experimentation Platform. In this role, you will define and advance the statistical, causal inference, machine learning, and AI capabilities that power high-quality decision-making across DoorDash. You will work on challenging problems at the intersection of experimentation, marketplace dynamics, machine learning, and product engineering.

Your work will shape how DoorDash teams design experiments, analyze results, interpret noisy marketplace outcomes, and make faster, more trustworthy decisions. This is a high-leverage role for a scientist who enjoys both deep technical work and broad cross-functional influence—partnering with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and operators to translate cutting-edge methods into reliable platform capabilities used across the company.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will...

• Set the scientific direction for Curie and shape the Decision Systems roadmap with engineering and product partners, identifying where better science, tooling, or automation can materially improve decision quality and velocity.

• Own the statistical contract for experiment analysis, including how metrics, populations, exposure windows, covariates, ratio metrics, and edge cases are defined.

• Ensure production systems faithfully implement those contracts by reviewing analytical SQL, validating statistical parity, and raising the bar for correctness across engine migrations.

• Develop and productionize advanced methods such as CUPED/CUPAC, ratio-metric and delta-method inference, sequential testing, heterogeneous treatment effects, switchback designs, and difference-in-differences for marketplace interference.

• Build approaches that hold up in high-scale, high-noise, three-sided marketplace data, including power analysis, multiple-testing correction, winsorization, quantile metrics, and other robust measurement techniques.

• Advance AI-assisted analysis workflows, including trustworthy automated experiment readouts, risk detection, and hypothesis generation, with the same rigor expected of statistical methods.

• Advise and mentor data scientists, product teams, operators, and engineers on experimental design, metric strategy, causal analysis, and interpretation of results.

We're excited about you because you have…

• 6+ years of industry experience, or equivalent applied research experience, developing statistical, causal inference, machine learning, or experimentation systems with measurable business impact.

• Deep expertise in experimentation and causal inference, with production experience in methods such as variance reduction, ratio metrics, sequential testing, heterogeneous treatment effects, marketplace interference, or quasi-experimental designs.

• Strong coding and data skills, including the ability to reason about production data pipelines and review complex analytical SQL for statistical correctness.

• Experience translating statistical or machine learning methods into reliable, scalable platform capabilities in close partnership with engineering and product teams.

• A track record of setting technical direction, influencing cross-functional teams, and mentoring senior technical contributors without relying solely on formal authority.

• The ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to scientific, engineering, product, and executive audiences.

• A bias for impact: you know how to balance methodological rigor, product velocity, engineering constraints, and customer needs.

We expect this position to be filled by 10-17-2026

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. jobs.title: Brand Communications Manager

jobs.description:
Be the voice of one of the best-known brands in marketing.

Ahrefs helps marketers get their brands found online, in search, in AI answers and on social. Our tools run on the largest search and AI datasets on the web. We’ve been bootstrapped and profitable for fifteen years, with no investors and no board, and we have offices in Singapore, Tokyo, Palo Alto and Cambridge (MA).

The product has a big reputation, and we want every word around it to live up to that. Up to now, copy at Ahrefs has been something talented people do alongside their main job. We want someone for whom it is the main job.

The job

You’ll be the voice of Ahrefs. You’ll decide how we sound and what we say about ourselves, write much of it yourself, and get every team using it. The homepage, a banner ad, a renewal email and a booth wall should all sound like the same company. When someone here wants to know how to say something better, they’ll come to you.

What you’ll do

• The website. Homepage, tool pages, comparison pages, ad landing pages, and the scripts for the explainer videos on them.

• Campaigns. Concepts, headlines, banners and video scripts for our advertising.

• Customer messages. Product emails and in-app notifications, the kind people read rather than archive.

• Print and events. Brochures, flyers, and the copy on our booth walls.

• The stage. Shape the message in our team’s conference talks, including keynotes at Ahrefs Evolve.

• Social. Work with our social media lead so a post and a landing page sound like they came from the same place.

• Positioning and messaging. Decide the core story for the company and each product, write it down, and get other teams to adopt it.

You’re probably right for this if

• Writing copy is what you do best, and most of your career has gone into it: campaigns, websites, product emails, scripts.

• You’re hands-on. You’d rather write it yourself than brief someone else to. You can turn a banner headline around the same day you’re halfway through a homepage rewrite, and you like having both on the go.

• You can show us your work. Real, published copy, and you can tell us exactly which parts you wrote.

• You know when to be funny and when to get straight to the point.

• You pick up technical products quickly, and can explain them to experts without dumbing them down. You don’t need to know SEO.

• You’ve owned a brand voice or positioning before, and got teams who didn’t report to you to use it.

• You’ll argue for a word with a CMO, and let go of the ones that don’t matter.

Good to have

• UX writing or product marketing experience.

• Video scripts and speechwriting.

• Comfortable enough in Figma or a CMS to fix your own copy in place.

Why Ahrefs?

We believe in giving smart people real ownership and not micromanaging them. You’ll own how Ahrefs sounds, everywhere, and shape how millions of marketers see the brand. We value honesty, results and simple solutions over complicated ones, and you’ll work with a smart, low-ego team where your words make a real difference.

Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third-party recruitment providers for the roles we hire for. If we need help, we’ll let you know.

Location: Singapore, Tokyo, Palo Alto (CA) or Cambridge (MA). On-site; you’ll need the right to work in the office you choose.

Ahrefs does not engage with agencies or third party recruitment solutions for the roles we hire for. If at any point we need help, we'll let you know!

jobs.title: Associate, Strategy & Operations, Merchant Onboarding & Experience
jobs.description:
About the Team

The New Vertical Onboarding Strategy & Operations team drives a fast, seamless onboarding experience for merchants across the SMB segments. We collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to enhance visibility, streamline workflows, and reduce onboarding friction through scalable process and product improvements. Our mission is to ensure every merchant launches smoothly and efficiently, powered by data-driven insights and strong operational alignment.

About the Role

The SMB Onboarding Strategy & Operations (S&O) role focuses on improving the end-to-end onboarding experience for small and medium-sized merchants by identifying process inefficiencies, building visibility tools, and driving scalable solutions across cross-functional teams. This role acts as the single-threaded owner for SMB onboarding, ensuring merchants are launched quickly, accurately, and with minimal friction through data-driven insights, process automation, and clear ownership alignment.

Key Responsibilities

• Process Visibility & SLA Tracking: Build dashboards to monitor true onboarding timelines, identify delays, and surface insights to inform process and tooling improvements.

• Root Causing Blocked Cases: Develop a shared tracker for blocked cases, analyze trends, and work with cross-functional partners to resolve issues and implement sustainable fixes.

• Integrations Enablement: Design and refine onboarding workflows for new integration types (e.g., Shopify), and establish scalable processes as SMB Retail expands in 2026.

• Product & Tooling Guidance: Translate workflow gaps into actionable product requirements for systems like SFDC, and advocate for automation that reduces manual work.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with MXO, GTMT, IA, Sales, and Product to ensure end-to-end alignment on onboarding priorities and execution.

• Data & Insights: Create and maintain onboarding performance dashboards to measure success and track progress toward SLAs and OKRs.

You will report into the Manager of the Onboarding S&O pod on our Merchant Onboarding & Experience S&O team in our New Verticals Business Development organization.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Drive meaningful impact by transforming how SMB merchants onboard — reducing friction, accelerating launch timelines, and improving the overall merchant experience.

• Shape strategy and process from the ground up, building visibility tools, performance metrics, and scalable workflows that become the foundation for SMB onboarding excellence.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Ops, and GTMT to design solutions that balance speed, quality, and automation across the onboarding journey.

• Own high-visibility problem areas, using data to identify blockers and lead systemic, cross-team improvements that directly impact business growth.

• Be at the forefront of innovation, helping define the future of merchant onboarding as new integrations, verticals, and tooling capabilities are unlocked in 2026 and beyond

We’re excited about you because…

• You have 2+ years of experience in a fast-paced environment, where you’ve built and optimized processes from the ground up.

• You’re proficient in SQL and comfortable using data to uncover insights, measure impact, and inform operational or strategic decisions.

• You thrive in dynamic, fast-moving environments, adapting quickly while maintaining a high bar for execution and detail.

• You’re a strong cross-functional collaborator.

• You’re known for your ability to “herd cats” — driving accountability, clarifying ownership, and keeping complex projects on track amid competing priorities.

• You possess a strategic and analytical mindset, able to diagnose root causes and translate findings into actionable, scalable solutions.

• You have exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, capable of influencing without authority across seniority levels and functions.

• You’re systems- and process-oriented, with a knack for identifying inefficiencies and translating workflow pain points into clear product or tooling requirements.

• You’re impact-driven, motivated by improving merchant experiences and accelerating business outcomes through operational excellence.

• You’re energized by ambiguity, eager to define structure, build visibility, and create sustainable frameworks that set the foundation for long-term success.

We expect this position to be filled by 10-17-2026

Compensation

Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be decided based on factors including, but not limited to, skills, prior relevant experience, and specific work location. Base salary is localized according to employee work location.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

See below for paid time off details:

• For hourly roles: vacation accrued at about 1 hour for every 25.97 hours worked (e.g. about 6.7 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 3.4 hours/month if working 20 hours/week), and paid sick time accrued at 1 hour for every 30 hours worked (e.g. about 5.8 hours/month if working 40 hours/week; about 2.9 hours/month if working 20 hours/week).

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees’ happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more.

jobs.title: Senior Content Designer
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

As a Senior Content Designer, you’ll be a key member of the Accounts design team, playing a critical role in building the systems that keep Roblox safe, civil, and inclusive for a global community. You’ll focus on creating platform-level designs that make all accounts on Roblox accessible, authentic, and protected.

Roblox’s mission is to connect a billion people with optimism and civility. The Safety organization is at the heart of that mission, working to ensure everyone has seamless and secure access to accounts tied to their identity. We also work on building a world-class account access and management system, ensuring safe and fun family experiences, supporting compliance with global regulations, and providing a healthy, inclusive environment for users of all ages.

You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across product, design, engineering, and research, shaping the platform's approach to trust and safety through thoughtful design. This is an opportunity to work at the systems level—defining how safety and account are embedded across Roblox and designing reusable frameworks that power our vision of civil immersive online communities.

You will:

• Own and deliver UX content strategy and execution for key Accounts surfaces and flows, including identity, account access and recovery, and family experiences, from early exploration through launch

• Develop a deep understanding of user needs, behaviors, and motivations, including young users, teens, adults, parents, and creators, to inform content design decisions across safety and account experiences

• Define the content strategy and roadmap for Accounts, identifying where content can improve safety, trust, and account outcomes and driving that work forward

• Lead collaboration with product managers, designers, researchers, engineers, and policy partners to ensure experiences are valuable, understandable, and easy to use

• Apply UX writing and content strategy to high-stakes moments, balancing legal and regulatory requirements with clarity and usability across player, parent, and creator experiences

• Define and maintain content guidelines, patterns, and frameworks for safety and account experiences that support consistency in voice and tone, partnering with the Foundation Design Systems team to make them reusable

• Communicate and document content decisions clearly, using empathy, logic, research insights, and data to inform recommendations

• Advocate for high-quality content design and influence product direction across Accounts, mentoring peers and partners on content best practices

• Shape team processes and ways of working, helping define how content design operates across groups

• Identify and implement AI solutions to improve content quality and scale

You have:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Content Design, UX Writing, Communications, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field

• Extensive experience (5+ years) in content design, with a strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in designing for trust and safety, identity, accounts, or other high-stakes consumer experiences

• Strong systems thinking and a track record of designing scalable content patterns and frameworks for comprehensive, connected user experiences

• Deep understanding of user-centered design principles, information architecture, and content strategy for complex workflows such as identity verification, authentication, and account recovery

• A track record of collaborating with and influencing cross-functional partners, including product managers, designers, researchers, engineers, and policy teams, and shifting product decisions through content

• A strong drive to deeply understand product goals from both a business and user perspective, fostering a culture of learning and iteration

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate content design concepts and rationale clearly and persuasively

• A collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across teams and influence design direction

• A strong interest in online safety, the gaming industry, and user-generated content platforms

• Keen interest in user experience trends, privacy, and emerging technologies

jobs.title: Health Coach
jobs.description:
About Us:

Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.

Who We Are

Future pairs each member with an expert coach who gets to know them, their goals, and their data, then builds a healthier life around all of it. We started in fitness, and we're now going further: a coaching-led health experience that brings together movement, nutrition, sleep and recovery, and leverages real clinical data to build precise, custom member protocols.  Our offering is continuing to evolve and we're looking for coaches who want to help shape it.

About the Role

Role Type: 1099 (independent contractor) Full-time

As a Health Coach, you'll own a caseload of members and guide each of them from their first day through their progress milestones. This is a partner role, not a prescriber role: you draw out what a member actually wants, meet them where they are, and help them build habits that last across nutrition, movement, sleep, and stress. You'll coach through a mix of virtual face-to-face sessions and day-to-day messaging, and you'll use each member's data to make your guidance specific and personal.  The members we serve expect high-touch, polished care, with the coach at the center of their experience.

What you'll do

• Own your members' experience end to end. Guide a caseload of members from onboarding through their 90-day milestone and beyond, and keep every one of them feeling individually known.

• Coach live and asynchronously. Run virtual kickoff and check-in sessions, and support members between sessions over messaging that stays warm, timely, and clear.

• Build personalized, data-informed plans. With the support of AI tooling, translate each member's goals and data into a plan across fitness, nutrition, sleep, and recovery, and adjust it as their life and results change.

• Coach the person, not just the plan. Use motivational interviewing and reflective listening to help members find their own reasons for change and choose their own next step, rather than handing them a prescription.

• Make the data useful. Under the guidance of Future’s Clinical Team, contextualize body composition scans, bloodwork and GLP-1 considerations within your scope, and turn them into everyday actions a member can take.

• Make progress visible. Track progress against goals your members helped set, and celebrate the behavior and consistency wins, not just the number on a scan.

• Help build. Bring what you learn from members back to the team, and help us shape a program that's ever growing and evolving.

Who you are

• Empathetic. You lead with care and meet people where they are, whether it's a member having a hard week or a teammate under pressure.

• Independent, and collaborative. You can run your caseload at a high level without hand-holding, and you still genuinely enjoy working alongside your teammates.

• An active part of the community. Even though we're a virtual company, you show up: you join calls, contribute to projects, and share honest feedback that makes the team better.

• Proactive. You chase down answers, follow up, and take initiative instead of waiting to be told.

• Tech-savvy. You pick up new tools quickly and are comfortable working across apps, data, and platforms all day.

What you'll need

Required (non-negotiable)

• NBC-HWC (National Board Certified Health & Wellness Coach) — full board certification through the National Board for Health & Wellness Coaching is required. This is our core standard for behavior-change theory, motivational interviewing, reflective listening, and coaching scope of practice.

• An associate's degree or higher (or an equivalent, experience-based path to your coaching certification).

• 2+ years of client-facing coaching or training experience. Enough that you can run a member session on day one, without a ramp.

• Proven high-volume caseload management. You've personally carried a large book of clients at once and kept each of them feeling individually known.

• Comfort working with a diverse member population. You adapt your style to meet members of different ages, backgrounds, cultures, abilities, and health starting points, and every one of them feels respected and understood.

• Strong written communication. Much of your coaching happens over messaging, so you're warm, clear, and personable on the page while staying professional.

• Strong verbal communication and presence. You also coach face-to-face over video, and you bring confidence, thoughtfulness and professionalism into every session.

• Comfortable synthesizing health data. You keep up with current health trends and have a track record of coaching clients across nutrition apps and wearable devices, bringing their data together into a single comprehensive plan.

Strong plus (not required)

• Additional coaching credentials layered on top of NBC-HWC, such as ACE Health Coach, Precision Nutrition L1, or NASM Behavior Change Specialist.

• A personal-training or strength credential (CSCS; NASM, ACE, or ACSM CPT; or similar).

• A nutrition-coaching certification such as Precision Nutrition.

• An advanced degree in exercise science, physiology, kinesiology, or a related field.

• Clinical collaboration in functional or integrative medicine. You've worked alongside or under registered dietitians, nurse practitioners, or physicians.

• Experience with luxury clientele. You've served high-end members in concierge medicine, a premium gym, or a private club, and you carry that polish into every interaction.

• A distinct coaching specialty such as performance, postpartum, pelvic-floor, or eating-disorder-informed coaching, that adds range to our team.

• Startup experience, or time spent in a fast-changing, still-being-built environment.

What we offer

Engagement Type

• This is an 1099 independent contractor engagement, not employment. Contractors are engaged through a written services agreement, are responsible for their own taxes, and are not eligible for Future employee benefits.

• Remote (residence in approved state) We are currently ONLY hiring in AZ, FL, GA, NC, OH, SC, TN, TX, UT.

Compensation

• The compensation range for this engagement is $30–$40 per hour, based on experience and credentials.

Future is an equal opportunity organization. We consider qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with applicable law, including the California Fair Chance Act.

Life at Future

Equity: Meaningful equity package.
Health Coverage: All employees who meet eligibility requirements receive comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance, plus tax-advantaged savings accounts.
Retirement: 401(k) plan.
Wellness: Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, recovery, and overall wellbeing, plus access to mental health resources and therapy support.
Flexible Time Off: Flexible PTO so you can rest, recharge, and take care of life outside of work.
Learning & Development: Annual budget for courses, conferences, coaching, and tools that help you grow in your craft.
Future Membership: Enjoy our platform for free.

Equal Employment Opportunities at Future

We are committed to building a future where every member of our community, is healthy, cared for, and advancing forward together. Future is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, age, civil or family status, disability or race.

Building Mercury's customer base has turned out to be a wild endeavor! With our continued growth in lending, we're looking for a seasoned credit and capital sales professional to continue to grow our capital products. This role focuses on selling to established, high-value mid-market brands generating millions in annual sales revenue. You'll bring the skills of a proven lending closer, someone who's structured and closed credit deals, while still thriving in the fast-moving, resourceful environment Mercury is known for.

You'll partner with founders and finance teams to understand their cash flow and capital needs on a deep level, and translate that understanding into credit-sound offers alongside underwriting. This role focuses on building your own pipeline of exceptional companies, starting with high-quality ecommerce brands, and expanding over time to other industries doing $20M-$500M in annual revenue. You'll own complex deal cycles that require both a strong banking relationship and real internal selling across underwriting and the executive team.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

This might be the right role for you if:

• You've sold credit and lending products before, either at a fintech lender or bank.

• You don't wait for a pipeline to show up — you go find it, through outbound, networking, and relationship-building.

• You've managed a deal cycle that took months, involved a term sheet, and required you to keep multiple internal and external stakeholders aligned at once.

• When underwriting says no to a deal you like, you understand why, and you know how to bring back a structure that works for everyone.

You will:

• Own the full sales cycle from self-sourced pipeline to close, selling Mercury's working capital products (term loans and rolling lines) to high-growth brands generating $20M-$500M in annual revenue.

• Identify and pursue opportunities to expand relationships into other Mercury products (banking*, credit card, treasury) as the account grows.

You have:

• 3+ years of quota-carrying, closing experience selling credit, lending, or capital products — at a fintech lender, a bank's business/commercial lending group, or a similar working-capital provider.

• A track record of closing deals with businesses doing meaningful revenue (think $20M+, ideally into the tens or hundreds of millions), in ecommerce or adjacent industries.

• Real comfort with credit fundamentals — you can speak fluently about cash flow, underwriting considerations, and deal structuring, not just product features.

• Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that require internal alignment (underwriting, credit committee, leadership) as much as external persuasion.

• A demonstrated ability to self-source pipeline through outbound, networking, and relationship-building — not just work inbound leads.

• Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales methodology, preferred but not required.

jobs.title: IT Systems Administrator
jobs.description:
The Company

Medely is a high-growth series-C technology start-up reimagining the future of healthcare work by providing an on-demand marketplace and workforce management tools. With the support of top-tier investors, Medely has quickly become a go-to platform for healthcare professionals to instantly access high-paying jobs with the freedom and flexibility to work when and where they want. 



As a fully remote team of sharp, collaborative, and entrepreneurial individuals, we are dedicated to redefining the way healthcare workers and facilities work together to provide for patients. We are looking for passionate and skilled professionals to join our team and help us take on tough challenges in this fast-expanding healthcare industry segment.  



Join us in our mission to transform the healthcare staffing industry and improve patient lives!



The Role

Medely's IT team is small, high-leverage, and remote-first. We support a distributed workforce on a modern SaaS stack including, but not limited to, Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom and Zoom Phone, Notion, our ticketing platform (Medely Help), Iru MDM, Rippling, Ashby, Torii, and dozens of business apps. Day-to-day support volume is modest and well-documented; most of this role's time goes to building, securing, and automating the systems underneath.



This role is a hybrid: part hands-on IT generalist (the occasional password/MFA reset, break/fix, or machine swap, plus the employee lifecycle), part IT Systems Administrator (owner of identity, device, and SaaS architecture), and part automation architect (the person who turns repeated work into workflows, APIs, and safe AI-assisted processes), all with a security-first mindset.



You'll be the engineer who makes access control automatic, auditable, and least-privilege by default, and who makes IT's operational data clean enough to measure, report on, and automate against.




WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

 - Support is manageable, but it can be smarter. Truly hands-on IT work (a password reset here, a laptop replacement there) is light. The bigger opportunity is the repeatable stuff, like app access requests, which should be self-service, policy-driven, or fully automated.

 - SaaS sprawl and shadow IT are real. Teams adopt tools quickly. We use Torii to discover and govern them, and we need someone to turn those findings into ownership, Okta-backed access, and renewal decisions.

 - Access control still has manual seams. Some apps are provisioned from Rippling instead of Okta, some support SCIM but aren't configured, shared service accounts need governance, and RBAC for Sales/RevOps and other departments needs to be operationalized end to end.

 - The lifecycle has timing and trigger gaps. Rippling → Okta activation timing, Ashby/Rippling → ticketing platform onboarding triggers, and offboarding audit trails all need durable, engineered workflows.

 - Device trust is maturing. Okta Device Trust with Iru on macOS and Windows is live and expanding; we've seen why enrollment controls (not just access controls) matter.

 - AI adoption is accelerating. Claude, Notion AI and agents, and n8n are in use. We need someone who can enable them quickly and safely, with scoped access, data-sensitivity controls, and governance.

 - We have the platforms to automate. n8n (self-hosted), Okta Workflows, ticketing platform workflows/webhooks/API, and Notion databases are in place. We need someone who lives in them.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:


1) IDENTITY & ACCESS MANAGEMENT (OKTA-FIRST)

 - Own Okta as the control plane: SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group rules, profile/attribute mapping, authentication policies, MFA/FastPass, and admin role scoping

 - Drive Okta to be the single source of provisioning for every eligible app; migrate remaining Rippling-provisioned apps and configure SCIM where supported but unused

 - Design and maintain RBAC by department, role, and seniority; publish and maintain access control matrices

 - Build birthright access, time-bound access (e.g., international travel), and automatic revocation

 - Govern service and shared accounts: inventory, ownership, conversion to named accounts, credential rotation

 - Run recurring access reviews and produce audit-ready evidence for SOC 2 and security reviews

 - Partner with Security on zero-trust posture, device admission, geofencing, and Okta system log monitoring


2) AUTOMATION, WORKFLOWS & INTEGRATIONS

 - Design, build, and maintain automations in n8n, Okta Workflows, and our ticketing platform, connecting Okta, Rippling, Ashby, the ticketing platform, Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, and business apps

 - Use REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth/API tokens, and JSON payloads confidently; read vendor API docs and build reliable integrations with error handling, retries, logging, and alerting

 - Automate the employee lifecycle end to end: pre-hire prep, staged Okta creation and timed activation, Day-1 access, role/department changes, and offboarding with access revocation and audit trail

 - Partner closely with HR / People Ops on lifecycle management: agree on HRIS data standards and trigger timing, coordinate start dates, role changes, leaves, and terminations (including sensitive or same-day exits), and handle HR data with discretion

 - Turn access requests into self-service catalog items with approval routing by app sensitivity (Slack approve/deny, owner approvals, automatic provisioning on approval)

 - Treat automations as production systems: version control or exportable definitions, documentation, runbooks, credential hygiene, least-privilege service accounts, and ownership


3) DEVICE MANAGEMENT (MACOS & WINDOWS)

Our fleet is roughly 85% macOS and 15% Windows. Mac is the default, but Windows users get the same level of support, security, and polish.

 - Own MDM across macOS and Windows (Iru; experience with Kandji, Jamf, and/or Intune expected): enrollment (ABM/ADE, Autopilot), blueprints/profiles, compliance baselines, patching, app deployment, and FileVault/BitLocker

 - Maintain and extend Okta Device Trust (device identity certificates, managed-device attestation, desktop and mobile auth policy rules)

 - Harden enrollment controls so factors and devices can only be enrolled from managed, compliant hardware

 - Own hardware lifecycle tooling and data: assignment, shipping, recovery, resale/disposal, and reconciliation with Finance


4) IT OPERATIONS & SERVICE EXCELLENCE

 - Serve as frontline support for Medely Help (our ticketing platform): identity, device, SaaS, and cross-system issues

 - Handle the occasional hands-on fix with care: password/MFA resets with proper identity verification, break/fix troubleshooting, and remote machine replacement (ship, wipe, re-enroll, recover)

 - Own ticketing platform configuration: request catalog, forms, routing, categories, SLAs, inbox boundaries (privacy-aware for HR/sensitive queues), and AI triage behavior

 - Maintain a strong Helpdesk Knowledge Base and IT internal runbooks in Notion

 - Help build sustainable IT operating rhythms: roadmap hygiene, weekly status, ownership on every card, and visible deadlines


5) ZOOM & ZOOM PHONE ADMINISTRATION

 - Own Zoom Workplace administration: Okta SSO and SCIM provisioning, license types and assignment, roles, groups, account- and group-level settings and locks, and add-on management

 - Manage meeting and recording policy: cloud recording settings, retention, sharing defaults, and access controls aligned with Security and Legal

 - Govern Zoom AI Companion and other AI features: who has them, what's enabled, and how summaries and recordings are stored and shared

 - Administer Zoom Phone end to end: number inventory and assignment, porting, call queues, auto receptionists/IVR, business hours and holiday routing, voicemail, and call handling for operational teams

 - Own Zoom Phone compliance and reliability: emergency (E911) addresses, call recording policies and notices, SMS/10DLC registration, and call quality troubleshooting

 - Build Zoom and Zoom Phone into the employee lifecycle: automatic license and number assignment on hire, call queue and routing updates on role changes, and number reclamation, recording handoff, and license recovery on offboarding

 - Track Zoom usage and licenses to right-size seats and Zoom Phone plans at renewal


6) SAFE AI ENABLEMENT

 - Enable AI tools (Claude, Notion AI/agents, and new entrants) through Okta SSO/SCIM, group-based entitlements, usage controls, and approval workflows

 - Build AI-assisted IT workflows (ticket triage, KB drafting, access request intake, reporting) with human-in-the-loop checkpoints where risk warrants

 - Design, build, and maintain governed AI integrations using LLM APIs (Anthropic/OpenAI), MCP connectors, and AI agents (including Notion agents and n8n AI nodes), with scoped credentials, data boundaries, logging, and clear ownership

 - Put safeguards in place for every employee using AI tools: approved-tool list, data classification guidance (what never goes into a prompt: PII, PHI, credentials, customer data), connector and integration scoping, admin settings like data retention and training opt-outs, and audit logging

 - Make safe use the easy path: short, practical guidance and training in Notion, a clear request path for new AI tools, and fast reviews so people don't route around IT

 - Partner with Security and Legal on AI acceptable-use policy, vendor reviews, and periodic checks of how AI tools are actually being used


7) SAAS GOVERNANCE & SHADOW IT (TORII)

 - Own Torii as the system for SaaS discovery: find unsanctioned apps, OAuth grants, and browser-extension sign-ups, and triage them (approve and bring under Okta, replace with a sanctioned tool, or shut down)

 - Assign a business owner to every app and keep the SaaS inventory current

 - Use Torii usage for automated license reclamation and consolidation

 - Build automations off Torii signals (new app detected, unused licenses, upcoming renewals) into the ticketing platform, Slack, and Notion


8) SECURITY OPERATIONS MINDSET

 - Apply least privilege and zero-trust principles to every system you touch, including your own admin access and automation service accounts

 - Monitor Okta System Log and admin activity; investigate suspicious sign-ins, unexpected factor enrollments, and policy failures with Security

 - Keep secrets out of tickets, Slack, and workflows; use 1Password and scoped API tokens, and rotate credentials

 - Administer 1Password: Okta-integrated provisioning, vaults and shared-vault structure by team, groups and permissions, policies, recovery and reporting

 - Support incident response: document, contain, and run post-incident follow-ups that close the underlying control gap

 - Help with security awareness for employees (phishing, MFA hygiene, device hygiene) and support Security on SOC 2 controls and evidence


9) SYSTEMS & DATA ARCHITECTURE

 - Design clean, relational IT data in Notion (and connected sources): SaaS inventory and status, app ownership, access matrices, asset inventory, roadmap, and ticket insights

 - Define sources of truth and sync patterns between HRIS (Rippling), identity (Okta), ticketing platform, and Notion so reporting is accurate and automatable

 - Build dashboards and metrics: ticket volume and categories, time to resolve, provisioning coverage, SCIM coverage, device compliance, license utilization, and SaaS spend

 - Support SaaS audits, renewals, and license reclamation with real usage data


10) NOTION PLATFORM OWNERSHIP

 - Administer Notion as a core company platform: teamspaces, permissions and sharing patterns, SCIM/SSO, databases, forms, automations, and AI agents

 - Help departments build in Notion without oversharing or shadow IT; set standards and templates


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 90 days

 - Fully onboarded on Okta, Iru, the ticketing platform, n8n, and Notion admin; owns a defined set of IT Roadmap workstreams with weekly deadlines met

 - Delivers a provisioning gap report: every app's SSO / SCIM / provisioning source / shared-account status, with a remediation plan

 - Ships at least 2–3 production automations that measurably remove manual ticket work (e.g., top app access requests)

 - Completes a Torii shadow-IT review: every discovered app is triaged, has an owner, and is either sanctioned under Okta or retired

 - Audits Zoom and Zoom Phone: license and number inventory, call queue and routing map, E911 addresses, and recording settings, with fixes for any gaps

6 months

 - Okta is the provisioning source for all eligible apps; Rippling-provisioned gaps closed

 - Access requests for top apps are self-service with policy-based approvals and auto-provisioning

 - Onboarding/offboarding is triggered, timed, and audited end to end

 - Ticket deflection and time-to-resolve trend in the right direction, with a monthly ticket insights report

12 months

 - Quarterly access reviews are automated and audit-ready

 - Device compliance and device trust coverage near 100% across macOS and Windows

 - IT operational data (SaaS, access, assets, tickets) is trusted and powers dashboards and AI-assisted workflows


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 4+ years in IT operations / systems administration / IT engineering in a SaaS-first, remote company

 - Deep, hands-on Okta administration: SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM, group rules, attribute mapping, authentication policies, Device Trust, and Okta Workflows

 - Hands-on MDM for both macOS and Windows (Iru/Kandji, Jamf, and/or Intune), including ABM/ADE, Autopilot, compliance policies, and app deployment

 - Genuinely comfortable supporting both macOS and Windows. Our environment is about 85/15 Mac to Windows, so you need to be just as effective troubleshooting, hardening, and deploying on Windows as on Mac

 - Microsoft 365 / Office 365 experience: licensing and app deployment (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), Entra ID basics, coexistence with Google Workspace, and supporting Office apps on both macOS and Windows

 - Proven experience building automations and integrations with n8n (strongly preferred), Okta Workflows, Zapier/Make, or Workato — using REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON

 - Core competency: building with AI in a governed way. Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Anthropic/OpenAI), MCP connectors, and AI agents. You scope access to least privilege, protect sensitive data, keep a human in the loop where risk warrants, log what the AI does, and document how it works

 - Strong understanding of least privilege, RBAC, joiner/mover/leaver processes, and SOC 2–aligned IT controls

 - Proven partnership with HR / People Ops on employee lifecycle management: onboarding, transfers, leaves, and offboarding, built on clear handoffs, shared data standards, and confidentiality

 - Hands-on 1Password admin experience (Business or Enterprise): provisioning, vault design, permissions, policies, account recovery, and shared-credential governance

 - A security-minded approach: comfortable reading auth logs, spotting risky configurations, and pushing back when convenience would weaken a control

 - Experience with SaaS management / shadow IT discovery (Torii, Productiv, Zluri, or similar)

 - Google Workspace administration (groups, shared drives, security settings, data transfer)

 - Hands-on Zoom and Zoom Phone administration: licensing, SSO/SCIM, meeting and recording policies, number management and porting, call queues, auto receptionists, routing, and E911

 - Advanced experience administering ticketing platforms (Jira Service Management, Freshservice, Zendesk, Intercom, or similar): building and maintaining workflows, routing and assignment rules, request forms and catalogs, SLAs, queues, and integrations

 - Technical translator, in both directions: able to explain complex technical solutions in plain English to executives, HR, Finance, and everyday users, and to turn vague business needs ("I just need it to work like this") into clear technical requirements, designs, and workflows

 - Clear writer: produces runbooks, KB articles, and decision docs that technical and non-technical readers can both follow

 - Reliable owner: keeps work visible, meets deadlines, raises blockers early

 - Self-starter with a real appetite for technical growth: takes initiative without waiting to be asked, and has a track record of upskilling on their own, such as learning new platforms, earning certifications, building side projects, or picking up new tools like n8n, APIs, and AI


CERTIFICATIONS

Strongly preferred

 - Okta Certified Professional

 - Okta Certified Administrator (Okta Certified Consultant / Workflows a plus)

 - Notion certification (Notion Admin / Notion Essentials or equivalent)

Nice to have

 - Apple Certified Support Professional / Apple Deployment and Management

 - Microsoft Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent Intune certification

 - Jamf or Kandji/Iru certification

 - Google Workspace Administrator certification

 - Zoom Phone or Zoom Workplace admin training/certification

 - Security fundamentals (CompTIA Security+, or similar)

Expectation: If not already Okta Certified, the hire completes Okta Professional and Administrator certification within the first 6 months (training available via our Okta Expert Learning Pass).


NICE-TO-HAVE EXPERIENCE

 - Intercom experience**:** workspace administration, inboxes and teams, assignment and routing rules, workflows and bots, Fin AI, help center, and integrations

 - Scripting: Python, JavaScript, Bash, or PowerShell

 - Rippling, Ashby, Torii (or similar SaaS management), Material Security, Slack admin/Workflow Builder

 - Touchpoints with GTM systems, especially Salesforce: user and license management, profiles and permission sets, Okta SSO/provisioning, connected apps and integration users, and sandbox access

 - Familiarity with the broader GTM stack: Gong / Gong Engage, Salesloft, HubSpot, LeanData, ZoomInfo, Clay, Gainsight, Intercom, Segment, and Letter.AI http://Letter.AI (or similar sales engagement, routing, enrichment, and CS tools)

 - Experience partnering with RevOps / GTM Systems on access bundles, onboarding and offboarding across GTM tools, integration and API token governance, and license true-ups

 - Basic data modeling; building dashboards in Notion, Metabase, or Tableau

 - Supporting audits (SOC 2) with evidence collection


HOW YOU WORK

 - Automate the second time: fix the ticket, then fix the system that caused it

 - Security by default: least privilege, clean offboarding, scoped AI, no secrets in Slack

 - Documentation is part of done: if it isn't in Notion, it isn't finished

CORE STACK

Including but not limited to:

Okta (SSO, SCIM, Workflows, Device Trust) · Iru MDM (macOS & Windows) · Microsoft Intune · n8n · Ticketing platform (Medely Help) · Notion · Google Workspace · Microsoft 365 · Slack · Rippling · Ashby · Zoom Workplace & Zoom Phone · Material Security · 1Password · Torii · Claude / Anthropic · Delphina · Metabase / Tableau · Jira/Atlassian

jobs.title: Weld Engineering Manager, Development
jobs.description:
HADRIAN - MANUFACTURING THE FUTURE

Hadrian is building autonomous factories to reindustrialize America. By combining AI, advanced software, robotics, and full-stack manufacturing, we help aerospace and defense companies build rockets, satellites, aircraft, ships, and other mission-critical systems up to 10x faster and at significantly lower cost.


Following our $1.37B Series D at a $7.87B valuation, Hadrian is rapidly expanding our manufacturing footprint, launching new capabilities across welding, casting, forging, electronics, additive manufacturing, and more, while scaling our Factory-as-a-Service platform to transform how critical products are built.


Backed by leading investors including JPMorgan Chase, Valor Equity Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, 137 Ventures, Lux Capital, T. Rowe Price, and Morgan Stanley, we’re building the future of American manufacturing—and looking for exceptional people to help make it happen.


If you’re ready to take on the most challenging and rewarding work of your career while helping create American manufacturing jobs for generations to come, you’re exactly who we’re looking for.




THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Welding Engineer, Manager to lead the weld development team that develops and qualifies welds at our Los Angeles development facility and scales them into production for mission-critical aerospace, defense, and maritime hardware. You will lead welding engineers, own the selection of welding equipment and processes, and build out the team as Hadrian grows. This is an on-site leadership role for someone who has developed welds for demanding programs and understands what it takes to run them in production.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead, mentor, and grow a team of welding engineers, including hiring, performance management, and career development

 - Oversee the development and qualification of weld processes and their transition into production

 - Own welding equipment and process selection, from defining requirements and evaluating vendors through installation and acceptance

 - Partner with production, tooling, automation, quality, and program teams to align welding priorities with production goals

 - Set welding standards and documentation practices, and serve as the welding point of contact for internal teams and customers


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Bachelor's degree in Welding Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field (equivalent experience considered)

 - 6+ years in welding engineering or weld process development, including 1+ years leading engineers or serving as a senior technical lead

 - Strong experience developing and qualifying welds for Navy or aerospace hardware

 - Prior production manufacturing experience and a clear understanding of what production needs from engineering

 - Working knowledge of NAVSEA, AWS D17.1, ASME Section IX, or MIL-STD welding requirements


WHAT WILL SET YOU APART

 - Experience selecting and implementing robotic or automated welding systems

 - Experience with laser beam, friction stir, or orbital welding of high-strength steel, stainless steel, nickel, titanium, or aluminum alloys

 - Experience building a welding team or capability from an early stage

 - Background in high-mix, low-volume or advanced manufacturing environments




BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

   401k 

 - Relocation support may be provided for certain situations, based on business need. 

 - Flexible vacation policy 

 - Equity

 


ITAR REQUIREMENTS
