jobs.title: Account Executive, LE, GBS
jobs.description:
About this role:

The Account Executive is a field sales role responsible for client retention and growth. Account Executives build trust-based relationships with C-Level Executives and their teams. They understand the mission-critical priorities of their clients and ensure clients receive the value from the Gartner relationship that they expect, while also identifying opportunities for stronger value delivery with alternative product offerings.

Account Executives will be given a territory of Large Enterprise clients.

In our Large Enterprise segment, Account Executives work with clients who have ~+$1bil in annual revenue.

What you will do:

• Drive value delivery with current Gartner clients, ensuring clients maximize the value they receive from their Gartner services
• Identify, cultivate, qualify, and close client growth opportunities through cross-sell and upsell
• Continually build a pipeline of high-quality opportunities to deliver against your sales metrics, ensuring KPI’s are met
• Quota responsibility for your assigned territory.
• Manage complex high-revenue sales across matrix and diverse business environments.
• Own forecasting and account planning on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis.

What you will need:

• 5-8+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments
• Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives
• Proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets.
• Proven ability to own, manage, and forecast a complex sales process.
• Willingness to conduct travel as needed.
• Bachelor's degree preferred

What you will get:

• Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, and more!
• Uncapped commission structure
• World-class sales training programs and skill development programs
• Annual "Winners Circle" event attendance at exclusive destinations for top performers
• Collaborative, team-oriented culture that embraces inclusion
• Professional development and career growth opportunities

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

jobs.description:
Business Area:

Seniority Level:

Mid-Senior level

Job Description:

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry.  Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Ready to take cloud innovation to the next level? Join Cloudera’s Anywhere Cloud team and help deliver a true “build your own pipeline, bring your own engine” experience — enabling data and AI workloads to run anywhere, without friction or vendor lock-in.

We bring the best of public cloud — cost efficiency, scalability, elasticity, and agility — to wherever data lives: public clouds, private data centers, and the edge. Powered by Kubernetes, our hybrid architecture separates compute and storage to maximize flexibility and optimize infrastructure usage.

This isn’t just cloud management — it’s about building a consistent, secure, and compliant cloud experience that gives organizations full access to all their data, anywhere.

With the acquisition of Taikun, we’re simplifying Kubernetes and cloud management even further, creating a unified, scalable, future-ready platform. If you’re passionate about Kubernetes — not just using it, but building it at the core, managing workloads across hybrid clouds and data centers, and obsessing over performance and DevOps — this is where you belong.

We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead the architecture and delivery of our cloud‑native AI platform. In this high‑impact role, you will bridge the gap between cutting‑edge AI research and production‑grade Kubernetes environments. You will build the “nervous system” of our AI stack—optimizing how we run and manage open‑source models (Llama, Qwen, etc.) using K8s‑native patterns like Custom Resources (CRDs) and Operators, enabling agentic AI to thrive, and designing integration patterns that let our product teams and customers consume AI capabilities seamlessly.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will:

• Enterprise AI Services: Design and implement elegant, scalable application services (Go/Node.js) that wrap AI capabilities for enterprise use.
• K8s-Native AI Orchestration: Lead the deployment of inference servers (vLLM, Triton) using KServe, KubeRay, or Knative to ensure serverless-style scaling for AI workloads.
• Developer Velocity: Build internal tooling, SDKs, and "AI Gateways" that enhance team agility and simplify the integration of Foundation Models (Llama, GPT) into product features.
• RAG & Prompt Engineering: Architect robust Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and prompt management services that integrate seamlessly with vector databases and enterprise data sources.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with UI engineers, UX designers, and Product Management to ensure the AI platform is not just powerful, but highly usable for internal developers.
• Infrastructure & Security: Ensure AI workloads are secure, multi-tenant, and optimized for GPU resource scheduling (MIG, fractional GPUs) within Kubernetes.

We’re excited about you if you have:

• Bachelor’s degree with 6+ years of software engineering experience (or equivalent Masters/PhD tenure), with at least 2+ years focused on AI/ML systems.
• Expert proficiency in Python (for AI ecosystem) and strong competence in a systems language like Go or Rust/C++ (for high-performance serving layers).
• Deep understanding of LLM deployment challenges and runtimes (e.g., vLLM, ONNX, TorchServe, Triton). Familiarity with quantization techniques (AWQ, GPTQ) to optimize model size/speed.
• Experience building complex workflows using tools like LangChain or LlamaIndex, and deploying them on containerized infrastructure (Docker/Kubernetes).
• Ability to navigate the rapidly changing AI landscape, filtering hype from practical engineering solutions, and driving technical alignment across teams.

You May Also Have:

• Model Fine-Tuning: Experience with efficient fine-tuning techniques (PEFT, LoRA/QLoRA) on custom datasets.
• GPU Optimization: Familiarity with CUDA programming or profiling GPU performance (Nsight systems).
• Open Source: Contributions to open-source AI projects (HuggingFace transformers, vLLM, etc.).

Why this role matters:

This is more than cloud management, it’s about building the foundation for a consistent, secure, and compliant cloud experience that gives organizations 100% access to 100% of their data, anywhere.

With the recent acquisition of Taikun, we are simplifying Kubernetes and cloud management even further, creating a platform that is unified, scalable, and future-ready.

If you are passionate about Kubernetes, not just using it but building it at the core managing workloads across hybrid clouds and datacenters and obsessed with performance, devops, etc. this is where you belong.

This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.

jobs.title: Property Adjuster - Field Estimating - Memphis, TN
jobs.description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

A day in the life of a Field Property Adjuster, and what it takes to do the job!

As a Field Property Adjuster, you will provide exceptional service to our policyholders. Your primary responsibility will involve traveling to our customers' homes to conduct on-site inspections, investigate coverage, prepare estimates, and settle claims promptly and efficiently. Additionally, you will handle virtual claims countrywide, leveraging various platforms and software such as Xactimate and ClaimsX Video Collaboration. Your expertise will be particularly focused on water losses, ensuring our customers receive the highest level of support and resolution for these specific claims.

You'll wear a few hats that will require a level of experience:

• The Customer Service Expert –you’ll live into Allstate’s Claims Culture by caring, empowering, and restoring, and you will accomplish that by being compassionate, clear, and a committed partner in each claim. You lead with empathy, always.

• The Investigator – you’ll confidently and independently investigate property claims by performing detailed reviews of damage and interpreting policies to determine coverage.

• The Effective Communicator – you’ll use phone, emails and sometimes even video chat with customers to help them through a fast, fair, and easy claims process. You’ll also incorporate a specific approach to claim handling to offer the customer their preference of communication to efficiently discuss their claim needs and keep them updated on the claim progress.

• The Negotiator – You will evaluate and negotiate claims settlements with customers, vendors, third party carriers and claimants, in accordance with all legal and business standard methodologies. With negotiations, you will incorporate tactics in handling challenging and complex situations.

• The Problem Solver –you’ll utilize multiple tools to get the job done in a fast-paced environment, including estimate tools, job aids, and additional settlement platforms, all while using your sharp critical thinking skills.

• The Recorder – you’ll protect the company financially by executing policies along policy agreements, and you keep a clear record of your work in a claims system that you will be trained in. You’ll accomplish this by ensuring timely and accurate documentation is completed as you work on each claim.

Qualifications:

• 2 years' previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

• Previous experience as an outside adjuster is highly desired.

• Proficiency in using Xactimate and other relevant software for estimating.

• Strong critical thinking and technical skills to assess damages accurately and expedite claims settlements.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to provide exceptional customer service.

• Ability to travel to customers' homes and handle virtual claims countrywide effectively.

• Detail-oriented and organized, with a focus on delivering high-quality work.

• This position is not available for California, Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico residents.

Required Qualifications:

• Residency within the posted location is mandatory for this role.

• Are willing and able to carry a 50-pound ladder and access up to a 6/12 pitch on a one to two-story roof.

• Valid driver's license and willingness to travel as part of the job requirements.

You’re provided with comprehensive training:

• The training program is designed to help you build a claims foundation and understand the systems and processes in your day-to-day work.

• Ongoing training opportunities for continuous improvement happen regularly on the job.

• You will be required to attend approximately 2 weeks of training that will take place in Dallas, TX.

Notice of Licensing Requirement:

• As a condition of employment, your office/area may require you to obtain an adjuster and/or an appraiser license which includes passing an additional background check with the Department of Labor. If applicable, you will be required to secure license(s) within 60 days of hire.
• If required, the Hiring Manager will work with you along with the Centralized Licensing team to ensure that you are properly licensed.
• As a requirement of employment, individuals who currently hold an active insurance license must terminate all existing appointments prior to onboarding and must not hold any outside appointments at any point during employment.
• Applicants seeking an adjuster role who also hold a resident producer license must formally surrender that license when instructed to by the licensing team. By proceeding with the application process, applicants acknowledge and accept these licensing requirements and agree to comply.

Sign On Bonus:

You may be eligible for a $1,000 Licensing Sign on Bonus if you have the applicable active licenses needed for this role.  This could include Home Resident Property & Casualty License, Designated Home State (DHS) Florida or Texas License, and/or applicable Appraiser License.

*Current employees or candidates who have previously worked for Allstate, including its family of companies, are not eligible for this sign-on bonus.

Company Car:

Based on our Company Car Guidelines, this role may qualify for a company car. Our leadership team determines this based on annual work mileage for this location. You may be required to use your personal vehicle until these guidelines are met. We offer mileage reimbursements for personal vehicle usage during work.

Allstate Benefits:

Being a part of Allstate means you receive a benefits package from Day 1 of employment.  This includes time off, healthcare, retirement, and more.  That is why as an Allstater, you’ll enjoy a Total Rewards package that includes:

• Competitive pay with needed support for continuous development and career advancement.

• Flexibility in scheduling and a time off policy that helps support your work/life balance.

• Initial and ongoing training to get you proficient in your new role.

• Comprehensive benefits like a 401K/pension, education reimbursement, and programs to help you balance work with the rest of your life. Visit www.allstategoodlife.com to learn more.

jobs.title: Senior Software Program Manager – CSP Engagements
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the CSP Engagements team, focused on deep technical engagement with hyperscale cloud service providers for NVIDIA’s next‑generation datacenter systems such as Vera Rubin NVL72. This role is intended for experienced systems and embedded software leaders—including software engineering managers, technical leads, or senior architects—who have led datacenter server and platform software programs and can operate as a trusted technical partner to hyperscale CSP engineering teams.

As a member of the CSP Engagements team, you will act as the primary technical engagement leader between NVIDIA’s system software organizations and CSP platform, system software, and AI teams, ensuring alignment, readiness, and successful large‑scale deployment of NVIDIA‑based datacenter solutions.

What you will be doing:

• Lead deep technical engagements with hyperscale CSPs as the primary NVIDIA point of contact for system software, firmware, and platform readiness for NVIDIA datacenter products.
• Partner directly with CSP system software, firmware, and infrastructure engineering leaders to align on software architecture, bring‑up plans, deployment readiness, and production requirements for NVIDIA‑based server and rack‑scale platforms.
• Represent CSP technical priorities internally, advocating for customer requirements and tradeoffs across NVIDIA’s system software, firmware, hardware, silicon, and product teams are aligned to customer needs, timelines, and constraints.
• Own the end‑to‑end CSP engagement lifecycle, from early technical alignment and pre‑production readiness through large‑scale deployment, escalation management, and sustained production support.
• Drive bi‑directional technical communication: translating CSP system‑level requirements into actionable focus areas for NVIDIA engineering teams, while clearly communicating NVIDIA platform capabilities, tradeoffs, and limitations back to customers.
• Proactively identify and manage cross‑company technical risks affecting CSP deployments, including OS enablement, firmware maturity, observability, reliability, and hardware/software integration challenges.
• Support rack‑scale and multi‑rack datacenter deployments by working closely with CSP infrastructure teams and NVIDIA engineering stakeholders to ensure system software readiness and operational success at hyperscale.

What we need to see:

This role requires strong technical depth and leadership credibility in systems software.

• Strong background in systems or embedded software, with experience across Linux kernel/drivers, server firmware (BMC/BIOS/UEFI), or datacenter platform bring‑up and hardware/software interfaces.
• Demonstrated technical leadership as a software engineering manager, technical lead/architect, or senior systems/platform engineer leading large cross‑functional efforts.
• Demonstrated experience delivering datacenter server software or rack scale systems, not application only or SaaS only software.
• Experience working directly with hyperscale CSP engineering teams on deep technical topics, including bring up, performance, reliability, observability, and deployment readiness.
• Strong ability to operate as a technical leader and influencer, aligning senior engineers, architects, and executives across organizational and company boundaries.
• BS or MS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
• 10+ years of experience in systems software, embedded software, or datacenter server development, including leadership responsibility

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

• Direct experience with NVIDIA GB200 and/or GB300 platforms, including hands‑on or leadership involvement in system software, firmware, or platform enablement efforts.
• Experience driving or supporting CSP-facing engagements specifically for NVIDIA datacenter platforms, translating GB200 / GB300 software and firmware capabilities into production‑ready solutions.
• Familiarity with the end‑to‑end NVIDIA data center software stack, including system software bring‑up, platform integration, observability, reliability, and deployment considerations at hyperscale.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world working for us. NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative, hardworking and self-motivated, we want to hear from you!

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing, and Visualization. Our invention serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables outstanding creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is seeking outstanding individuals like you to help us drive the next wave of artificial intelligence.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Specialist
jobs.description:
About Us

At Antares, our long-term mission is to make clean energy abundant from Earth to the Asteroid Belt. We’re fueled by the belief that advanced nuclear energy can strengthen our military, solve the climate crisis, elevate global living standards, and expand humanity's presence in outer space. To achieve our mission, we’re building mass-producible, inherently safe, deployable microreactors that can be used terrestrially, underwater, and in space.



The Antares team hails from SpaceX, the White House, the Pentagon, the Department of Energy, MIT, Rigetti Computing, General Atomics, Relativity Space, Ursa Major, and National Laboratories like Idaho, Oak Ridge, Los Alamos, and Savannah River. Antares has raised over $600M in venture capital from top-tier investors and has hundreds of million-dollars on contract with the military services, NASA, and the Department of Energy.

About the Team

As an early member of the Antares Supply Chain team, you will have a definitive role in ensuring we are able to meet our aggressive timelines and evolving our supply chain to enable factory-produced microreactors at scale. As a Supply Chain Specialist, you will execute and improve the workflows connecting business requirements, suppliers, purchase orders, delivery, invoicing, and payment across direct and indirect procurement.

You will combine hands-on purchasing and supplier management with analytics and process building, partnering with Finance to improve controls and reporting. The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, and comfortable balancing urgent actions with longer-term improvement.



Roles & Responsibilities:

 - Execute direct and indirect sourcing, purchase order management, and delivery follow-up

 - Manage supplier performance, risks, open actions, and recovery plans

 - Partner with Finance and Accounts Payable to improve approvals, invoice matching, exceptions, and payment visibility

 - Create dashboard and reporting for spend, purchase order status, supplier performance, lead times, and overdue actions

 - Document procurement procedures, approvals, data standards, and ownership

 - Maintain supplier and purchasing data to support sourcing decisions and negotiations

 - Balance urgent needs with controls, documentation, and scalable processes



Basic Qualifications:

 - Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, business, finance, engineering, information systems, analytics, or a related field; OR 5+ years of relevant experience in procurement, supply chain, supplier management, or business operations



Preferred Skills and Experience:

 - Experience across both direct and indirect procurement categories

 - Experience improving procure-to-pay or source-to-pay processes in partnership with Finance or Accounts Payable

 - Proficiency with ERP, MRP, procurement, purchasing, or accounts payable systems

 - Experience creating dashboards and recurring reports using spreadsheets and/or business intelligence tools

 - Demonstrated success managing supplier performance, commercial issues, and corrective actions

 - Proven success in fast-changing hardware environment



Additional Requirements:

 - Ability to work long hours and weekends as necessary to support critical milestones

 - Ability to travel up to 20% when necessary to interface with suppliers and support business needs

Location

 - We are located in Torrance, CA in a 322,000 square foot, brand new facility featuring large open spaces for team collaboration, R&D, and production, as well as easy access to the 405, 105, and 110 freeways. Our facility is in the heart of Los Angeles' vibrant emerging tech ecosystem alongside many other high growth startups and enterprises. Employees are required to work in-office 5 days/week.



Culture

At Antares, we like to specifically tie each role to our founding document’s set of values–here are the top five cultural values we think you should believe at your core to be successful:

 - Think in Systems - Energy and Defense are complex ecosystems with numerous stakeholders with competing priorities, conflicting policies, perverse incentives, and emergent and path-dependent properties. First principles thinking alone is insufficient. Think probabilistically and then take action. “If you want to be certain, then you are apt to be obsolete.” Over-optimizing the components often degrades the system

 - Obsess over the End User - The customer and end user are often not the same. We will never build globally competitive commercial products if we lose sight of our end users and their entire interaction with the product life cycle

 - Be Unconstrained by Convention - Our only limits are the laws of physics. Many, even experts, will say what we are working on is impossible. They said the same about SpaceX reusing rockets. Generationally impactful companies, by definition, must accomplish the seemingly impossible. If it were easy, it would have already been done. Never shy away from a solution because it has never been tried before, and never choose to do something because that's “how it's always been done”

 - Go Where the Work Is - Never miss a chance to meet a customer, user, or stakeholder face to face, even if that means hopping on a plane. If you can’t make it, find a teammate who can channel your intentions and go in your place. Deep work can be done from anywhere, but we believe teams are built in person, and aim to maximize our time together

 - Operate in the Grey - Embrace nuance in pursuit of truth. Question every fundamental assumption
   
   

Equal Opportunity

Antares is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are based solely on merit, competence, and qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. jobs.title: Software Engineer II -  Java, Spring, AWS, CI/CD
jobs.description:
GHX is seeking a Software Engineer with strong technical skills and growing experience in designing, developing, and delivering quality software solutions. You will join the Rules and Actions team and report to the Manager of Engineering. The team owns the rules engine at the core of the GHX Exchange platform. That engine evaluates routing and business rules against document events and runs the resulting actions, such as routing, notifications, and document processing, for healthcare supply chain transactions.

The ideal candidate is proficient in Java and the J2EE/Spring stack, has exposure to AWS cloud services and event-driven systems, and is developing skills in CI/CD pipelines and software design patterns.

What You'll Work On

- Build and enhance features in the rules execution service. It consumes EventBus document events, runs the rule engine, and publishes outcomes such as route-found and no-route-found.

- Implement rule types, specifications, and actions on the shared rules framework and Exchange extension libraries, following established patterns.

- Support EventBus-driven rules, including MongoDB-backed rule definitions, event matching, and rule caching.

- Contribute to Intelligent Business Rules (IBR) capabilities such as business-rule statistics and change-request persistence.

- Develop and maintain rule actions for document handling and integrations, with guidance from senior engineers. Ship changes behind feature flags.

- Write JUnit 5 and Mockito tests, and help with ongoing monolith decoupling and Java version migrations.

Duties and Responsibilities

- Design and implement scalable, secure, and maintainable software that aligns with business needs and is flexible, reusable, and efficient.

- Translate ideas into clear, high-quality code under the guidance of senior engineers.

- Contribute to technical design for features and stories. Document your work and follow IT control policies.

- Work with your team and cross-functional partners to address technical dependencies, review ideas and concerns, and deliver high-quality products.

- Identify issues of limited scope, analyze their impact, and resolve them independently or with guidance from senior team members.

- Follow best practices for design, development, testing, and Agile workflows.

- Build professional relationships within the team to support collaboration and knowledge sharing.

- Develop an understanding of the rules subsystems, their components, and how they interact (EventBus, MongoDB, ConfigSvc, Elasticsearch) to support feature development.

Qualifications

- Minimum of 2–3 years of software development experience

- BS in Computer Science, or similar work experience

- 2+ years developing solutions with Java and J2EE technologies (Spring, Maven)

- Working knowledge of cloud technologies. AWS experience with EC2, SNS, SQS, S3, or Lambda is nice to have.

- Experience with databases. MongoDB, Elasticsearch, and MySQL are nice to have.

- Exposure to a rules engine and/or event-driven architecture (event buses, publish/subscribe messaging)

- Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment

- Able to work independently on well-defined tasks and collaboratively as part of a team

- Experience delivering moderate-complexity features

- Strong problem-solving and communication skills

Nice to Have

- Exposure to Liquibase or other database migration tools

- Experience with feature flags or configuration services

- Interest in healthcare, supply chain, or EDI/B2B document exchange

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

- Delivers high-quality results on assigned tasks with attention to detail and commitment to excellence

- Communicates technical concepts clearly to team members and immediate stakeholders

- Collaborates effectively within the team and with other departments

- Is developing an understanding of how individual work affects the broader system and team goals

- Contributes to team success through reliable execution and willingness to learn

jobs.title: Propulsion Engineer, Non-Destructive Evaluation (Raptor)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PROPULSION ENGINEER, NON-DESTRUCTIVE EVALUATION

NDE (Non-Destructive Evaluation) Engineers ensure the structural integrity and reliability of the Raptor Engine. At the Hawthorne facility, you will utilize advanced NDE techniques, including phased-array ultrasonics and immersion ultrasonics to improve manufacturing processes. You will seamlessly integrate these methods with automated systems to enable high-rate production, drive optimizations, and ensure mission success.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop NDE inspection methods from feasibility through production cut-in, covering sensors, scan development, software, and qualification

• Design and prototype ultrasonic sensor systems, scan setups, and part tooling to meet coverage, sensitivity, and cycle-time requirements

• Partner with responsible engineers on inspection requirements, designing parts for inspectability, method selection, and evaluation of production data

• Validate new techniques with modeling, bench-top trials, and production-representative scans before committing to full-scale hardware

• Drive vendors, tooling, and automation from requirements and procurement through on-site install, integration, and commissioning

• Build and deploy automated evaluation, data storage, and reporting pipelines that link inspection results to work orders

• Define integration test plans, qualification evidence, and production-cut-in criteria that track to the program schedule

• Present risk, performance, and recommendations to manufacturing, design, and leadership

• Debug hardware and software interactions at the inspection cell during development and production

• Use production scan data to improve detection performance, reduce cycle time, and eliminate false calls and escapes

• Train production technicians on new inspection methods and support them through process activation

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in an engineering discipline, physics, or computer science

• 1+ years of hands-on with non-destructive evaluation techniques and processes

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Master’s degree or PhD in an engineering discipline

• Knowledge of a variety of NDE techniques such as phased array ultrasonic testing, immersion ultrasonic testing, eddy current testing, digital radiography testing, etc.

• Knowledge of statistical modeling, machine learning, and mathematical optimization

• Understanding of hardware and software development and validation process

• Familiarity with JIRA or similar task/feature tracking systems

• Knowledge of automation and controls

• Experience with software and automation coding (Labview, Python, C#, SQL)

• Ability to multitask, from developing technologies, project management, and training people throughout the introduction of multiple productive solutions, from inception and R&D to full-volume production

• Experience with problem solving tools and techniques: Practical Problem Solving, 8D etc."

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work flexible hours and occasional weekend support as needed

• Ability to travel to vendors and other SpaceX sites as needed (up to 25%)

jobs.description:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest is uniquely positioned across the consumer journey – from inspiration and discovery through consideration, purchase, and long-term customer relationships. Pinners’ commercial intent and engagement create valuable signals that can help advertisers better understand and improve their performance. This role will define how Pinterest applies identity, conversion, and measurement signals to help advertisers identify and acquire new customers, measure incremental outcomes, and optimize campaign bidding. By connecting measurement insights with campaign decisioning, this leader will help advertisers maximize business outcomes and strengthen Pinterest’s differentiation in the ads ecosystem.

The ideal candidate is a Staff-level product leader with substantial experience in ads measurement, optimization, or adjacent advertising technology. They deeply understand how advertisers set growth objectives, distinguish acquisition from retention, evaluate incrementality, and translate insights into campaign and bidding decisions. They have strong quantitative and technical fluency across attribution, experimentation, causal measurement, customer-lifecycle signals, and ads optimization. They excel at partnering cross-functionally with engineering, data science, research, PMM, sales, and other teams to transform complex sigånals and methodologies into credible, actionable, privacy-durable, and scalable products.

What you’ll do:

• Own the strategy and end-to-end execution for products that apply Pinterest’s identity, conversion, and measurement signals to improve advertiser outcomes across new-customer acquisition, incrementality, and bidding optimization.

• Partner closely with engineering, data science, design, research, PMM, sales, partnerships, legal, privacy, and policy/integrity to deliver solutions with strong product-market fit, methodological rigor, regulatory compliance, and long-term durability.

• Build a comprehensive suite of products that helps drive incremental reach and performance for Pinterest advertisers.

What we’re looking for:

• 8+ years of experience working as a Product Manager or in a related role, including 3–5+ years of substantial ads or marketing measurement experience.

• Strong evidence of the ability to define new products and strategies in an ambiguous space and execute from ideation and multi-quarter roadmaps through go-to-market and adoption.

• Deep understanding of identity and first-person data, how advertisers establish objectives and deploy tactics, and how they evaluate outcomes across awareness, consideration, intent, conversion, and long-term value.

• Experience working with engineering, data science, analytics, research, or PMM cross-functional teams and a strong ability to empathize with, anticipate the needs of, and collaborate with a diverse set of stakeholders.

• Strong quantitative judgment and understanding of attribution, incrementality, experimentation, brand lift, conversion lift, and measurement tradeoffs.

• Deep understanding of business metrics and tradeoffs in the context of online platforms or multi-sided ecosystems.

• Preferred but not required: Experience with creator, influencer, branded-content, social, video, commerce, or organic-and-paid measurement.

• Preferred but not required: Experience building advertiser-facing measurement products or working with advertisers, agencies, creators, marketing science teams, or measurement partners.

• Preferred but not required: Experience designing, running, or analyzing incrementality or lift experiments.

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

• This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

The selected candidate will help coordinate team priorities, provide guidance on complex and escalated requests, train and support team members, and ensure consistent execution of established return processes.

jobs.title: Site Merchandising Specialist
jobs.description:
Clean luxury. Better for you. At Everlane, we believe luxury should be as effortless as it is conscious. We partner with ethical factories, work with premium, sustainably sourced materials, and strive to leave the industry cleaner than we found it. There's still much to do, and we're excited to grow a team of motivated humans ready for the challenge. The journey toward better continues.

The Ecommerce team shapes the customer shopping experience on Everlane.com. Through customer insights, ecommerce best practices, and cross-functional collaboration, we ensure customers can easily discover our products, understand the value behind them, and shop with confidence. We partner closely with Merchandising, Product, Engineering, Data, Creative, and Marketing to deliver a seamless, brand-aligned digital experience that brings Everlane's products and sustainability commitments to life.

As a Site Merchandising Specialist at Everlane, you will execute and optimize our digital storefront, with a focus on Product Detail Pages (PDPs), Collection Pages, site navigation, and promotional experiences. This role requires hands-on Shopify experience, strong merchandising instincts, and a data-informed approach to improving product discoverability, site accuracy, and Conversion.

What You’ll Do

Product Detail Page (PDP) Execution

• Build, maintain, and optimize PDPs, ensuring product descriptions, imagery, attributes, and key product benefits are accurate, complete, and aligned with Everlane's brand voice.

• Manage end-to-end image uploads, asset placement, and quality assurance to ensure product imagery reflects current assortments and meets brand standards.

• Maintain product page accuracy across launches, assortment updates, and ongoing site changes.

Collection & Landing Page Management

• Create, maintain, and optimize collection and landing pages to support product launches, seasonal updates, promotional events, and marketing initiatives.

• Manage product categorization, sorting, and placement to improve product discoverability and align with merchandising priorities.

• Ensure collection pages reflect inventory availability, product priorities, and the overall customer shopping experience.

Site Merchandising & Optimization

• Execute day-to-day site merchandising updates in Shopify, ensuring site content, product information, and merchandising configurations are accurate and timely.

• Generate and share optimized PDP and Collection Page URLs with the Retention team, completing final QA on email campaigns to verify product accuracy and real-time inventory availability.

• Partner with Merchandising, Marketing, Creative, and cross-functional teams to execute promotions, new product launches, and brand storytelling.

• Identify opportunities to improve site navigation, product discovery, and the overall shopping journey.

Data & Performance Analysis

• Monitor site performance and merchandising KPIs using analytics tools to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

• Use performance insights to inform product placement, collection sorting, and site merchandising decisions.

• Support A/B testing and conversion rate optimization initiatives focused on improving PDP and collection page effectiveness.

• Conduct regular site audits and QA to proactively identify and resolve merchandising, content, and functionality issues.

We'd Love to Hear From You If You Have

• 2+ years of experience in ecommerce, site merchandising, or digital retail, with hands-on experience managing a live ecommerce storefront.

• Hands-on Shopify experience, including managing product detail pages, collections, merchandising updates, and site content.

• Strong understanding of ecommerce merchandising fundamentals, product discoverability, inventory considerations, and the customer shopping journey.

• Experience managing product content, image assets, and site QA with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.

• Familiarity with ecommerce analytics and performance metrics, with the ability to translate insights into actionable merchandising improvements.

• Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to prioritize competing deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets; experience with Looker and Airtable is a plus.

• Familiarity with web analytics, A/B testing, or heat mapping tools is a plus.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams.

• A proactive, detail-oriented mindset and a strong sense of ownership over the quality of the customer shopping experience.

The Fine Print:

LA: This is a full-time role based in our Los Angeles Creative Studio located in the Arts District. We are on a hybrid schedule, with at least three days in the office per week, Tuesdays through Thursdays.

Remote Positions: This is a fully remote position. Please note: We are only accepting applications from those who file their taxes in one of the following states: California, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Kansas, Massachusetts, Minnesota, North Carolina, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, and Washington.

jobs.description:

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Sweetgreen is a national restaurant brand dedicated to building healthier communities by connecting people to real food. Dots is building personal AI agents that help people make progress on their goals, including when they are away from ChatGPT. These agents can learn preferences, maintain context, work across applications, and use cloud computers to carry out tasks.

Our team brings together product engineering, design, and research to turn frontier model capabilities into useful everyday experiences. We are defining how people delegate work, understand what an agent is doing, and stay in control. Engineers help shape both the product and the systems behind it, from early prototypes through launch and iteration.

About the Role

We are looking for Senior and Staff Full Stack Software Engineers to build Dots product experiences from the interface through the services that power them. You will help define how people delegate tasks to personal agents, follow their progress, and collaborate with them over time. This role combines hands-on product development with the systems work needed to make persistent, asynchronous agent experiences reliable.

In this role, you will:

 - Build and launch features across web interfaces, APIs, backend services, and data models.

 - Create workflows for task creation, progress updates, agent feedback, and results that remain coherent across sessions and devices.

 - Translate emerging model capabilities into product prototypes with research, product, and design partners.

 - Design clear interfaces between product surfaces and agent execution systems.

 - Improve performance and reliability across the stack, including user-facing latency and recovery from partial failures.

 - Own projects from early exploration through architecture, implementation, launch, and iteration based on user feedback.

We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

• Ensure that the firmware is as protected and tamper-proof as the hardware platform can provide

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

• Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

• 401(k) + company match

• Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

• See challenges as opportunities

• Embrace change and continuous improvement

• Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day

Skills & Qualifications

• You’ll be a great communicator (verbally and with the written word) as you’ll work closely with team members to review schematics and new designs. jobs.title: Internal Audit Manager
jobs.description:
Pay Range: $101,200-$126,500

Remote Eligible: Hybrid

We offer a pay-for-performance compensation program including bonuses for all employees and a competitive benefits package. See https://www.cuofco.org/careers for a high-level overview of our benefits package and bonus offerings.

General Purpose of the Position

The Internal Audit Manager is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the Internal Audit Function and ensuring effective execution of the Credit Union’s audit plan. This role ensures alignment with the strategic direction established by the Director of Internal Audit and translates that direction into effective operational execution by managing audit activities, guiding team performance, and ensuring high-quality, risk-based audit delivery. The Internal Audit Manager will serve as a key leader within the department, providing coaching and development to audit staff, promoting consistency in audit methodologies, and supporting continuous improvement of audit processes, tools, and capabilities. This position plays a critical role in strengthening internal controls, enhancing risk management, and delivering value-added insights that support organizational objectives.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Accountable for the execution and delivery of the annual audit plan, ensuring audits are completed timely, efficiently, and in alignment with risk-based principles

• Provide leadership, coaching, and performance management for audit staff, including Supervisor, Senior Auditors, and Auditors, fostering a high-performing and accountable team environment

• Oversee the end-to-end audit lifecycle, including planning, fieldwork, reporting, and follow-up, ensuring consistency, quality, and adherence to internal audit methodologies and professional standards

• Monitor and manage audit progress, resource allocation, and competing priorities to ensure effective and efficient delivery of audit activities

• Ensure audit engagements meet established standards, regulatory expectations, internal audit methodologies, including appropriate review and approval prior to Director review

• Serve as a primary point of contact for business unit management regarding audit activities, findings, and recommendations, ensuring clear communication and alignment on outcomes

• Facilitate communication of audit results, ensuring findings are well-defined, supported, and include actionable and value-added recommendations

• Monitor and support the timely resolution of audit findings and corrective actions, ensuring accountability and effective issue remediation

• Support the Director in Supervisory Committee communications by preparing clear, risk-focused reporting on audit results, emerging risks, audit trends, while also contributing to enhancing reporting clarity, consistency, and value-added insights

• Identify and escalate emerging risks, delays, or issues impacting delivery of the audit plan, including significant control concerns or trends

• Promote adherence to risk-based auditing principles and applicable professional standards, including the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) framework, and drive consistency across audit activities

• Support talent development through training, mentorship, and ongoing feedback to enhance technical, analytical, and professional capabilities across the audit team

• Participate in workforce planning, including resource allocation, capacity management, and hiring support to ensure alignment with audit plan coverage and organizational needs

• Promote and support the use of audit technology, data analytics, and automation to enhance audit efficiency, coverage, and resource management

• Partner with internal stakeholders to enhance audit tools, reporting capabilities, and overall audit effectiveness

• Identify opportunities for process improvement through audit insights, including systemic issues and root cause trends, and collaborate with appropriate stakeholders to drive improvements

• Maintain awareness of emerging risks, regulatory changes, auditing practices, and industry trends impacting the Credit Union and incorporate considerations into audit execution and planning

• Ensure audits are aligned with the Credit Union’s risk profile, organizational objectives, internal policies, and applicable regulatory requirements including adherence to federal and state regulations and the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and OFAC

• Support coordination with external auditors and regulatory examiners as needed, in collaboration with the Director of Internal Audit

• Support the review and enhancement of audit-related policies and procedures to ensure alignment with evolving regulations, legal requirements, and industry trends

• Support fraud investigations, partnering with Risk Management and/or the People Team in reporting and coordinating with appropriate authorities, insurance providers, and management

• Support special investigations or audits as directed by the Director of Internal Audit, Supervisory Committee, Board of Directors, or Senior Management

• Support the Director in Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) activities by contributing to risk assessments, reporting, and follow-up with stakeholders

• Assists and supports Credit Union personnel and management as required

• Ensure that the Credit Union's professional reputation is maintained both internally and externally

• Ensures that appropriate levels of security and confidentiality are maintained

• Performs additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Requirements

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Requires Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field; plus five (5) years of auditing experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience, including experience in a financial institution environment. Demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience preferred. Industry certifications are preferred (CIA, CISA, CFE, CPA).

OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES

Strong knowledge of Credit Union operations, internal controls, risk management practices, and audit methodologies, including risk-based auditing and the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA). Proven ability to lead and develop teams, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality results. Effective communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships across all levels of the organization. Experience using audit tools, data analytics, and standard office software. A valid driver’s license is required for travel.

DIRECT REPORTS

Internal Audit Supervisor; Senior Internal Auditor; Internal Auditor; Product Analyst/Internal Auditor; Internal Operations Auditor

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is typically required to remain stationary for long periods and is occasionally required to lift/move or transport up to 25 pounds. Employee will need to occasionally move about inside an office to access files, mail, office machinery, etc. and constantly operates a computer and other office equipment, such as a phone, copier/printer, etc.  Will need to position self to maintain computers, including under desks and in the server closet. Employee will frequently communicate with members and co-workers and must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations. Employee will travel to visit CU location as needed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Core Competencies

Every position at Credit Union of Colorado is grounded in our organizational Core Values and Core Competencies. These skills and behaviors guide how we work, collaborate, and deliver results. Click here to view our Core Values and Core Competencies on Atlas.

Credit Union of Colorado is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Dots is building personal AI agents that help people make progress on their goals, including when they are away from ChatGPT. These agents can learn preferences, maintain context, work across applications, and use cloud computers to carry out tasks.

jobs.title: Senior International Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than  3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior International Marketing Manager to build Roo's brand and growth in every market we enter outside the US. Roo launched in Canada in September 2026, our first market outside the US, and we're growing across Canada while planning the countries that come next.

You'll lead marketing for Roo's international markets and be accountable for the outcome: bringing animal hospitals and veterinary professionals onto Roo in each new market and keeping them engaged. You'll define the marketing strategy, own the go-to-market and engagement plans, and partner closely with Roo's sales, brand, lifecycle, partnerships, and other marketing teams to bring them to life. Drawing on deep knowledge of each market, you'll guide partners with the direction and local insight they need for anything Roo launches there. Along the way, you'll build the playbook Roo uses to launch every new country.

Responsibilities

Market Strategy & Go-to-Market

• Own the marketing strategy for Roo's international markets, setting goals for acquisition and brand presence on both sides of the marketplace.

• Lead go-to-market and engagement planning for each new market: audience and market insight, positioning, channel mix, budget, timeline, and measurement.

• Build Roo's international launch playbook so each new country launches faster and with less lift than the last.

• Bring the voice of each market back to Roo, sharing what you learn from veterinary professionals, hospitals, and partners to shape product, pricing, and marketing decisions.

Positioning & Messaging

• Define Roo's positioning and messaging for each market in partnership with the brand and product marketing teams, building on Roo's core frameworks and grounding them in how veterinary professionals and hospitals there work, hire, and think about their careers.

• Develop the proof points, customer stories, and data that build Roo's credibility in a new market.

• Own each market's messaging framework and set the standard for Roo's voice and narrative in market, partnering with the brand and lifecycle teams to bring it into campaigns, the website, sales materials, and the product experience.

• Know each country's marketing, privacy, and anti-spam laws, apply them to every campaign, and educate other internal teams on these laws, ensuring compliance.

Acquisition & Growth

• Own acquisition strategy and budget for each market across paid, organic, referral, and partner channels.

• Partner with the sales and account management teams on hospital and veterinary professionals acquisition and growth, aligning on targets and pipeline and equipping them with the messaging, materials, and campaigns that support their outreach.

• Partner with the lifecycle team on onboarding, activation, and engagement journeys for each market, bringing the audience insight, messaging, and goals that shape them, and reviewing performance together to turn new sign-ups into active users.

• Shape referral and ambassador programs that help veterinary professionals and hospitals bring Roo to their peers.

Brand Presence & Community

• Partner with the brand team to grow Roo's presence in each market, bringing local insight and ideas to campaigns, content, design, and creative so the work feels like Roo and lands locally.

• Partner with the brand team on PR and earned media for each market, surfacing local stories, voices, and media opportunities that build Roo's credibility.

• Bring ideas for Roo's presence at conferences, trade shows, CE events, and industry moments, and partner with the brand, events, and partnerships teams to bring them to life, from concept and experience through the follow-up that turns attendees into Roo users.

• Build relationships with local partners, key opinion leaders, and industry associations that help Roo earn trust in a new market.

Measurement & Insights

• Own marketing measurement for each market, setting goals and metrics before every launch and campaign and tracking performance across the funnel on both sides of the marketplace.

• Track channel and campaign performance against budget, read signals in early data, and shift investment toward what's working.

• Measure brand awareness and perception as Roo grows in each market, partnering with the brand team on research.

• Share clear, regular reporting on what's working, what isn't, and what's next with international and marketing leadership.

What Success Looks Like

In your first year, you will:

• Launch in new Canadian markets on schedule.

• Grow hospital and veterinary professional acquisition in Canada against plan and within budget.

• Grow Roo's brand presence in Canada, so Roo shows up in the industry moments and conversations that matter to veterinary professionals and hospitals.

• Set a clear measure for every channel and move investment toward what works.

• Build a launch playbook that's ready for Roo's next country.

• Prepare and lead the next country launch

Qualifications

• You have deep experience in multi-channel marketing strategy, including launching a brand or product in a new market or country.

• You've owned positioning and messaging for a professional audience and built the proof points that made it credible.

• You've owned acquisition budgets and measurement, and make smart trade-offs when data is early.

• You bring cross-functional partners together around a shared plan and move work forward through people you don't manage.

• You're comfortable building from ambiguity and move easily between strategy and hands-on work.

• You understand marketing and privacy regulation across countries, ideally including Canada.

• Thoughtful about where AI and emerging tools improve how marketing teams work, and where human judgment matters most.

• Experience in veterinary medicine, healthcare, marketplaces, labor platforms, or international expansion is a plus.

Why Roo

• Lead marketing for Roo's first international markets and shape how Roo grows around the world.

• Build the launch playbook Roo uses for every new country.

• Work across strategy, messaging, acquisition, and brand, with the support of Roo's central marketing teams.

• Help veterinary professionals find flexible, meaningful work and help hospitals get the support they need.

• Partner closely with an ambitious leadership team that values first-principles thinking, ownership, and continuous improvement

While we are a remote first company, if you are based in San Francisco this will be a hybrid role.

Please see below for compensation ranges based on our geographical tiering system recommended by external benchmark data (with example cities listed).

Note: We’ve recently been made aware of a job scam where scammers are posing as Roo employees and conducting fake text interviews. Please note that any communication from @lifeatroo.com is not legitimate. All official Roo communication will always come from @roo.vet.

Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

Tier 1 Pay Range (examples: San Francisco, NYC)

$160,000—$220,000 USD

Tier 2 Pay Range (examples: LA, Boston, Seattle, DC, San Diego, Chicago)

$145,000—$200,000 USD

$135,000—$190,000 USD

$130,000—$175,000 USD

Tier 5 Pay Range (examples: Madison, Birmingham, San Antonio, Spokane, Toronto)

$120,000—$165,000 USD

Core Values

Our Core Values are what shape us as an organization and we're looking for people who exhibit the same values in their professional life; Bias to Urgency, Drive Measurable Impact, Seek Understanding, Solve Customer Problems and Have Fun!

What to expect from working at Roo!

For permanent, full time employees, we offer:

• Accelerated growth & learning potential.

• Stipends for home office setup, continuing education, and monthly wellness.

• Comprehensive health benefits to fit your needs with base medical plan covered at 100% with optional premium buy up plans.

• 401K

• Unlimited Paid Time Off.

• Paid Maternity/Paternity and reproductive care leave.

• Gifts on your birthday & anniversary.

• Opportunity for domestic travel, including for regional team building events.

Overall, you would be part of a mission-driven company that will significantly empower the lives of all veterinary professionals and the health of the overall animal industry that seeks massive innovation.

We have diverse, passionate & driven team members from a variety of backgrounds, and Roo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.  We understand that your individual experience may not check every box but we still encourage you to apply even if you are not confident in every expectation listed.

About the Team

The Data Center Design team manages the delivery of comprehensive site, campus, architectural, and engineering designs across CoreWeave’s global data center portfolio. The team’s work covers the full physical planning and development of data center sites, from initial site programming and master planning through the coordinated design of single-building facilities and large-scale, multi-building campuses. This includes establishing the overall layout, building locations and orientations, land utilization, construction and capacity phasing, central plants, site access and circulation, logistics areas, stormwater management, civil works, and provisions for future expansion.

The Data Center Engineering team creates an integrated design that coordinates each data center building with power, cooling, water, telecommunications, controls, life-safety, security, and other shared infrastructure systems. The team is also responsible for the comprehensive design of the buildings and their supporting systems and equipment, including architecture, structure, building envelope, mechanical systems, electrical infrastructure, plumbing, controls, fire protection, and life-safety systems. The team coordinates the full design lifecycle from early-stage site planning and project definition through detailed design, construction, commissioning support, and IT deployment. It makes sure CoreWeave’s technical requirements are built into each project and delivered in line with established scope, schedule, budget, quality, reliability, scalability, and operational expectations. Through disciplined leadership, multidisciplinary design coordination, and consistent execution, the team enables CoreWeave to rapidly and reliably expand its physical infrastructure to support next-generation, high-density compute workloads.

We are seeking an accomplished and experienced Director of Data Center Engineering to lead CoreWeave’s multidisciplinary team of engineering subject matter experts and set the technical direction for our global data center portfolio. This person will develop, maintain, and govern CoreWeave’s Basis of Design, reference designs, engineering standards, and long-term design roadmap for future data centers. As a senior leader within the Data Center Design organization, the Director will serve as the senior technical authority and escalation point for engineering decisions. They will partner with the VP of Design and cross-functional teams, including Design Management, Data Center Technology, Capacity, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, Network Engineering, and Supply Chain, to turn business and technology requirements into scalable infrastructure solutions.

This role requires 20% travel to various data center sites.

Key Responsibilities:

• Engineering Team Leadership & Development: Lead, manage, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team of engineering subject matter experts across mechanical, electrical, plumbing, architectural, civil, structural, controls, and other critical infrastructure disciplines. Establish clear expectations, foster accountability, and support the professional growth of the engineering team.

• Technical Strategy & Direction: Establish the technical vision and engineering strategy for CoreWeave’s global data center portfolio, ensuring infrastructure solutions align with business objectives, customer requirements, deployment timelines, and the evolving needs of high-density AI compute.

• Basis of Design Governance: Lead the development, maintenance, and governance of CoreWeave’s Basis of Design. Ensure requirements are technically sound, clearly documented, consistently interpreted, and updated to reflect lessons learned, operational feedback, technology advancements, and changing business needs.

• Engineering Design Roadmap: Develop and maintain a long-term design roadmap for future data centers, identifying the infrastructure architectures, capacity requirements, technologies, and engineering capabilities needed to support emerging compute platforms and increasing rack densities.

• Multidisciplinary Engineering Integration: Ensure mechanical, electrical, architectural, civil, structural, controls, life-safety, and other engineering disciplines are coordinated into cohesive infrastructure solutions. Partner with Data Center Technology to integrate low-voltage, structured cabling, network, and white space technology requirements.

• Partnership with Design Management: Work closely with Data Center Design Management to define technical requirements, establish design review milestones, resolve engineering issues, evaluate proposed changes, and support timely delivery of coordinated, constructible design packages.

• Design Reviews & Technical Assurance: Set expectations for technical design reviews and lead evaluations of critical drawings, specifications, calculations, equipment selections, control sequences, studies, and commissioning documentation. Ensure design risks, gaps, and interdisciplinary conflicts are identified and resolved.

• Technical Decision-Making & Escalation: Serve as the senior escalation point for complex engineering challenges and decisions. Facilitate alignment among internal subject matter experts and give the VP of Design and executive leadership clear options, risk assessments, and recommendations.

• Infrastructure Performance & Operational Feedback: Collaborate with Operations and Commissioning to review system performance, reliability events, commissioning findings, capacity limitations, and operational trends. Translate findings into corrective actions and improvements to standards, reference designs, and future project requirements.

• Continuous Improvement & Lessons Learned: Establish a structured process for capturing lessons learned from design, construction, commissioning, and operations. Ensure validated improvements are incorporated into the Basis of Design, reference designs, specifications, and engineering processes.

• Innovation & Technology Evaluation: Lead the technical evaluation of emerging data center technologies, including advanced cooling, liquid cooling, power distribution, energy storage, controls, modular infrastructure, and other systems supporting high-density compute. Develop recommendations for testing, standardization, and deployment at scale.

• Reliability, Efficiency & Sustainability: Drive engineering initiatives that improve infrastructure reliability, energy and water efficiency, sustainability, scalability, maintainability, and total cost of ownership without compromising performance or deployment speed.

• Codes, Standards & Compliance: Ensure engineering requirements and designs comply with applicable codes, regulations, safety requirements, contractual obligations, and recognized industry standards. Stay aware of regulatory and technical changes that could affect CoreWeave’s portfolio.

• External Partner & Supplier Engagement: Provide technical direction to data center providers, A/E consultants, contractors, equipment manufacturers, and technology partners. Set clear engineering expectations and evaluate proposed solutions for compliance with CoreWeave’s requirements.

• Equipment Strategy & Standardization: Collaborate with Supply Chain and Construction to define technical requirements for major infrastructure equipment, evaluate vendor solutions, support product qualification, and identify opportunities for standardization and strategic procurement.

• Engineering Resource Planning: Manage engineering resources across the project portfolio, balancing project demands, standards development, technical initiatives, and operational support. Identify capability gaps and develop hiring, consultant, or vendor strategies.

• Executive & Portfolio Reporting: Give the VP of Design and executive leadership clear reporting on engineering priorities, technical risks, major decisions, roadmap progress, resource needs, and initiatives affecting portfolio performance.

• Culture of Technical Excellence: Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, technical rigor, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement within the engineering team. Encourage subject matter experts to challenge assumptions, develop scalable solutions, and maintain a high standard of engineering quality.
