jobs.title: Staff Data Platform Software Engineer - veza
jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate Staff Software Engineer to join Veza's Graph Data Platform team. You will play a key role in designing, improving, and maintaining the robust and scalable code behind the Veza Access Graph, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to shape the future of our products and deliver exceptional identity and access management experiences to our customers. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the growth and success of a high-impact team while working on cutting-edge technologies.

What You Will Do

Technical Leadership

• Act as the technical expert for the Veza Access Graph, identifying broad challenges — technical, functional, or business — and parsing them into initiatives the org can execute against
• Solve complex problems with no established precedent in the org or the field, from architecture through implementation
• Serve as the dependable subject-matter expert (SME) for your area; define coding standards and engineering best practices for the team
• Identify opportunities to simplify systems, reduce redundancy, and drive large-scale simplification across the platform
• Deliver significant direct technical contributions while independently driving workstream-level design reviews
• Set the bar for code quality, testing, documentation, and support — and share best practices with teammates in a consumable format

Roadmap & Execution

• Set roadmap and prioritization for workstreams in your area; drive planning, design, and delegation of key components to ICs and stakeholders
• Identify gaps, dependencies, and unresolved problems; partner with customers and stakeholders to close them
• Proactively refine technical requirements in alignment with key stakeholders
• Operate autonomously, consistently delivering high-quality work on time

Collaboration & Mentorship

• Break complex roadmaps into clear workstreams, milestones, and timelines, driving alignment and buy-in across PMs, TPMs, EMs, TLs, ICs, and dependency teams
• Represent your team's roadmap and dependencies in company-wide initiatives
• Coach and mentor team leads and ICs; help define interview loops, identify talent gaps, and build coaching plans to close them
• Drive collaboration, conflict resolution, and stakeholder buy-in to unblock projects and ensure successful delivery
• Model ServiceNow's core values and contribute feedback to improve team culture

• 10+ years of professional backend software development experience, with a focus on scalable distributed systems, data management, identity, security, or related domains
• Distributed systems fundamentals — consistency models, partitioning/sharding, replication, consensus, failure modes at scale
• Graph database internals — traversal algorithms, query planning/optimization, indexing strategies (not just querying an existing graph API)
• Go at a systems-programming level — concurrency patterns, memory/performance tuning, and production experience building and testing backend services
• Large-scale data modeling — schema design for graphs handling high cardinality/fan-out
• Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs in microservice architectures
• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization / orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
• Familiarity with caching mechanisms in distributed systems
• Track record of technical decisions with org-wide blast radius — not just execution within an assigned mandate
• Experience setting technical direction or standards adopted by multiple teams
• Systems design for correctness and rollback safety in high-stakes infrastructure (access/identity data qualifies)
• Fluency with AI-assisted engineering — using LLM-based tools (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate design exploration, code review, debugging, and documentation, while knowing when to trust generated output versus verifying it against source, tests, or runtime behavior

Nice to have:

• Storage engine or query engine experience — having built or deeply modified one (Neo4j internals or a comparable engine)
• Deep knowledge of relational algebra and graph algorithms, with experience across OLTP and OLAP systems
• Track record of using AI tools to multiply personal and team output on complex, large-codebase work — beyond autocomplete-level usage
• Identity and access management concepts (RBAC/ABAC, permission graphs, entitlement modeling)
• Security or compliance-adjacent engineering background
• Graduate degree

You Are:

• A rigorous problem-solver who instinctively verifies assumptions rather than guessing — you dig into logs, code, and system behavior before proposing a fix, and you're comfortable being wrong in public if it gets the team to the right answer faster.
• Someone who thrives with ambiguity: you can take a vague mandate ("make the graph queries faster," "harden this for scale") and turn it into a scoped plan with clear tradeoffs, then execute it independently — while knowing exactly when to loop others in.
• A systems thinker who considers blast radius and reversibility before making changes to critical infrastructure — especially in a domain like ours, where a subtle bug in the access graph has real security consequences.
• A strong communicator who can explain why a traversal algorithm is O(n²) to another engineer and why that matters for customer-facing latency to a product manager — without losing precision or condescending to either audience.
• Fluent with AI as a working tool, not a crutch — you use it to move faster through exploration, boilerplate, and first drafts, but you still own the correctness of what ships, and you can tell the difference between "the model sounds confident" and "this is actually verified."
• Someone who treats AI-assisted output the same way you'd treat a junior engineer's PR — useful, often good, but reviewed with the same rigor as anything else before it touches production.
• A mentor who multiplies the team's effectiveness, not just your own — you review code like you're teaching, you pair when it helps someone level up, and you measure your impact partly by how the engineers around you grow.
• Someone who leaves things better than you found them: documentation, test coverage, runbooks, and team practices all improve because you touched them.
• Low-ego and high-trust — you can disagree strongly in a design review and still buy the team a round after it's decided.
• A pleasure to work with — even at 2am during an incident.

Role

You will provide shared legal operations support across multiple teams, partnering with legal, finance, business development, and operations stakeholders to streamline contracting workflows, improve legal technology and processes, and establish scalable operational practices.

You will oversee contract lifecycle management (CLM), legal technology, outside counsel billing, budgets, and knowledge management. A key focus of this role will be identifying opportunities to leverage AI and automation to improve legal operations, reduce manual processes, and drive operational efficiency.

You will identify opportunities to standardize processes across teams while accommodating the distinct business needs of each organization. You are an independent thinker who demonstrates initiative, sound judgment, and exceptional attention to detail.

Partner with legal and cross-functional stakeholders to drive responsible AI adoption and scalable processes.

• Cross-Functional Operations. Partner with legal, finance, business development, revenue, marketing, and compliance stakeholders across participating organizations to develop scalable operational processes and support business growth.

jobs.description:
This role requires a hybrid schedule and will be based in our New York, NY office (Tuesday through Thursday) and work fully remotely on Mondays and Fridays each week.

This role is not open to visa sponsorship or transfer of visa sponsorship including those on H1-B, F-1, OPT, STEM-OPT, or TN visa, nor is it available to work corp-to-corp.

TPG sells a wide set of media tactics to a small set of high-value partners, and today the price of any given tactic is set more by history and negotiation than by what the tactic actually delivers. This role fixes that. You will own the pricing & yield system for TPG Media: what every tactic is worth, what range a seller can work within, what a given partner and situation justifies, what margin the business needs to clear on the way through, monitoring how tactics are pacing to delivery, and understanding the full scope of our inventory. You will also build the reporting that makes all of it provable, so pricing decisions are defended with data instead of precedent.

This is a high-leverage seat for someone who wants their analysis to change what the company charges, not sit in a deck. You will work daily with sales, partner analytics, finance and the solutions team, and your outputs go straight into live partner negotiations.

You are the analytical force behind pricing. Director of FP&A will underwrite your recommendations and help influence internal stakeholders: how to frame a recommendation so it lands, how to bring a seller along instead of blocking them, and how to hold a position in a room of senior stakeholders.

For The Points Guy website click here. Curious how The Points Guy fits into Red Ventures? Click here.

What You’ll Do:

• Pricing: set and maintain pricing for every media tactic and every partner, own a defined price range for each tactic, work with sales teams to scope discounting, and keep pricing aligned to TPG’s broader strategy.

• Performance: track performance across tactics to feed into the pricing work of what each tactic is actually worth, track the true costs of each tactic, and run. industry/competitive pricing analyses to understand how we compare with other publishers.

• Forecasting: maintain the media revenue forecast, keep pipeline tracking honest, and help teams with data hygiene in Boostr.

• Reporting: stand up reporting so we are able to see performance by campaign, solution, and partner.

What We’re Looking For:

• 2 to 5 years of experience managing RevOps, Pricing, or Yield

• Experience forecasting revenue off a sales pipeline, and the discipline to hold deal-stage data to a standard when the people entering it are busy closing.

• Ability to collaborate across sales and analytics teams and be a strong voice in the room.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

We’re seeking a Senior Enterprise AI Automation Engineer to play a key role in executing Crusoe’s 2026 Enterprise AI Strategy. In this role, you will design and build agentic AI systems that move the organization from simple information retrieval to orchestrated, multi-system automation.

You’ll operate at the intersection of AI, enterprise systems, and integration platforms—building scalable agent workflows, enabling a citizen developer ecosystem, and establishing the technical foundations for an AI-powered operating model.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Designing and implementing agentic AI workflows using a modular, API-first architecture across platforms such as Workato ONE, Anthropic Claude, and Gemini.

 - Building autonomous agents that orchestrate workflows across enterprise systems (e.g., Salesforce, Coupa, Slack, Google Workspace)

 - Designing deployment pipelines and lifecycle management systems for AI agents in production environments

 - Mentoring internal teams through code reviews, training, and technical enablement programs

 - Evaluating emerging AI technologies and prototyping next-generation capabilities to advance agentic maturity



What You'll Bring to the Team:

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Enterprise Brain
jobs.description:
About Glean:

Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles.

At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level.

Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality.

If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company.

About the Role:

Glean is seeking a few Machine Learning engineers who want to focus on a combination of Quality and traditional ML work to help us build the Enterprise Brain. The Enterprise Brain team is developing a suite of proactive AI products that aims to revolutionize enterprise workflows by proactively detecting and automating tasks for users - thus unlocking true productivity. This is built on top of a deep user understanding and state of the art Enterprise graph. The project involves using both LLM and other advanced ML techniques, agent orchestration and cutting-edge ranking techniques.

You will:

• Work on deeply challenging ML problems involving user understanding and task prediction.

• Invent new LLM workflows and signals to improve reasoning, planning, and personalization.

• Design and optimize reinforcement learning and fine-tuning approaches to improve the quality of understanding, prediction and other agentic systems.

• Lead development of scalable evaluation, benchmarking, and optimization loops.

• Build and maintain robust ML pipelines for enterprise and knowledge graph construction.

• Drive initiatives to measure, monitor, and improve data quality, model quality, and end-to-end system performance.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deeply understand customer pain points and deliver high-quality, production-ready ML solutions.

• Mentor junior engineers or learn from experienced ones in a tight-knit, high-velocity environment.

About you:

• You bring 6+ years of industry experience in machine learning engineering.

• You hold a BA/BS in computer science, math, sciences, or a related field.

• You have a proven ability to design, build, and ship production-ready models and systems.

• You bring demonstrated expertise in ML evaluation, benchmarking, and data quality.

• You are proficient in an ML framework of your choice, such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.

• You thrive in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment, turning open-ended customer and ML problems into clear priorities and production-ready solutions.

• You balance speed with quality, making pragmatic tradeoffs to deliver measurable progress without losing sight of production readiness.

Location:

• This role is hybrid (4 days a week in our Mountain View office)

Compensation & Benefits:

The standard base salary range for this position is $200,000 - $280,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused.

We’re committed to building and sustaining a diverse, inclusive workplace. We strive to attract and retain people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we do not discriminate on the basis of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

#LI-HYBRID

AI-First Mindset at Glean:

At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required.

jobs.title: Launch Manager
jobs.location: Hybrid (Boston, MA); Hybrid (HQ - San Mateo, CA)
jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

As a Launch Manager, you will turn new supply opportunities into scaled, high-value marketplace programs—from initial pilot through incubation and growth, until they become established sellers on B-Stock. Supply comes to B-Stock directly from brands and channel partners with extensive brand networks, and you’ll own these relationships post-sale. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role where you’ll partner closely with Sales, Strategy, Marketing, and Project Management to deliver successful launches and build momentum on the platform. You’ll pair strategic thinking with hands-on execution, advising brands on how to succeed on B-Stock and driving the work needed to scale their programs. You'll also build the launch engine itself, using AI to automate the repeatable parts of intake, pilot setup, and performance tracking so each new program launches faster than the last. This person reports directly to the Senior Manager, Strategy & Business Operations.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own new seller launches from opportunity intake from sales and pilot design through pilot, and initial scaling

• Drive seller growth post-launch by analyzing performance, identifying opportunities, securing additional inventory, and developing high-potential sellers into meaningful B-Stock businesses for the first 6 months before passing for ongoing growth to dedicated Account Managers

• Manage partner relationships post-sale. Own the B-Stock relationship with 3PL, donation, and RMS partners as the primary commercial contact — including onboarding their brand networks, structuring programs, and resolving escalations

• Develop launch strategies including pricing, pilot parameters, and success criteria, in partnership with Sales

• Drive cross-functional execution with Sales, Strategy, Marketing, and Project Management to get new programs live quickly and resolve issues along the way

• Build and improve the playbook for launching and scaling sellers, using data, AI, and learnings from each program to make the process faster and more repeatable

• Develop deep category expertise, bringing insights on brands, inventory, pricing, buyer demand, and marketplace performance to seller strategy and growth

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS, JOB SKILLS, ABILITIES

• 5+ years of experience in implementations, early-stage customer success, strategy and business operations, or a related client success function — ideally within e-commerce, retail, or marketplace environments

• Proven record of owning outcomes across a portfolio of accounts, launches, or programs, measured on growth

• You are skilled at navigating complex, cross-functional projects and bringing together internal stakeholders across functions to drive customer success

• Ability to drive launches to completion across many stakeholders without direct authority

• You have excellent communication skills and can represent B-Stock credibly with brands and partners

• Hands-on experience applying AI within operational workflows, building automations or agentic processes that handle multi-step work like data pulls, performance reporting, or launch tracking with minimal manual oversight

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Passionate about re-commerce, the circular economy, or reverse logistics; experience in e-commerce, retail technology, or supply chain is a strong plus

• Experience working with apparel and footwear brands

• Experience launching and scaling new customer or seller programs, from initial onboarding through measurable growth

The pay rate for this role will range between $100,000 to $140,000, per annum. We consider many factors when determining salary offers, such as the applicant’s work experience, education and training, skills, market data, and internal equity.

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS

• Competitive compensation packages, including bonus and options

• Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Paid Time Off, telecommuting, and matching 401(K)

• Support for continuing education

• Team offsites, social events, and extracurricular activities are a staple

• Snacks, drinks, and the occasional box of donuts

THE COMPANY

B-Stock is the world's largest B2B re-commerce platform, connecting sellers and buyers of returned, trade-in, and overstock inventory. Our customers range from today’s top brands and retailers that want best-in-class inventory resale management to tens of thousands of entrepreneurs looking to purchase valuable merchandise for their resale businesses.

While the amount of returned and overstock inventory continues to grow, there is also growing pressure on retailers and consumers to adopt a more circular economy and keep products in use as long as possible. Accordingly, the need for re-commerce solutions - to find products a second life - has never been greater! At B-Stock we’re proud to play a large part in powering resale, reuse, and the circular economy through our platform: annually we sell over 130 million items across all categories and conditions, equating to 400 million pounds of inventory.

We believe there is tremendous value in and demand for this inventory - no matter the category, condition, or location. With hundreds of thousands transactions completed annually, B-Stock gives buyers a simple and direct way to buy valuable products directly from retailers and offers sellers a technology-driven replacement for traditional resale methods, while boosting operational efficiency, recovery rates, and cycle time.

Led by eBay veterans and backed by top investors including Spectrum Equity, True Ventures, and Susquehanna Growth Equity, B-Stock shows no signs of slowing down. Our core values have shaped the company we are today and will continue to drive our success for many years to come.

For more information, visit bstock.com/careers/

OUR VALUES

Make Each Dollar Count
Whether it’s the recovery amount or a buyer’s budget, money matters to all of our clients. And because each dollar matters to them, it matters to us.

Take Our Work Seriously, Not Ourselves
Everything at B-Stock continues to grow - everything but our egos, that is. We’re not afraid to let loose and laugh (often at ourselves).

Do The Hard Things Today That Will Pay Off Tomorrow
We’re willing to sacrifice and endure, fail and adapt to reach our long-term goals.

Use Trust As The Best Measure Of Success
The trust we earn along the way is more valuable than money. Without trust from both our buyers and sellers, our business won’t succeed.

Find Strength In Numbers
Use our passion for data to provide value to our customers, improve ourselves, and develop new ways to delight our buyers and sellers.

No applicant will face discrimination/harassment based on race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination/harassment based on “protected categories,” B-Stock also strives to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (e.g., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at B-Stock.

Work Authorization required.

Why this role is on the menu

The CX Vendor Manager leads the performance and continuous improvement of Instacart's outsourced Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) network, and builds and manages a team of Associate Vendor Managers to do it. This role is critical to ensuring consumers, shoppers, and retailers receive world-class support through a scalable global network of Customer Service Representatives. As a subject matter expert in vendor management, you will lead complex programs across the CX Organization, contribute to the Vendor Management team's strategy, and act as a thought partner to leaders across the company. The role is fast-paced and data-driven, and calls for someone who can make tough, well-informed decisions, think long-term, and develop people while delivering measurable outcomes.

About the Team

The CX Shopper Pillar team at Instacart is dedicated to providing the best possible customer experience. We are passionate about understanding customer needs and using data-driven insights to improve processes and drive innovation. We work collaboratively across the organization to ensure our customers have a seamless and enjoyable experience with Instacart.

What you'll cook up in your first year

People Leadership

• Manage, coach, and develop a team of Associate Vendor Managers, including goal setting, regular feedback, performance reviews, and career growth.

• Support hiring, onboarding, and succession planning for the Vendor Management team.

• Allocate work and priorities across the team to balance vendor coverage, project delivery, and individual development.

Strategy

• Apply broad expertise to help set functional objectives and roadmaps, weighing both known and intangible factors to make sound, long-term decisions.

jobs.title: Director of Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
ABOUT HONEYDEW

No one should suffer from a treatable skin disease because they couldn't access care. That's what Honeydew is fixing — a platform connecting hundreds of millions of people to licensed dermatologists, FDA-approved treatments, and ongoing skin health support. We've helped 50,000+ patients get life-changing results, we're growing 4x YoY, and we're just getting started.




THE OPPORTUNITY

Honeydew is growing rapidly, and paid media is a core part of our growth engine. Meta, Google, TikTok, a growing roster of creator and influencer partners, and an in-house creative team are all part of an high-performance operation.



We’re hiring a Director of Performance Marketing to own this engine end to end. You’ll manage an eight-figure budget, and you’ll have real autonomy to put it wherever the returns are greatest. You’ll report to and work directly with the Head of Growth, as well as CEO and CFO on strategy and targets.



A lot is already built around you. An in-house creative team (strategy, production, editing) that briefs, makes, and iterates on the assets you’ll need. A partnerships leader who runs celebrity, creator, and influencer relationships and keeps talent and content flowing. A paid search lead and paid social coordinator who will report to you. Your job is to increase our rate of growth by deciding where dollars go, what gets tested, and where the results take us next.



One thing to know going in: we advertise prescription treatments. Every paid platform has health restrictions, and tracking is HIPAA-adjacent. If you’ve bought in a regulated category, that’s a real advantage. If you haven’t, you’ll need to find the constraint interesting rather than annoying.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - Spend allocation & buying. You'll be accountable for paid social & search spend and strategy on day one, and you've personally run meaningful budgets on several platforms. You have an excellent understanding of what the platform automations and when to override them

 - Measurement. ROAS and CAC by channel, multi-touch attribution, media mix modeling, incrementality and geo holdout tests, and the responsibility to know when each one is lying.

 - CRO and Digital Product.  You'll work with our designers and engineers to customize sleek onboarding experiences for the different channels your audiences reach.

 - New channels. Testing and launching platforms we're not on yet, and buying on them yourself before we hire for them.

 - The creative testing loop. What gets tested, when and how, and what the results tell the creative team to make next.

 - The team. You'll manage our paid search lead and paid media coordinator and be responsible for their development. Both are high performing and ready for more scope.

 - Data, tracking, and privacy. Our marketing data pipelines, conversion tracking, and privacy and consent platform, so the numbers hold up and we stay compliant.

 - Paid media strategy. Budget planning, forecasting, channel mix, and the case for what we should and shouldn't be doing.



You'll be measured on blended CAC at target new patient volume.




THROUGHOUT 2027, YOUR WORK WILL INCLUDE:

 - Launching new channels: connected TV, a bigger TikTok presence, affiliate, programmatic, and in-app inventory

 - Rebuilding spend allocation around incrementality rather than platform-reported ROAS

 - Leveling up tracking and measurement so it survives consent changes and finance trusts it

 - Partnering closely with the creative team on testing

 - Hiring and leveling up the team to match the channel mix




WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You're probably 7 to 10 years in. You've led performance marketing at a fast-growing D2C company (Series B to D is the sweet spot), or you've done it for several at an agency and want to own one business in-house. You've bought across the major performance channels: social, search, CTV, programmatic, display. You're extremely analytical and you understand the whole funnel, from first impression to a patient starting treatment, and you make spend decisions with all of it in view. You can explain a complicated call to a founder or a CFO in plain language.



Nice to haves: healthcare, telehealth, or subscription experience; CTV, programmatic, or affiliate buying; server-side tracking and consent management setup.




THIS PROBABLY ISN'T THE ROLE FOR YOU IF:

 - You want to set strategy and have someone else run the accounts

 - You've only ever bought on one platform

 - You need a mature data team to get an answer




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Salary: $170,000-$200,000 based on experience

 - Equity in Honeydew

 - Flexible PTO

 - Free Honeydew membership

 - Health, vision, and dental insurance

 - 401(k) with company match

 - One Medical, Kindbody, Talkspace, and HealthAdvocate memberships

 - Company MacBook + monthly internet stipend

Recognized by Fast Company as #32 on the Top Workplaces for Innovators, we're proud to be Great Place to Work® certified and home to a dynamic team of technologists, product innovators, and business leaders who are passionate about solving meaningful challenges at scale.

If you’re inspired to dream big, innovate fast, and make a difference, we’d love to hear from you! For more information, visit www.newsbreak.com/about

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Accountant to support our General Ledger & Financial Close processes and help lead the revamp of our Order-to-Cash operations.

General Ledger & Financial Close

• Support the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, including preparation of journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, and other close activities.

• Prepare monthly and quarterly balance sheet and P&L account analysis to ensure completeness, accuracy, and appropriate accounting treatment.

• Support the annual financial statement audit, including preparation of audit schedules, supporting documentation, and responses to auditor requests.

Revenue Operations & Order-to-Cash

• Support the revamp of the end-to-end order-to-cash (O2C) process, identifying process gaps, control weaknesses, and opportunities for automation and scalability.

• Partner with cross-functional teams to streamline processes from contract execution through billing, collections, cash application, and revenue recognition.

• Evaluate and improve the use of systems such as NetSuite and other tools to automate manual processes and improve data accuracy.

• Develop and maintain appropriate controls over the O2C process to minimize billing errors, revenue leakage, and operational risks.

• Lead or support system enhancements, integrations, and automation initiatives related to billing and revenue operations.

• Monitor revenue performance and develop revenue projections and forecasting models in partnership with FP&A and business stakeholders.

• Analyze actual revenue versus forecast, identify key drivers and variances, and provide insights to support management decision-making.

• Own or support sales commission tracking and reconciliation, including monitoring commission calculations, identifying discrepancies, and partnering with Finance to ensure accurate and timely reporting.

• Ability to propose and implement scalable processes and documentation to support new products, pricing models, commercial structures, and business growth.

Required

• CPA is a plus

• 4 or more years of experience in a finance-related or similar business role

• Prior experience in big4 or accounting firm is helpful

• Experience creating financial and operational models

• Proficient in using PowerPoint to communicate recommendations to team members and partners

• Experienced with NetSuite and AI tools

jobs.title: Staff Applied Scientist
jobs.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team:

Upstart’s Unsecured Underwriting Machine Learning team develops and improves the models that inform credit decisions for our unsecured lending products. The team conducts machine learning research, evaluates model performance, and partners closely with Engineering teams to translate promising ideas into scalable  model improvements.

As an Applied Scientist, you will research and implement enhancements to Upstart’s core unsecured underwriting model. Your work will directly influence credit decisioning and help the team increase the pace of research while maintaining the rigor, reliability, and responsible oversight required of production underwriting models.

As an Applied Scientist in the Unsecured Underwriting Machine Learning team at Upstart, you will:

• Research machine learning and statistical approaches that improve the predictive performance of unsecured underwriting models.

• Design, implement, and evaluate model enhancements using rigorous experimentation and validation methods.

• Analyze model performance and downstream effects to confirm that proposed changes improve decisioning reliably.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Finance Analyst
jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are coming together with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together we're building the data infrastructure layer that moves, transforms, and adds context to data — from the moment it lands to the point where teams and AI systems depend on it.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products our customers know and trust. It's a good time to join a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work.

About the Role

Product Finance covers two things: how our products perform, and what they cost to build, run, and support. This role owns the cost and investment side, as the finance partner to the Product and Customer Support organizations.

You'll own the operating expense P&L for both organizations — headcount and hiring plans, vendor and program spend, annual planning, monthly close, and budget-vs-actuals — and work with those leaders on where to spend and what to trade off.

You'll also build our view of product investment at the portfolio level: what we spend behind each product line, what it returns, and what that means for how the roadmap gets funded. That includes bringing cost of revenue and unit economics into the picture, so we can talk about product margin rather than just product spend. This is how we'll decide where to invest and where to pull back.

You'll build our cost-to-serve view as well — support cost by account and segment, and the economics of deflection and AI-assisted support.

Expect close work with Product Managers, Support and Engineering leaders, Pricing, Corporate FP&A, and Accounting, and regular exposure to senior leadership as we scale toward public company readiness.

This is a full-time, hybrid position based in our Denver, CO office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

What You'll Do

• Serve as the finance business partner to Product and Customer Support leadership — own their budgets, partner on spend decisions, and flag risks, trade-offs, and reallocation opportunities early.

• Own the annual operating plan for both organizations, including headcount and hiring plans, vendor and program spend, and quarterly reforecasts.

• Own monthly close, accruals, and variance analysis — budget vs. actuals with clear driver explanations and forward-looking implications.

• Build the portfolio view of product investment: what we spend behind each product line, what it returns, and what that implies for roadmap funding and resource allocation.

• Bring cost of revenue and product unit economics into that view, working with the teams that own the underlying cost data.

• Build cost-to-serve analytics — support cost by account and segment, and the economics of deflection and AI-assisted support.

• Build business cases for new product investments and major roadmap decisions, including the economics of retiring or consolidating products, and provide Pricing with the unit economics behind packaging and monetization changes.

• Co-own the Product Monthly and Quarterly Financial Reviews with the product top-line lead, so cost and performance are presented together.

• Improve how this work gets done — better data models, less manual assembly, and AI applied to recurring analysis.

What We're Looking For

• 4+ years in FP&A, strategic finance, product finance, investment banking, or consulting, including ownership of a model or forecast that others relied on.

• Experience owning an operating expense budget, or partnering with a non-finance organization on its spend.

• Strong modeling skills across both driver-based revenue forecasts and operating expense and headcount models.

• Working knowledge of software and subscription economics — ARR, NRR, ARPA, expansion, gross margin — ideally in a usage-based business.

• Comfort working directly with large and complex datasets. SQL proficiency strongly preferred.

• Ability to turn analysis into a clear recommendation and present it to Product, Support, and senior leadership.

• Interest in how software gets built and what it costs to run.

Nice to Have

• Product or Engineering finance partnership at a software, data infrastructure, or developer tools company.

• Hands-on product margin, cost of revenue, or cost-to-serve analysis.

• Experience supporting a Customer Support, Services, or other cost-to-serve organization.

• Usage-based pricing, packaging, or monetization modeling.

• Planning and BI tools (Pigment, Looker, Tableau, Sigma) and lightweight automation in Python or SQL.

• Experience through a period of rapid scaling or IPO preparation.

HeyMilo Labs is looking for experienced product managers to participate in paid, recorded conversations with other product professionals. You’ll discuss product decisions, debate priorities, and explain how you weigh customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints.

These conversations will help train and evaluate AI systems.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Discuss product discovery, strategy, prioritization, roadmaps, launch decisions, and success metrics.

Professional acting experience is optional. Domain expertise and conversational ability are essential.

Following an initial screening, selected applicants will be invited to a paid, recorded conversation with another product professional who has a similar background. You’ll discuss a topic within your shared expertise, debate possible decisions, and challenge each other’s reasoning.


COMPENSATION AND RECORDING

Pay is $40–$100 per hour. The rate, expected time commitment, and recording-use and licensing terms will be shared before you accept an assignment. Recordings may be licensed to AI developers for training and evaluation under the agreed terms.

Share your product management background, product areas, availability, time zone, and spoken languages.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Initiatives - Special Projects
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.



If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.



About the Role:

As a Senior Manager on the Strategic Initiatives team, you'll work directly with the President/CSO and other leaders to help Crusoe make big decisions quickly, then make them happen. Our executives face questions like: What’s the right ownership structure for any given asset? How much of our data center supply chain should we build ourselves? How should we enter a new country? You'll take these questions, gather the facts and the right people, write a clear recommendation, and push for a decision. When the answer is "go," you'll often lead the work yourself until it has a permanent owner. The job is a blend of high-level strategic thinking, analysis, and writing, cultivating relationships with internal and external partners, and running mission critical projects. We’re looking for the rare candidate that’s as comfortable on a job site or factory floor as they are in the boardroom. Crusoe Spark, our modular data center business, started as a program on this team.



What You'll Be Working On:

 - Recommendations to executives: Define each decision up front: who makes it, what the options are, and what has to be true for each option to work. Work with stakeholders across product, engineering, and finance to write short memos that cover the background, financial analysis, options, tradeoffs, and your recommendation, backed by a model with unit economics, scenarios, and capacity plans.

 - Launching new programs: turn approved recommendations into programs with goals, milestones, a budget, an executive sponsor, and a working team. Run pilots that test the riskiest assumptions, and at each checkpoint recommend whether to scale up, change course, or stop. Coordinate engineering, finance, legal, real estate, and outside partners until the program is ready to hand to a business unit leader, along with a written plan, metrics, and a list of open risks.

 - Special projects for the President's office: Lead projects that no single team owns or that cross business units, Support the President on leadership meetings, board and investor materials, international expansion, and deal evaluations, and screen incoming requests to the office. Pitch in wherever needed



What You'll Bring to the Team:

 - 7–10 years in management consulting, corporate strategy, investment banking, private equity, or a strategy or chief of staff role at a fast-growing infrastructure, energy, or technology company. That should include meaningful time at an operating company, not only in advisory work.

 - Strong writing for senior leaders, such as investment memos, board materials, or strategy recommendations backed by numbers. We'll ask for a writing sample and give you a case exercise.

 - Experience taking a program from approved idea to day-to-day operation, including changing course along the way and handing it off to a permanent owner.

 - The ability to build financial models from scratch, including scenarios. You're comfortable with capital-heavy businesses: megawatts, cost per kilowatt, capex, and lead times.

 - Experience in at least one of these areas: data centers, power and energy, AI compute and cloud, or manufacturing.

 - Daily use of AI tools like Claude or Gemini for research, analysis, and writing, along with the judgment to check what they give you.



Behavioral Traits:

 - Clear writer: You can explain a complex problem in one page.

 - Ownership mentality: When a project is yours, you own all of it: the analysis, the people, the recommendation, and the result.

 - Organizational fluency: Busy teams make time for you because you make their work easier, not harder.

 - Range: in a single week, you might visit a factory floor, review a contract, and build board slides.

 - Intellectual curiosity: You want to know how a substation works and how a delay in cooling equipment changes a revenue forecast.



Bonus Points:

 - Experience preparing board or investor materials at a late-stage private company.

 - Experience launching a new product, business line, or venture, either inside a larger company or at a startup.

 - Experience with international market entry or cross-border deals, especially in Latin America or Europe. Spanish or Portuguese is a plus.

 - Experience scaling manufacturing or with lean operations.

 - An MBA or a quantitative graduate degree.



Benefits:

 - Competitive compensation and equity packages

 - Restricted Stock Units

 - Paid time off, paid holidays & leave of absence programs

 - Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance

 - Employer contributions to HSA account

 - Paid parental leave

 - Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability

 - Professional development & tuition reimbursement

 - Mental health & wellness support

 - Commuter benefits (parking & transit)

 - Cell phone stipend

 - 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary

 - Volunteer time off

 - Global travel insurance & emergency assistance

 - Daily meals allowance

 - Additional perks & programs specific to location



Compensation Range

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $175,000 - 215,000 + Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Each match is an opportunity to bring together our community, celebrating our resilience, inclusivity, and a commitment to excellence. United in professional dedication- we are two clubs with one shared vision of progress and greatness.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Manager, Marketing Automation & Operations is the technical and strategic owner of the clubs' marketing automation platform within the Lifecycle Marketing team, accountable for platform architecture, configuration, governance, deliverability, and privacy compliance across email, SMS, mobile push, in-app messaging, and paid media audiences. This person joins as the clubs complete their transition from Salesforce Marketing Cloud, supports the final cutover, and then builds the new platform into the foundation for Sounders FC and Reign FC. They build the lifecycle stage model, lead scoring, and cross-channel journeys inside the platform, turning the clubs' growth goals into always-on programs measured by the ticket, membership, and renewal revenue they drive. They partner closely with Business Intelligence (BI), which owns the clubs' data pipelines, integrations, and enterprise reporting, to define what data the platform needs, where engagement data goes, and how results are reported. Working with Lifecycle Marketing, Ticketing, Digital, IT, and other internal stakeholders, this role sets the standards that let marketers build and launch campaigns independently while protecting data integrity, brand control, and compliance across both clubs.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Platform ownership and build-out

• Serve as the primary owner and administrator of the clubs' marketing automation platform (Braze, Customer.io, or similar) for Sounders FC and Reign FC, including workspace and project structure, user roles and permissions, data schema, API keys, and integration configuration. Own platform health and roadmap, including audits, troubleshooting, feature adoption, and management of the platform vendor and implementation partners.

• Partner with the migration lead, implementation partner, and platform vendor through the final stages of the transition from Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including validating migrated audiences, journeys, and consent records during the parallel-run period, then lead the post-launch build-out.

Standards, enablement, and compliance

• Set and enforce campaign production and governance standards across both brands, including segmentation, setup, QA, launch, naming conventions, permission management, audit trails, and the campaign calendar, and serve as the escalation point for complex or revenue-critical sends.

• Partner with Marketing Managers and the Lifecycle Marketing team to build and deliver highly targeted acquisition, retention, and member programs, and train and enable marketers on both teams to build campaigns independently, including effective and responsible use of the platform's AI and automation features, through platform documentation, onboarding, and certification paths.

• Own email deliverability for both clubs, including sending domain and IP strategy, separate sender reputations per club, domain authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI), IP warming, and ongoing monitoring and remediation.

• Serve as the subject matter expert for GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM, and other applicable privacy regulations, owning compliance workflows, consent management, and suppression strategies across both clubs.

Journeys, data, and lifecycle programs

• Design, build, and maintain complex cross-channel journeys across email, SMS, mobile push, in-app messaging, and paid media audiences, including frequency and suppression rules coordinated with the Braze instance bundled with Jump for ticketing messages.

• Partner with Business Intelligence (BI), which owns the clubs' data pipelines, integrations, and reporting infrastructure, to define the platform's data requirements, including the Amperity fan ID as the primary profile key, event and attribute schemas, inbound data feeds, and engagement data returned to the data warehouse for reporting. Own data quality within the platform and partner with BI to resolve upstream issues across sources such as Jump, Salesforce, Shopify, and Fanatics.

• Lead experimentation and optimization programs, including A/B and multivariate testing, holdout groups, and incrementality measurement, and translate results into insights and recommendations for Marketing Managers.

• Build and maintain the lifecycle stage model and lead scoring logic in the platform, as defined by Lifecycle Marketing in partnership with Ticketing, including MQL definitions, score decay, routing and writeback to Salesforce CRM, and suppression of fans in active sales conversations.

Reporting, AI, and automation

• Own recurring weekly, monthly, and quarterly campaign and journey performance reporting that connects programs to ticket and membership revenue, renewals, and lifecycle stage movement, with views for each club and consolidated executive reporting.

• Configure, govern, and measure AI and machine learning features, such as send-time optimization, predictive scoring, and generative copy assistance, with brand guardrails and human approval in place, and evaluate technologies that integrate with the platform to identify automation opportunities and reduce tool overlap.

• Use AI agents for routine campaign production work, maintaining the context they rely on and reviewing output before it reaches fans.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

No specific degree is required. We hire for experience and judgment over credentials.

Required:

• 5+ years in marketing operations and automation, including 3+ years administering a marketing automation platform.

• Experience integrating a marketing automation platform with a CRM, including lead management, lead scoring, and bi-directional data sync.

• Hands-on experience with email deliverability, including domain authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) and IP warming.

• Experience running automation for two brands in one instance.

• A track record of running marketing operations work through AI agents and automation, with the context, review steps, and data guardrails to do it safely.

Preferred:

• Experience with Salesforce CRM.

• Experience with lifecycle models and audience segmentation inside a marketing automation platform.

• Experience with Customer.io, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, or Braze.

• Experience with customer data platforms such as Amperity.

• Experience with email testing tools, Google Analytics, and BI tools such as Tableau.

• Experience in sports or live events is a plus given the fast-paced, matchday-driven environment.

COMPETENCIES, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

• Energized by building: would rather design a better system than work around a broken one, and leaves every process, journey, and playbook better than they found it.

• Exceptional attention to detail and careful with data. One wrong segment or broken link can reach thousands of fans, and “it works” is not the same as “it’s safe to send.”

• Strong strategic and analytical skills; interprets campaign and revenue data and turns it into clear, actionable recommendations.

• Strong judgment; knows what matters most, when to act and when to ask, and when a result looks right but isn’t. Weighs speed against risk to fans, data, and the brand.

• Self-directed; goes looking for what needs improving rather than waiting to be assigned it.

• Takes personal ownership of what’s launched; documents it, watches how journeys and automations perform, and fixes them when they break.

• Steady under pressure: makes sound, fast calls when a critical send, deliverability issue, or data problem needs fixing against a tight timeline.

• Collaborative; builds trust with internal partners who rely on this role for their own work, and works with them to adopt shared standards.

• Clear communicator, oral and written; explains technical decisions and process to colleagues and business partners in non-technical language and adjusts to the audience.

• Comfortable with change; keeps work moving through a platform migration, shifting priorities, and incomplete information.

• Stays current on how marketing technology and AI are changing and looks to companies leading this work in other industries for practical ideas, not hype.

• Committed to principles of diversity, equity and inclusion, and to living our organizational values and mission: Create Moments, Enrich Lives, and Unify & Uplift Through Soccer.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

• This role is on-site at our Headquarters & Training Facility in Renton, WA, Monday through Thursday, with flexibility on Fridays and periodically as needed.

• Evenings, weekends, and holidays are required periodically to meet business needs, such as season requirements, campaign launches, and critical sends, and may include supporting a match.

• Must reside within Washington state upon date of hire.

• Must be able to facilitate own local travel.

• Must be eligible to work in the US without sponsorship.

COMPENSATION, BENEFITS AND PERKS

We offer competitive compensation and an engaging, supportive environment that prioritizes the health and well-being of our people.

The salary range for this position is $110,000 - $160,000. Positioning within the range at time of offer is based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, internal equity, and current market conditions.

In addition to financial compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your overall well-being and professional growth, including:

• Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: We offer 100% employer-sponsored medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your dependents. For employees enrolled in our HSA healthcare plan, we provide employer contributions to a Health Savings Account (HSA) — $1,000 per year for employee-only coverage and $2,000 per year for spouse or family coverage.

• Generous Paid Time Off & Leave: We offer unlimited paid vacation, paid company holidays, and paid sick leave in compliance with Seattle’s Paid Sick and Safe Time ordinance. We also provide paid bereavement leave and paid jury duty leave to support you during life’s critical moments.

• Retirement Planning Support: 401(k) retirement plan matching, helping you secure your financial future with ease.

• Fertility & Family-Building Support: We provide a $10,000 lifetime maximum fertility benefit through our healthcare plan to support employees in their family-building journeys. This benefit includes coverage for infertility treatment, IVF, IUI, embryo transfer, fertility preservation, and related medications.

• Inclusive Parental Leave: Our gender-neutral parental leave program provides 12–16 weeks of paid leave, inclusive of Washington Paid Family & Medical Leave (PFML), giving new parents the time and support they need during this important life stage.

• Peace of Mind Coverage: Employer-paid long-term disability coverage, as well as basic life insurance and accidental death & dismemberment (AD&D) coverage, providing financial protection and peace of mind for you and your family.

• Exclusive Perks: Enjoy complimentary tickets to matches and employer-funded ORCA cards for public transit, making it easier for you to experience the excitement firsthand.

• Continuous Growth Opportunities: We invest in your learning and development through various programs and resources.

• Community Engagement: We provide a variety of volunteer opportunities that align with our social impact goals and RAVE Foundation initiatives, empowering you to make a meaningful difference in the Seattle community.

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where every employee is respected, valued and supported. We celebrate our diverse work environment and welcome team members of all backgrounds and perspectives. To that end, if you do not meet every job requirement listed, we still encourage you to apply. We believe your relevant experience and expertise will help us become a high-performing best-in-class workplace for all. Women, gender-nonbinary, people of color, LGBTQIA+ people and people with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

The physical demands reflected in the duties and work environment herein are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. If you’d like to request an accommodation in the application or interview process, please do so by emailing the People & Culture Team.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

jobs.title: Associate Escalation Engineer
jobs.description:
Be part of the team that defends the networks the world depends on

Corelight defends the world’s most sensitive networks—from global commerce to national defense—quietly, relentlessly, and with resolve. As cyber threats grow faster and smarter, we serve as the trusted force behind network resilience, putting elite defense within reach.

By transforming digital footprints from physical, virtual, and cloud networks into actionable insights, we empower defenders to illuminate blind spots and stay ahead of an evolving threat landscape. Built on open-source innovations and fueled by industry leading agentic AI technology, Corelight helps teams to detect advanced threats and close cases with unprecedented clarity and precision.

About the Role

Corelight is looking for an Associate Escalation Engineer to join our Customer Success organization and provide technical support to customers during overnight hours. This US-based, shift-focused role is part of our expansion toward 24/7 support for Federal customers, helping troubleshoot technical issues, maintain case continuity, and ensure customers receive timely assistance outside standard business hours. In this role, you will work alongside experienced Escalation Engineers to investigate customer issues, build technical expertise, and develop hands-on experience across Linux, networking, hardware, cloud technologies, and cybersecurity.  This role is a strong fit for someone early in their technical career who enjoys solving problems, learning how systems work, and building depth in a highly technical customer environment.

This is a dedicated overnight shift position supporting our expansion to 24/7 customer support.

• Hours: Overnight coverage between 8:00 PM and 8:00 AM Eastern.

• Schedule: Potential shifts include Sunday through Thursday or Monday through Friday.

• Flexibility: Weekend and holiday coverage may be required based on business needs.

What You'll Do

• Investigate and troubleshoot customer technical issues across Corelight products, Linux systems, networking, hardware, and cloud environments.

• Support customer cases and take increasing ownership of issues as technical proficiency develops.

• Use logs, system information, network traffic, and other technical data to help identify the source of technical problems.

• Learn when and how to escalate complex issues to more experienced Escalation Engineers or Engineering.

• Provide clear and timely updates to customers and internal stakeholders on assigned cases.

• Build practical knowledge of Corelight products, Linux, networking, cloud technologies, and cybersecurity concepts.

• Document troubleshooting steps, findings, and resolutions to contribute to shared team knowledge.

• Partner with Escalation Engineering, Engineering, Product Management, Sales Engineering, and other teams to help resolve customer issues.

• Participate in team training, labs, technical projects, and continuous learning.

• Contribute to scripting, tooling, automation, and process improvements as skills develop.

What You'll Bring

• Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Networking, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent technical training.

• Foundational understanding of computer systems and how devices communicate across networks.

• Basic knowledge of networking concepts such as TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, IP addressing, and routing.

• Familiarity with Linux or UNIX systems through coursework, technical training, labs, certifications, military experience, or personal projects.

• Basic understanding of computer hardware and operating systems.

• Interest in technical troubleshooting and the ability to work methodically through unfamiliar problems.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to learn from feedback, ask good questions, and build technical proficiency quickly.

• Strong technical curiosity and interest in networking, systems, and cybersecurity.

• Exposure to scripting, packet analysis, cloud platforms, virtualization, or cybersecurity concepts is a plus.

Notice of Pay Transparency:
The compensation for this position may vary depending on factors such as your location, skills and experience. Depending on the nature and seniority of the role, a percentage of compensation may come in the form of a commission-based or discretionary bonus. Equity and additional benefits will also be awarded.

Compensation Range

$62,000—$88,000 USD

Why Join Us?

Fueled by investments from top-tier venture capital organizations such as Crowdstrike, Accel and Insight, Corelight is one of the fastest growing network detection and response platforms in the industry.  Our passionate team thrives in a collaborative, inclusive, and geographically distributed culture. We embrace diverse perspectives, neurodiversity, curiosity and low ego results - fostering an environment where every innovator can solve the toughest challenges in cybersecurity and contribute their best work.

We are looking forward to meeting you. Check us out at www.corelight.com

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity.

Our Communications team includes media relations, employee communications, community building, events, and other external-facing functions. This team’s ethos is to support OpenAI's mission and goals by clearly and authentically explaining our technology, values, and approach to safely building powerful AI.

This person will play a key role in communicating about our safety work: how we prepare, respond thoughtfully when issues arise, and continue earning people’s trust as our systems become more capable.

This person will partner across teams to shape clear, confident narratives that show our commitment to transparency and continuous improvement. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, enjoys translating complex ideas into relatable stories, and sees opportunity in helping people understand how safety and innovation work together.

jobs.description:
Position Objective:

Communicates with patients, medical staff, hospital staff and visitors in a professional manner providing excellent customer service as reflected in AAMCs policies and practices.

jobs.title: Robotics & Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT FUSE

We are building one of the most potentially consequential companies of the century. Our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to fusion energy while safeguarding humankind. This is not a normal company. This is not a normal job. We are committed for the long term to win.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for robotics engineers to stand up and grow Fuse's robotic manufacturing capability from the ground up. You will design, build, program, and deploy robotic cells that handle the full lifecycle of our pulsed-power hardware, from individual components up to our complete Impedance-Matched Marx Generator (IMG) modules. This is a hands-on, high-responsibility role: you'll select the robots, design the end-effectors and fixturing, write the control and vision software, integrate everything into a working line, and keep it running. You'll work shoulder to shoulder with our pulsed-power, mechanical, and electrical engineers to make our hardware manufacturable by robots.




WHAT WE VALUE

 - Obsess about the details — sloppy work costs us later, so do it right the first time.

 - Care — pick up the trash. Do things no one asks you to do. Go the extra mile because you care.

 - Act with urgency — every hour matters more than it feels like it does.

 - Be responsible for the outcome, not just the task; if it is not working, it remains your problem until it is fixed.

 - Assume good intent — disagree openly, then commit fully once a call is made.




CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design and deploy robotic capabilities to fabricate and assemble Fuse's core pulsed-power components, including FDGS (field-distortion gas switches), "bricks" (capacitor and switch assemblies), stages, full IMG modules, and transmission lines.

 - Build automated assembly, fastening, bonding, alignment, and handling processes for high-voltage, high-energy parts, including heavy and delicate components.

 - Develop robotic workflows for inspection, test, and preventive maintenance of fielded hardware, reducing manual intervention in high-voltage environments.

 - Design and fabricate custom end-effectors, grippers, tooling, and fixtures tailored to our components.

 - Integrate machine vision, force/torque sensing, and metrology for precise alignment, quality control, and error detection.

 - Program and integrate industrial and/or collaborative robots (arms, gantries, mobile platforms) with PLCs, motion controllers, and factory software.

 - Define the cell-level architecture, including safety systems, interlocks, material flow, and throughput, and contribute to the build-out from concept to a fully functioning production line.

 - Partner with design engineers on Design for Automated Assembly, feeding manufacturability requirements back into component design.

 - Establish maintenance, calibration, spares, and documentation practices so the automation is reliable and serviceable.

 - Help onboard new team members as the robotics team grows.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

 - Degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Controls, or equivalent hands-on experience.

 - Hands-on experience deploying robotic automation in a manufacturing or assembly environment.

 - Strong skills in robot programming and integration (e.g., FANUC, KUKA, ABB, Universal Robots, or similar) and industrial controls (PLCs, motion control, I/O, safety systems).

 - Experience designing end-effectors, fixtures, and tooling in CAD and seeing them through fabrication.

 - Working knowledge of machine vision and sensor integration for guidance and inspection.

 - Software ability (e.g., Python, C++, and/or ROS) for control, vision, and system integration.

 - Solid grasp of automation safety standards and safe design practice.

 - A builder's mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, iterating fast, and owning a system end to end in a startup.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience automating the assembly of high-voltage, high-energy, or hazardous hardware, and familiarity with the associated safety requirements.

 - Background in pulsed power, Marx generators, capacitors, high-voltage systems, or fusion/plasma hardware.

 - Experience with heavy-payload handling, precision alignment/metrology, or automated electrical/hi-pot testing.

 - Experience with mobile robots or automated maintenance/inspection in field environments.

 - Experience standing up a new automation function or production line.




ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

 - Based in or willing to relocate to our San Leandro, CA facility; this role is fully onsite.

 - Comfortable working hands-on in a lab and production environment around high-voltage and high-energy equipment, following strict safety procedures.

 - Ability to lift and maneuver equipment and tooling as needed during cell build-out and maintenance.

 - Occasional travel to other Fuse locations.




BENEFITS

 - Medical, dental, and vision coverage.

 - Relocation assistance for roles that require it.

 - Flexible time off. Take what you need, no accrual tracking.

 - 2 weeks of paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs).

 - Supportive leave of absence policies.

 - Paid leave for new parents.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

To conform to U.S. Government technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Fuse is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Fuse is governed on the basis of merit, competence, and qualifications and will not be influenced by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, ancestry, immigration status, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.
