jobs.title: TAM Director
jobs.description:
ABOUT OSCILAR

At Oscilar, we're building the most advanced AI Risk Decisioning™ Platform. Banks, fintechs, and digitally native organizations rely on us to manage their fraud, credit, and compliance risk with the power of AI. If you're passionate about solving complex problems and making the internet safer for everyone, this is your place.


WHY JOIN US?

Mission-driven teams: Work alongside industry veterans from Meta, Uber, Citi, and Confluent, all united by a shared goal to make the digital world safer.

Ownership and impact: We believe in extreme ownership. You'll be empowered to take responsibility, move fast, and make decisions that drive our mission forward.

Innovate at the cutting edge: Your work will shape how modern finance detects fraud and manages risk.


ROLE OVERVIEW

Oscilar is looking for a Director of Technical Account Management to lead and scale a high-performing team responsible for customer success, retention, expansion, and long-term value realization.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who leads through expertise, judgment, and example. You'll build a team of Technical Account Managers who operate as general managers of their portfolios — owning customer relationships, driving technical adoption, anticipating risks, identifying growth opportunities, and delivering measurable business outcomes.

Reporting to the VP of Solutions Engineering & Customer Success, you'll set the standard for technical account ownership, serve as an executive partner to our most strategic customers, and develop the team's expertise in AI-driven risk decisioning and agentic AI.

You'll also serve as a critical bridge between customers, Product, and Engineering, translating field intelligence into actionable insights that influence Oscilar's platform and product roadmap.

This role sits at the intersection of technical customer success, commercial strategy, agentic AI adoption, and product innovation. We're looking for a leader who can build an exceptional team while remaining deeply connected to customers, technology, and the outcomes that matter.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Lead, hire, and develop a high-performing Technical Account Management team, fostering a culture of extreme ownership, technical excellence, and customer accountability.

 - Empower TAMs to operate as GMs of their portfolios, independently owning customer engagement from onboarding and implementation through adoption, renewal, and expansion.

 - Own team-level performance against Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Net Revenue Retention (NRR), customer satisfaction, product adoption, and time-to-value objectives.

 - Establish clear standards for account success planning, executive engagement, customer health management, and proactive identification of retention and expansion opportunities.

 - Serve as the senior escalation point for strategic accounts, complex technical challenges, critical incidents, and high-stakes customer engagements.

 - Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, leading strategic business reviews and ensuring customers realize measurable value from Oscilar's platform.

 - Partner closely with Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Solutions Architects, and Customer Success leadership on renewal strategies, commercial expansion, and complex implementations.

 - Provide technical leadership across the TAM organization, ensuring the team can confidently navigate API integrations, SQL, Python, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise data workflows while engaging specialized engineering resources when appropriate.

 - Champion agentic AI adoption, developing the team's ability to guide customers through AI-driven automation strategies, workflow design, deployment, and ongoing optimization.

 - Build team fluency in AI agent evaluation, human-in-the-loop workflows, performance monitoring, and production governance across fraud, credit, and compliance use cases.

 - Leverage AI tools such as Claude, Cursor, GPT, or similar technologies to accelerate analysis, improve team productivity, and develop scalable customer enablement resources.

 - Act as the voice of the customer in Product and Engineering discussions, translating deployment insights, recurring challenges, and emerging customer needs into actionable roadmap recommendations.

 - Partner with Product and Engineering on beta programs, early-access initiatives, and reusable implementation frameworks that improve customer outcomes.

 - Build scalable operating processes, customer health frameworks, performance dashboards, and team development programs that enable consistent execution without sacrificing autonomy.

 - Communicate portfolio performance, renewal risk, expansion opportunities, and strategic customer insights to senior leadership.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 10+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, or related technical customer-facing roles within enterprise SaaS, fintech, or AI-driven platforms.

 - 5+ years of leadership experience, with a demonstrated ability to hire, coach, develop, and scale high-performing technical customer-facing teams.

 - Proven experience leading enterprise customer portfolios with accountability for GRR, NRR, customer adoption, retention, and expansion.

 - A track record of building teams that operate with independent account ownership, commercial accountability, and strong technical judgment.

 - Deep understanding of enterprise customer success, including executive business reviews, customer health frameworks, renewal strategy, account planning, and expansion motions.

 - Strong technical foundation across REST APIs, SQL, Python, data integrations, and cloud infrastructure(AWS, GCP, or Azure).

 - Ability to guide teams through complex customer implementations, troubleshoot technical escalations, and collaborate effectively with Solutions Architects, Product, and Engineering.

 - Familiarity with AI/ML platforms, agentic AI, or LLM-powered enterprise workflows, including their deployment, evaluation, and operational considerations.

 - Practical experience leveraging LLMs and AI tools to improve productivity, accelerate analysis, automate workflows, or solve complex business problems.

 - Strong commercial instincts and the ability to connect technical adoption and customer value realization with retention and revenue expansion.

 - Exceptional executive communication skills, with the ability to influence C-suite stakeholders and translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

 - Data-driven approach to leadership, with experience defining KPIs, tracking leading indicators, and using performance insights to guide decisions.

 - Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and translate customer insights into meaningful product, engineering, and business outcomes.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Domain expertise in fraud prevention, credit risk, identity, AML/KYC/KYB, compliance, or financial-services risk decisioning.

 - Experience at a fintech, financial institution, fraud or risk management platform, or enterprise AI company.

 - Experience deploying, supporting, or advising on agentic AI systems, AI agents, or LLM-powered enterprise workflows.

 - Familiarity with rules engines, ML-driven decisioning, case management, alert management, and risk operations.

 - Experience with customer success platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Totango, or similar tools.

 - Experience building or scaling a Technical Account Management function in a high-growth startup or scale-up environment.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Build a high-performing TAM organization where every team member demonstrates independent portfolio ownership, technical credibility, and commercial accountability.

 - Drive measurable improvements in customer retention, net revenue retention, product adoption, and time-to-value.

 - Establish strong executive relationships and proactive engagement strategies across Oscilar's most strategic customer accounts.

 - Accelerate customer adoption of AI-powered decisioning and agentic AI capabilities, translating technical innovation into measurable business value.

 - Create a structured feedback loop between customers, Product, and Engineering that meaningfully influences platform capabilities and roadmap priorities.

 - Establish scalable customer success frameworks that support Oscilar's growth while preserving the speed, ownership, and customer intimacy of a high-performing startup.


BENEFITS AND OTHER PERKS

 - Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages, including a 401(k) plan.

 - Flexibility: Remote-first culture.

 - Health: 100% employer-covered comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance with a top-tier plan for you and your dependents (US).

 - Balance: Unlimited PTO policy.

 - Culture: Family-friendly environment with regular team events and offsites.

 - Development: Unparalleled learning and professional development opportunities.

 - Impact: Making the internet safer by protecting online transactions.

jobs.title: Director of Human Resources
jobs.description:
About Gruve

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.

About the Role

The Director of Human Resources will lead Gruve’s global people function across six countries, supporting approximately 540 employees. This role will drive global HR strategy, compensation and rewards, performance management, talent acquisition, and HR operations while partnering with the CFO and executive leadership team to support the company’s growth.

The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience leading multi-country HR functions, building scalable people processes, ensuring employment law compliance, and developing high-performing teams in a fast-growing technology or IT services environment. This leader will play a key role in shaping Gruve’s organizational structure, strengthening employee engagement, and establishing consistent HR practices across global locations.

Key Responsibilities

• Set and lead Gruve's global HR strategy across the US, India, Singapore, the UAE, Korea, and Japan, aligned with business growth plans.

• Own compensation and rewards: salary bands, annual merit and promotion cycles, bonus plans, and equity guidelines, using market benchmarks for each country.

• Run the annual performance review and bonus cycle end to end, including rating calibration across leaders and pay equity reviews.

• Partner with the CFO on headcount planning, compensation budgets, and people costs.

• Build HR policies, an employee handbook, and processes that are consistent globally and compliant with local employment laws.

• Lead talent acquisition strategy with hiring managers, including job leveling, offer approvals, and onboarding.

jobs.title: Outbound Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.description:
Muck Rack is trusted by thousands of organizations around the world to understand how their brands show up across news, social media and AI-generated answers.

Our AI-powered platform connects the entire PR workflow in one place, helping communications teams manage media relationships, understand the conversations shaping their brands, take action and measure their impact. Combined with analyst-led Media Intelligence and advisory services, Muck Rack turns signals into insights and insights into action.

Founder-controlled and growing  profitably and sustainably, we have the freedom to build forward-thinking products, put our customers first, and offer an inclusive culture that welcomes diverse perspectives.

We’re growing quickly, and we’re looking for an ambitious, tech-savvy, and detail-oriented Outbound Sales Development Representative to join our team and make a big impact.

As an Outbound SDR at Muck Rack, you will work closely with our sales team to generate opportunities through outbound outreach. You should be excited about working in a fast-paced sales environment where you'll be the first "face" of Muck Rack to prospective customers, representing our team, culture, and brand.

What you’ll do:

• Build pipeline through outbound outreach — prospect leads via email, LinkedIn, and phone to consistently meet and exceed quota

• Personalize your interactions — leverage Muck Rack’s tools and prospect insights to make outreach timely, relevant, and informed from the first touch

• Prospect strategically— develop efficient, creative outreach systems tailored to target accounts, using our systems to identify patterns and prioritize who to contact and when

• Plan your day with purpose — lean on AI-assisted workflows to structure your time, stay on top of follow-ups, and keep your pipeline moving without things falling through the cracks

• Stay plugged into PR — monitor industry news to surface timely, relevant outreach opportunities

• Maintain clean CRM hygiene — keep lead records, activities, and reporting accurate and up to date in Salesforce

• Collaborate cross-functionally — partner closely with Account Executives and Marketing to align outreach efforts and drive pipeline growth

• Maintain consistent activity standards — execute against outreach expectations across segments while balancing quality personalization with high-volume prospecting

How success will be measured in this role:

• Meetings booked, held, and converted to pipeline (S2 opportunities)

• SDR-sourced revenue

If the details below describe you, you could be a great fit for this role:

• 1+ year of experience in a SaaS SDR role or 1+ year working in PR preferred— you understand either the sales motion or the buyer's world

• Highly accountable and self-motivated, with a growth mindset that welcomes feedback and coaching

• A natural relationship builder with genuine curiosity and a sales-oriented mindset

• Exceptional written communication skills — you write emails that actually get read and responses that move things forward

• Strong phone presence — you can build rapport quickly and keep a conversation going

• Ability to juggle multiple priorities in a fast-paced, startup environment without dropping the ball

• A quick study with new tools (including AI tools) — we work in Google Workspace, Salesforce, Outreach, Slack, Nooks, SalesNav, etc

• 45-minute Zoom interview with the hiring manager, including a mock cold call

• Panel interview with several members of our team

Travel & Team Engagement Expectations

This role requires up to 10% travel for team collaboration, customer engagements, and company events. As part of our commitment to building strong connections across our fully distributed team, attendance at our annual company offsite (typically held in Mexico) is expected.

Salary

In the US, the base salary for this role is $53,000, with $68,000+ in OTE. Note that we typically build 1-3 quarters of ramp time with lower goals and thus lower earnings from commissions. We take a geo-neutral approach to compensation within the US, meaning that we pay based on job function and level, not location. For all other countries, we have competitive pay bands based on market standards.

Individual compensation decisions are based on a number of factors, including experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. We recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted. If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

Remote Work, Forever

• Fully distributed team with a permanent remote setup

• Home office stipend, phone and internet reimbursement, coworking membership

• Virtual and in-person team bonding (lunches, events, competitions)

Transparent & Fair Compensation

• Competitive geo-neutral pay in the U.S.

• Annual reviews to ensure equity and market alignment

• Standardized bonus or commission structure

• 401(k) with employer contributions

• Equity opportunities

Health & Wellness

• Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance for employees and dependents

• 100% premium coverage for individuals on high-deductible plans

• 24/7 Virtual Care and Employee Assistance Program

• Employer-funded HSA contributions and other pre-tax benefits

• Quarterly wellness stipend and free Headspace subscription

Time Off & Family Benefits

• 4+ weeks of PTO, plus paid sick and mental health days

• 13 paid holidays with the option to swap for personal days

• Up to 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

Learning and Development

• Transparent pathways for internal mobility and promotion

• Bi-annual performance reviews, team workshops, and leadership training

• Unlimited access to Coursera and O’Reilly

• 2 additional PTO days annually for learning and development

Inclusive, Customer-First Culture

• Commitment to equity and valuing diverse perspectives

• Agile, founder-led company focused on collaboration and innovation

• Trusted by 3,000+ companies worldwide

Note: Benefits and compensation reflect offerings for U.S.-based employees. Support is provided for employees in other locations, in compliance with local laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Director, Head of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
jobs.location: Dallas, Texas, United States; Edison, New Jersey, United States
jobs.description:
About Gruve

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.

About the Role

The Director, Head of Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) will play a key role in shaping Gruve’s financial strategy and supporting the company’s continued growth. This role will lead budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and performance reporting across multiple business units and countries, providing leadership with clear, actionable insights to drive business performance and profitability.

As a strategic partner to the CFO and executive leadership team, the Director will translate complex financial data into meaningful recommendations, support strategic planning and resource allocation, and establish scalable financial planning processes. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical capabilities, sound business judgment, and experience operating in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment, with the ability to influence decisions and align financial performance with Gruve’s long-term business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the annual operating plan and budget process, working with business unit leaders across the US, India, and APAC.

• Own monthly and quarterly forecasting for revenue, gross margin, operating expenses, headcount, and cash.

• Build and maintain the company's financial model, including scenario and sensitivity analysis for growth, pricing, and investment decisions.

• Deliver monthly management reporting and variance analysis (budget vs. forecast vs. actuals), with clear explanations of what drove the results.

• Prepare financial materials for the CFO, CEO, board of directors, and investors, including board decks and fundraising support.

• Track and report key business metrics such as bookings, revenue by business line, customer profitability, and unit economics.

• Partner with sales, delivery, and engineering leaders on pricing, deal profitability, and resource planning for services and AI infrastructure offerings.

• Own headcount and compensation planning with HR, including salary increase and bonus budgets.

• Support multi-currency, multi-entity planning across Gruve's international subsidiaries.

• Build, lead, and mentor the FP&A team, and improve planning tools, processes, and controls as the company scales.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, economics, or a related field.

• 10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A or corporate finance, including at least 3 years leading a team.

• Proven track record owning budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning for a growing company.

• Advanced financial modeling skills in Excel or Google Sheets.

• Experience presenting financial results and recommendations to executives and boards.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain financial results to non-finance leaders.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master’s degree in Business Administration (MBA) or a professional finance certification, such as Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), is preferred.

• Experience at a venture-backed technology, IT services, or SaaS company.

• Experience with multi-entity, multi-currency planning, especially across the US and India.

• Hands-on experience with planning tools (such as Adaptive, Anaplan, or Pigment) and ERP systems such as NetSuite.

• Experience supporting fundraising, due diligence, or M&A.

Compensation and Benefits

The base salary range for this position varies by location:

• New Jersey: $175,000–$220,000 per year

• Texas (Dallas, Houston, or Austin): $160,000–$205,000 per year

The final compensation offer will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and work location.

In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for an annual performance-based bonus and stock options.

Gruve offers a benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off (PTO), and paid holidays.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PROPULSION ENGINEER – RAPTOR FINAL ASSEMBLY & TUBE SHOP

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Responsible for overseeing the build and test processes for the Raptor final assembly & Tube Shop production area

• Develop, qualify, and refine assembly processes to enable high volume production of engines

• Think creatively; question the status quo; challenge engineering and manufacturing requirements to drive efficient production of Raptor engines on schedule through collaboration with a multidisciplinary team of engineers (design, build, and reliability), internal production teams, and external vendors

• Work with design engineering to develop design and manufacturing standards that reduce final assembly burden; implement a maintainable and lasting system of reasonable and powerful requirements

• Resolve build issues, disposition nonconforming conditions, perform root cause analysis, and implement robust corrective actions

• Extreme owner oftooling design, fabrication, qualification and improvement, based on analysis and data

• Design tooling for new and existing products to support rate production

• Streamline existing production builds to minimize cost while improving quality and efficiency

• Implement standard practices, troubleshooting guides, and standard repair procedures, including review and approval of planning documents

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in mechanical, aerospace, or manufacturing engineering

• 1+ years of mechanical design and manufacturing experience from either industry or collegiate engineering projects such as Formula SAE, Baja SAE, or Design Build Fly

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience with the building and testing of fluid and electrical systems, and interpreting schematics

• Documentation and configuration management experience

• Experience writing test plans, procedures and providing go/no-go judgment and rationale

• Experience taking products through development cycle to full volume production

• Solid understanding of a variety of manufacturing processes, including machining, welding, drilling, and automation

• Ability to work with minimal supervision

• Experience with Design for Manufacturability and Assembly

• Experience with NX (UG or equivalent) CAD and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) for component and tooling design

• Process development, facility and line layouts

• Experience in process development, value stream layout, PFMEA, and error proofing

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work directly with the hardware on the floor for extended periods of time

• Position may require extended hours and weekend work

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

Level 1: $100,000.00 - $130,000.00
Level 2: $115,000.00 - $160,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Product Manager, Autonomous Cyber Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

America is under sustained cyber attack. Our adversaries infiltrate our networks, steal our IP, and degrade the digital infrastructure that modern life runs on. They’ve learned—correctly—that those attacks rarely produce consequences.

Twenty was founded to change that, by making our adversaries think twice before they attack us. Our vision is American and allied primacy in cyberspace—a future where they cannot contest us, deterrence is assured, and the free world remains secure.

Founded in 2024, Twenty Technologies (www.twenty.io http://www.twenty.io) industrializes offensive cyber operations for the U.S. and its allies. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Twenty has raised $168M from Khosla Ventures, Accel, Caffeinated Capital, Friends & Family Capital, Point72 Ventures, General Catalyst, and In-Q-Tel.

 
 
 
 
 

Mission | On Site | Full Time | U.S. Citizenship Required / No Active Clearance Required

 
 
 
 
 


ROLE SUMMARY

Twenty builds AI-enabled technology for mission-critical cyber operations. We're seeking a Senior Product Manager to shape capabilities for cyber warfare, focused on building highly autonomous capabilities employed on the nations most critical operations. You'll work closely with practitioners and engineers to understand how users execute high-stakes offensive cyber operations in support of national security objectives, then turn those needs into reliable, intuitive product experiences. You'll balance speed, accuracy, auditability, and legal frameworks while guiding product work from discovery through delivery and iteration.

 


WHO YOU ARE

 - You're fluent in some aspect of cyber related workflows, and can earn trust with security researchers, engineers, and mission-facing users.

 - You can translate complex technical problems into clear product choices and useful, intuitive experiences.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity, high accountability, and hands-on collaboration.

 - You communicate clearly and bring sound product judgment to complex technical and security tradeoffs.
   


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own discovery, roadmap, prioritization, requirements, delivery, and iteration for offensive-security and vulnerability-management capabilities.

 - Learn how practitioners conduct nation state level cyber operations; turn those workflows into clear, actionable product experiences.

 - Partner with engineers and mission-facing users to define useful findings, workflow integrations, data needs, and reliable technical behavior.

 - Make product tradeoffs across speed, usability, accuracy, auditability, and legal frameworks.

 - Set meaningful success metrics, gather user feedback, and use what you learn to improve the product.

 - Communicate product strategy, roadmap choices, and technical tradeoffs clearly to leadership and delivery teams.
   


MUST HAVE

 - Substantive experience in at least one of: offensive cyber operations (OCO), vulnerability research, attack surface management, vulnerability management, incident response, adversary hunt, cyber threat intelligence, penetration testing, or red teaming.

 - Strong product judgment and the ability to turn technical needs into user-centered product direction. Formal PM experience is helpful; demonstrable ownership and shipped outcomes matter most.

 - Ability to work credibly with engineers and practitioners on integrations, data quality, workflows, and security tradeoffs.

 - Comfort with ambiguity, high accountability, and hands-on collaboration.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with offensive-security or vulnerability-focused platforms built for expert users.

 - Exposure to vulnerability intelligence, adversary emulation, security research, or technical mission workflows.

 - Experience with 0-to-1 product development, data-rich security tools, or AI-assisted security workflows.



Benefits 
What's on the table:

 - Health. Medical, dental, and vision plan options. Life / AD&D, disability coverage options.

 - Family. Paid parental leave for eligible full-time employees. 12 weeks for birthing parents, 4 for non-birthing parents, 6 weeks for adoptive, foster, or intended parents through surrogacy.

 - Vacation. Paid holidays and flexible PTO. Take what you need.

 - Retirement. 401(k) with pre-tax and Roth options. HSA/FSA options, dependent care FSA.

Benefits vary by location, role, and eligibility. Full plan details provided during the interview and offer process.





If this role sounds like you, apply and share with us your interest

Due to U.S. government contract and security requirements, this role is limited to U.S. citizens. Some positions may also require eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance. Any active clearance requirement will be listed in the role description.

Twenty is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected status, consistent with applicable law.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, let us know and we will work with you.

jobs.title: Associate Director, IT Business Solutions
jobs.description:
Axsome Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company leading a new era in the treatment of central nervous system (CNS) conditions. We deliver scientific breakthroughs by identifying critical gaps in care and develop differentiated products with a focus on novel mechanisms of action that enable meaningful advancements in patient outcomes. Our industry-leading neuroscience portfolio includes FDA-approved treatments for major depressive disorder, agitation associated with dementia due to Alzheimer’s disease, excessive daytime sleepiness associated with narcolepsy and obstructive sleep apnea, and migraine, as well as multiple novel product candidates addressing a broad range of serious neurological and psychiatric conditions that impact over 150 million people in the United States. Together, we are on a mission to solve some of the brain’s biggest problems so patients and their loved ones can flourish. For more information, please visit us at www.axsome.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

About This Role

Axsome Therapeutics is seeking an Associate Director, IT Business Solutions to join the Information Technology team. This hands-on role requires deep cross-domain knowledge of broadly defined Corporate Systems and is responsible for both functional business and technical systems activities.

The incumbent will partner closely with business stakeholders and IT teams to enhance technology solutions by translating high-level epics and user stories into actionable product backlogs, supporting testing efforts, and serving as a project lead or subject matter expert as needed. This individual will also manage select escalated post-implementation support issues and coordinate vendor engagement when appropriate to ensure timely and effective issue resolution. Leveraging strong domain and systems expertise, the Senior Manager will identify and drive opportunities for business transformation through system enhancements, process simplification, and governance initiatives that improve operational efficiency and business outcomes.

This role is based at Axsome’s HQ in New York City with an on-site requirement of at least three days per week. We are unable to consider candidates who are looking for fully remote roles.

jobs.title: Operations Manufacturing Test Lead
jobs.description:
JOIN THE TEAM BRINGING ADVANCED AUTONOMY TO THE BUILT WORLD

At Bedrock, we're moving AI out of the lab and into the real world. Our team includes veterans who helped launch Waymo, scaled Segment to a $3.2B acquisition, and grew Uber Freight to $5B in revenue. Today, we're deploying autonomous systems on heavy construction equipment across the country, improving safety on job sites and accelerating schedules on critical infrastructure projects.

We're not here debating the future of AI. We're deploying it in the real world. In just two years, we've raised $350M and achieved the first fully autonomous excavator deployments in construction.

This is where algorithms meet steel-toed boots. You'll work alongside construction veterans and world-class engineers to solve physical-world problems that simulations can't touch. If you're ready to do meaningful work on hard problems, we'd love to have you join us.



Role Overview:
We are looking for a Manufacturing Test Engineer to design, build, and scale robust test systems that ensure product quality from early hardware development through high-volume manufacturing and fleet deployment.

This role sits at the intersection of hardware engineering, manufacturing, and quality—owning test strategy, infrastructure, and execution to catch design, process, workmanship, and component-level issues before products reach the field.

You will develop automated, data-driven test frameworks and diagnostic systems that enable fast bring-up, high coverage, and scalable production operations.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Test Strategy & Framework Development

 - Define end-to-end manufacturing test strategy across EVT, DVT, PVT, and production

 - Develop scalable hardware test frameworks covering functional, system-level, and end-of-line testing

 - Architect modular test systems that can evolve from prototype builds to high-volume manufacturing

 - Establish test coverage goals to ensure detection of:
   
   - Design defects
   
   - Component quality issues
   
   - Manufacturing process variation
   
   - Workmanship defects

2. Test Development & Automation

 - Design and implement functional test systems (electrical, mechanical, system-level validation)

 - Develop automated test scripts and sequences using Python or similar languages

 - Integrate test equipment (DAQs, sensors, vision systems, robotics interfaces, etc.)

 - Build diagnostic tools to quickly isolate failures and reduce debug time

 - Enable data logging, traceability, and test result analytics

3. Work Order & Manufacturing Execution Integration

 - Configure and manage work orders and test flows within MES or manufacturing systems

 - Define test steps, pass/fail criteria, and routing logic across stations

 - Ensure traceability of test results to serial numbers, components, and build configurations

 - Partner with manufacturing teams to optimize throughput and minimize test time

4. Product & Manufacturing Line Bring-Up

 - Lead test bring-up for new products during EVT/DVT/PVT builds

 - Support factory ramp by deploying and validating test stations on production lines

 - Debug early build issues and rapidly iterate on test coverage and methods

 - Train operators and technicians on test processes and troubleshooting

5. Diagnostics & Failure Analysis

 - Develop structured diagnostic workflows to identify root causes of failures

 - Partner with hardware, firmware, and quality teams on root cause analysis (RCA)

 - Differentiate between design issues, supplier defects, and manufacturing errors

 - Implement containment actions and feed improvements back into test and design

6. Reliability & Sustaining Test

 - Design and execute ongoing reliability and stress testing (burn-in, environmental, lifecycle)

 - Monitor failure trends and adjust test strategies to catch emerging issues

 - Ensure alignment between validation testing and production test coverage

7. Test Coverage & Continuous Improvement

 - Define and track test coverage metrics and escape rates

 - Continuously improve test effectiveness to reduce field failures and returns

 - Optimize test time, cost, and efficiency without compromising quality

 - Drive improvements in first pass yield (FPY) through better detection and diagnostics

8. Data, Automation & Scaling

 - Build systems for automated data collection, analysis, and reporting

 - Leverage scripting and software tools to streamline test development and execution

 - Implement scalable solutions that support multi-line, multi-site manufacturing

 - Utilize advanced tools (including AI Agents/ML where applicable) for:
   
   - Anomaly detection
   
   - Failure classification
   
   - Predictive insights on test and field data




KEY REQUIREMENTS:

 - Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or related field

 - 5+ years of experience in manufacturing test, hardware validation, or production engineering

 - Experience supporting NPI builds (EVT/DVT/PVT) and scaling production ramp

 - Strong experience with automated test development and scripting (Python preferred)

 - Hands-on experience with test equipment (oscilloscopes, DAQs, power supplies, sensors, etc.)

 - Familiarity with MES systems, work order configuration, and manufacturing workflows

 - Experience with hardware-software integration and embedded systems testing

 - Knowledge of diagnostics, failure analysis, and reliability testing methodologies

 - Experience with data analysis tools (Python, SQL, or similar)

 - Willing to travel domestically and internationally up to 30% 




PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

 - Robotics, autonomous systems, or complex electromechanical products

 - High-volume manufacturing and contract manufacturer environments

 - Vision systems, calibration processes, or system-level testing

 - HIL/SIL testing frameworks

 - Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to manage and resolve complex challenges with little to no established playbooks, using creative and proven strategic thinking to drive solutions.

 - Risk Management: Proven track record of identifying, managing, and mitigating risks in large, complex programs.

 - Adaptability: Comfortable with ambiguity and able to thrive in a fast-moving, constantly evolving environment.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:

 - High test coverage with minimal field escapes

 - Efficient, scalable test systems that support rapid production ramp

 - Fast and accurate failure detection and diagnosis

 - Improved yield and reduced rework through better test and diagnostics

 - Strong alignment between design validation and manufacturing test

 


OPERATING STYLE:

 - Hands-on, detail-oriented, and highly analytical

 - Strong problem solver with a bias toward root cause and data-driven decisions

 - Comfortable working on the factory floor and in the lab

 - Thrives in fast-paced environments with evolving products and processes

If you thrive in dynamic environments, love solving complex challenges, and want to make an impact with cutting-edge technology, we’d love to hear from you!




DAY IN THE LIFE - MANUFACTURING TEST ENGINEER




MORNING: DATA REVIEW & PRODUCTION PULSE CHECK

You start by checking what happened overnight or on the previous shift:

 - First Pass Yield (FPY) by station

 - Top failure modes and pareto trends

 - Test station uptime and bottlenecks

 - Any line stops or escalations

If a failure spikes—say a communication test or sensor calibration—you flag it immediately.

Then you join a quick stand-up with manufacturing, quality, and engineering:

 - What’s breaking on the line right now?

 - Are failures real (product) or false (test issues)?

 - What needs immediate containment vs. deeper investigation?

You leave with a clear priority: keep the line running, but don’t let bad units escape.

 


MID-MORNING: ON-THE-LINE DEBUGGING

You’re on the manufacturing floor (or remote into stations), working side-by-side with technicians.

Typical scenarios:

 - A unit is failing functional test intermittently → you hook into logs, probe signals, and check if it’s hardware, firmware, or test script timing

 - A station is slowing throughput → you optimize sequence timing or parallelize steps

 - A new build variant isn’t flowing correctly → you adjust work order/test routing in MES

You’re constantly asking:

 - Is this a real defect or a test artifact?

 - If it’s real, is it design, component, or process-related?

 - How do we contain it now and detect it earlier next time?

 


MIDDAY: TEST DEVELOPMENT & ITERATION

Back at your desk or lab bench, you shift into build mode.

You might be:

 - Writing Python scripts to automate a new functional test

 - Adding diagnostics to isolate failures faster (better logging, error codes, signal capture)

 - Integrating new hardware into the test system (DAQs, sensors, fixtures)

 - Expanding test coverage to catch a recently discovered issue

This is where you improve the system so the same issue doesn’t keep showing up on the line.

 


EARLY AFTERNOON: BRING-UP & NEW PRODUCT SUPPORT

If you’re in EVT/DVT/PVT or launching a new product, this block is intense.

You’re:

 - Bringing up new test stations for a prototype or pilot build

 - Debugging early design issues exposed during testing

 - Defining pass/fail limits where none existed before

 - Rapidly iterating test sequences as the product evolves

Expect ambiguity—things aren’t fully defined yet, and you’re helping shape both the test strategy and the product quality bar.

 


MID-AFTERNOON: FAILURE ANALYSIS & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL WORK

You sit down with hardware, firmware, and quality engineers to go deeper on key issues:

 - Reviewing failure logs and waveform captures

 - Reproducing issues in the lab

 - Running experiments to isolate root cause

You help answer:

 - Did test catch this early enough?

 - Should this be moved upstream (design validation vs. production test)?

 - What additional coverage is needed to prevent escapes?

This is where you connect test → design → manufacturing → field performance.

 


LATE AFTERNOON: SYSTEMS, SCALING & OPTIMIZATION

Now you zoom out and improve the broader system:

 - Updating MES flows (test steps, routing, traceability)

 - Refining test limits to reduce false failures without letting defects pass

 - Improving test time to increase throughput

 - Building dashboards for test data visibility

You may also work on:

 - Reliability testing setups (burn-in, stress tests)

 - Automation to reduce manual intervention

 - Smarter failure classification (rule-based or AI-assisted)

 


END OF DAY: WRAP-UP & PRIORITIZATION

Before signing off, you:

 - Check if critical line issues are contained

 - Ensure test changes are deployed and documented

 - Align with the next shift or offshore teams

 - Set priorities for the next day (new tests, top failures, line risks)

 


WHAT MAKES THE ROLE UNIQUE

 - You are the gatekeeper between manufacturing and the field

 - You constantly balance coverage vs. speed vs. cost

 - You touch everything: hardware, software, fixtures, data systems, and operations

 - Your work directly impacts yield, reliability, and customer experience




IN ONE SENTENCE

You spend your day building and refining the systems that catch problems early, diagnose them quickly, and keep production moving without compromising quality.




Bedrock Robotics is an Equal Opportunity Employer

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic.

Reasonable Accommodations

We want our hiring process to be accessible to everyone. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please let your recruiter know so we can support you.

jobs.title: Research Intern, Frontier Speculative Decoding (Winter 2027)
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Speculative Decoding team at Together AI builds the draft models and algorithms that let large language models generate faster without changing their outputs. Our speculators run in production on frontier open models such as DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM. Our work sits at the intersection of model training, inference algorithms and serving systems, and we co-design all three to lower the cost and latency of generation.

As a research intern, you will dive into open questions in speculative decoding: new drafter architectures and verification schemes, knowledge distillation and training recipes that align draft and target models, and drafters that adapt as traffic shifts. You will train and fine-tune draft models at scale on dedicated GPU clusters, and test your ideas against realistic serving workloads, including long-context and agentic traffic.

Projects aim to answer important research questions in speculative decoding, enabling faster generation on frontier models, drafters that keep pace with changing workloads, and robust, reproducible evaluation under real traffic.

Past Research

Speculative decoding research by Together researchers, interns and academic collaborators includes:

• Speculative Speculative Decoding (ICLR 2026)

• When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System (ICML 2026)

• Beat the Long Tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training (MLSys 2026)

Responsibilities

• Research and prototype new efficient speculative decoding algorithms and draft model architectures

• Train, fine-tune and distill draft models, and design rigorous experiments to validate hypotheses.

• Implement optimized version for serving engines to show efficacy in real world workloads

• Communicate the plans, progress, and results of projects to the broader team

• Share findings through technical write-ups and blog posts, and help bring successful ideas into production

Requirements

• Currently pursuing a Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

• Strong knowledge of Machine Learning and Deep Learning fundamentals

• Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning large models with distributed training frameworks (e.g., Megatron-LM, FSDP)

• Familiarity with modern model architectures, such as Mixture-of-Experts and hybrid attention

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior research experience in speculative decoding, efficient inference, or efficient machine learning

• Publications at leading conferences in machine learning or systems (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, MLSys)

• Experience with knowledge distillation, post-training, or reinforcement learning

• Familiarity with LLM serving engines (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM)

• Contributions to open-source machine learning projects

About Together AI

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

Internship Program Details

Our internship program runs 12 to 14 weeks, giving you the opportunity to work alongside industry-leading engineers and researchers across multiple teams. This cohort's internship dates span January 4th to April 9th.

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation, housing stipends, and other competitive benefits. The estimated US hourly rate for this role is $58 - $70 an hour. Our hourly rates are determined by location, level and role. Individual compensation will be determined by experience, skills, and job-related knowledge.

Equal Opportunity

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, Data & Platform Infrastructure
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

America is under sustained cyber attack. Our adversaries infiltrate our networks, steal our IP, and degrade the digital infrastructure that modern life runs on. They’ve learned—correctly—that those attacks rarely produce consequences.

Twenty was founded to change that, by making our adversaries think twice before they attack us. Our vision is American and allied primacy in cyberspace—a future where they cannot contest us, deterrence is assured, and the free world remains secure.

Founded in 2024, Twenty Technologies (www.twenty.io http://www.twenty.io) industrializes offensive cyber operations for the U.S. and its allies. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, Twenty has raised $168M from Khosla Ventures, Accel, Caffeinated Capital, Friends & Family Capital, Point72 Ventures, General Catalyst, and In-Q-Tel.

 
 
 
 
 

Mission | On Site | Full Time | U.S. Citizenship Required / No Active Clearance Required

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 


ROLE SUMMARY

Twenty builds AI-enabled technology for mission-critical cyber operations. We're seeking a Staff Product Manager to own data and platform services that power applications and agentic workflows across our product ecosystem. You’ll treat engineers as your customers, turn common needs into reusable capabilities, and align teams on the interfaces, reliability standards, and investments that help them build quickly and safely. You will be building platform services that enable the creation highly complex and autonomous offensive cyber capabilities.

 


WHO YOU ARE

 - You're fluent in some aspect of cyber related workflows, and can earn trust with security researchers, engineers, and mission-facing users.

 - You can translate complex technical problems into clear product choices and useful, intuitive experiences.

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity, high accountability, and hands-on collaboration.

 - You communicate clearly and bring sound product judgment to complex technical and security tradeoffs.
   


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own discovery, roadmap, prioritization, requirements, delivery, and iteration for offensive-security and vulnerability-management capabilities.

 - Learn how practitioners conduct nation state level cyber operations; turn those workflows into clear, actionable product experiences.

 - Partner with engineers and mission-facing users to define useful findings, workflow integrations, data needs, and reliable technical behavior.

 - Make product tradeoffs across speed, usability, accuracy, auditability, and legal frameworks.

 - Set meaningful success metrics, gather user feedback, and use what you learn to improve the product.

 - Communicate product strategy, roadmap choices, and technical tradeoffs clearly to leadership and delivery teams.
   
   


MUST HAVE

 - Substantive experience in at least one of: offensive cyber operations (OCO), vulnerability research, attack surface management, vulnerability management, incident response, adversary hunt, cyber threat intelligence, penetration testing, or red teaming.

 - Strong product judgment and the ability to turn technical needs into user-centered product direction. Formal PM experience is helpful; demonstrable ownership and shipped outcomes matter most.

 - Ability to work credibly with engineers and practitioners on integrations, data quality, workflows, and security tradeoffs.

 - Comfort with ambiguity, high accountability, and hands-on collaboration.
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with offensive-security or vulnerability-focused platforms built for expert users.

 - Exposure to vulnerability intelligence, adversary emulation, security research, or technical mission workflows.

 - Experience with 0-to-1 product development, data-rich security tools, or AI-assisted security workflows.



Benefits 
What's on the table:

 - Health. Medical, dental, and vision plan options. Life / AD&D, disability coverage options.

 - Family. Paid parental leave for eligible full-time employees. 12 weeks for birthing parents, 4 for non-birthing parents, 6 weeks for adoptive, foster, or intended parents through surrogacy.

 - Vacation. Paid holidays and flexible PTO. Take what you need.

 - Retirement. 401(k) with pre-tax and Roth options. HSA/FSA options, dependent care FSA.

Benefits vary by location, role, and eligibility. Full plan details provided during the interview and offer process.





If this role sounds like you, apply and share with us your interest

Due to U.S. government contract and security requirements, this role is limited to U.S. citizens. Some positions may also require eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance. Any active clearance requirement will be listed in the role description.

Twenty is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected status, consistent with applicable law.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, let us know and we will work with you.

jobs.title: Level Sports, CEO
jobs.description:
THE COMPANY

Mechanism exists to build $10 billion in liquid enterprise value by December 2035 — our 10-in-10 mission. We get there by building or acquiring profitable companies and turning them into enterprises.

Since 2019, we've launched and scaled 10 companies while driving $300M+ in revenue by treating company-building as an engineering problem. We combine rigorous validation, advanced analytics, and repeatable systems to dramatically increase the odds of success.

Today, we are taking company-building in-house. We scaled our pre-vetting engine and learned it does not yet yield the companies we need, so we are deliberately doing the things that don't scale — to learn what profitable, defensible scale actually requires.




A MESSAGE FROM OUR CEO

"At Mechanism, our goal is to generate $10B in liquid enterprise value over the next 10 years. We call it '10-in-10.'

Level's next chapter is part of that mission. With PrimePutt, we've built a product golfers love, and we've taken the company to millions in revenue with tens of thousands of customers. The next stage is all about expansion.

I’m looking for a golf-obsessed leader to own Level end-to-end and take it to the next level of profitability. Someone who thinks from first principles, gets into the details, fails and learns faster than anyone around them, and turns customer insight into profitable growth.

If you want real ownership, a high-trust partnership, and the chance to build something meaningful in a sport you love, let's talk."

Breanden Beneschott, Mechanism Co-founder & CEO




THE OPPORTUNITY

Golfers will do almost anything to shave strokes. PrimePutt helps them put in the work at home, on the same surface PGA professionals use. It’s a product golfers love and recommend, with a loyal customer base and a growing owned audience.

Over the past year and a half, we’ve strengthened the business behind it. The financials are clean, manufacturing is dialed in, and operations are built to scale. The foundation is in place. Now it’s time to see how far we can take it.

Your mission is to turn Level into a highly profitable, growing golf company. You’ll own the whole business, including the P&L, product, growth, and the team. You’ll sit on the board and earn meaningful equity as you hit each milestone. You’ll set the direction for what Level makes, who it reaches, and where it invests.

You won’t be starting from zero, and you won’t be doing it alone. You’ll inherit a proven product, an engaged audience, a PGA coach, and a putting game already running competitions with one of the largest golf communities online. You’ll build alongside Mechanism’s experts across Growth, Product, Engineering, Design, Operations, People, Finance, and Legal. Bring 20 ideas. Ship the best ones in days, not quarters. Kill what doesn’t work, and pour fuel on what does.

If you’re the golfer who can’t walk through a pro shop without spotting the product nobody’s made yet, this is your shot. Build the golf company you’d want to buy from, and own a real piece of what you build.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

You Have Three Core Missions

 1. Expand the Growth Engine: Own strategy and hands-on execution across paid media, creative, email, and partnerships. Build an owned audience through useful golf content, training programs, and offers, then convert that audience into customers. Ship new creative weekly, improve landing pages and nurture sequences, and scale the approaches that drive profitable sales.
    

 2. Drive Profitable Growth: Own Level’s financial performance. Plan cash and inventory around seasonal demand, improve margins across products and fulfillment, and make disciplined decisions about growth investment. Build a clear case for where additional capital can accelerate profitable growth, and track whether those investments deliver.
    

 3. Expand the Product Line and Build the Team: Identify and launch complementary golf products that give customers more ways to buy from Level. Validate demand, margins, and inventory needs before scaling, and use your golf network to develop credible partnerships. Hire contractors and team members where they improve execution and support profitable growth.




SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERTISE

Core Requirements

The right candidate will recognize themselves in the message above. This is a role for a golf-obsessed operator who can demonstrate the following:

 - Golf Obsession: You understand golf culture, how golfers practice, and what motivates them to buy. You can recognize credible instruction, create offers that resonate, and build relationships with coaches, creators, and golf communities.

 - Hands-On Growth Expertise: You've personally run paid media, especially Meta, built creative at volume, and scaled acquisition channels. You can set the strategy and do the work yourself.

 - DTC Physical Product Experience: You've grown a direct-to-consumer brand selling a physical product, ideally at a premium price point.

 - Financial Judgment: You understand how acquisition costs, margins, inventory, and operating expenses turn into cash, and you've made sound calls with a tight cash position.

 - Founder Mentality: You've built a business or owned meaningful outcomes at an early-stage company. You move fast, solve problems with limited resources, and own results.

 - AI-Native by Default: You use AI daily to accelerate analysis, creative, and execution, and you can point to workflows you've built and the results they produced.

 - Team Leadership: You've hired and led strong performers and know when hiring creates more value than doing the work yourself.


WHAT TO EXPECT

This role moves between strategy and execution every day. You'll make consequential decisions and personally do the work to deliver them.

First 30 days: Take the handoff and set the plan

 - Complete Mechanism's CEO onboarding and growth training.

 - Complete the handoff with the current CEO, and build relationships with the team, contractors, and Mechanism's Practice Areas.

 - Evaluate existing campaigns, training offers, audience initiatives, and product tests. Identify what to scale, improve, or stop.

 - Read the Black Friday and holiday results: what sold, at what price, through which channels, and at what cost.

 - Partner with our product and operations team to design a weekly creative program shipping new ads, with fast and clear results.

 - Review unit economics, cash, inventory, and supplier obligations.

By 60 days: Own the business and get the engine running

 - Take full responsibility for operations and financial performance.

 - Run a weekly creative and conversion testing program, with clear results informing each next round.

 - Run a weekly operating cadence covering revenue, acquisition cost, margins, cash, inventory, and customer experience.

 - Fix any operational bottlenecks and decide where contractors, automation, or hiring will help.

By 90 days: Show progress and plan the season

 - Show measurable progress toward three consecutive profitable months.

 - Scale what's working, and stop or revise what isn't.

 - Demonstrate which audience-building efforts are converting into product sales and contributing to profitability.

 - Present the spring season plan, including Father's Day, the next SKU or price test, investment priorities, and team needs.




LOGISTICS

Fully remote, full-time, with most of the workday overlapping US Eastern Time. Expected start is around January 2027, with a full handoff from the current CEO.

Compensation includes a base salary and a significant equity stake. For candidates located in New York, Washington, Colorado, California, and Illinois, the base salary range is $180,000 to $220,000 USD. Compensation may vary depending on qualifications, skills, experience, and location.

jobs.title: Associate Advisor
jobs.description:
About Allworth Financial

Allworth Financial (www.allworthfinancial.com) is an independent investment advisory firm providing full-context wealth planning solutions. The firm brings together investment, tax, retirement, estate, and other financial considerations to help clients evaluate decisions in the context of their whole financial lives.

Founded in Sacramento, California, in 1993, Allworth Financial is a high-growth, private equity-backed, multibranch registered investment adviser. Allworth is primarily a fee-based fiduciary advisory firm that emphasizes client well-being and education. The firm continues to expand through acquisitions and organic growth.

Allworth is a great place to work and build a career. The firm ranks among the top 15 on Barron’s Top 100 RIA Firms list, has a historical client retention rate of 97%, and is a National Business Research Institute (NBRI) Circle of Excellence Award winner. Learn more at AllworthFinancial.com.

SUMMARY:

The Associate Advisor plays a key role on our centralized planning team, partnering closely with our Financial Advisors to deliver an exceptional service and advice experience to Allworth’s on-plan asset management clients. This role is designed for individuals who are committed to becoming future lead advisors and who want to build deep technical planning expertise, strengthen client-facing skills, and gain hands-on exposure to the full Allworth operating model.

As an Associate Advisor, you will support the end-to-end planning process — from preparing and refining financial plans, to conducting research and case analysis, to participating in client meetings and follow-up. You will collaborate across departments, develop a strong understanding of our integrated service model, and play an important role in ensuring clients feel informed, cared for, and confident in their financial future.

This is an in-office position. The role includes structured professional development and support in pursuing the CFP® designation as part of your long-term career path within Allworth.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Can you navigate the fast-paced dynamics of a multi-office law firm with ease?

**RECRUITERS DO NOT CONTACT**

Omrani & Taub PC is a prominent personal injury law firm with a significant presence in New York City, including offices in Manhattan, Queens, and White Plains. Founded on the values of dedication and empathy, our firm is committed to advocating for individuals who have suffered due to the negligence of others. Our team of experienced attorneys has successfully handled thousands of personal injury cases, making a profound impact on our clients' lives.

Our mission is to provide unparalleled legal representation, ensuring that every case receives the attention and expertise it deserves. We pride ourselves on our client-centric approach, offering personalized service and strategic legal solutions. Our practice areas include car accidents, construction accidents, medical malpractice, and more, reflecting our comprehensive expertise in personal injury law. We are deeply rooted in the community, providing not only legal advocacy but also support and guidance to help clients navigate challenging circumstances.

Why This Role Exists

The firm has outgrown informal operations handling. Senior leadership is spending too much time on day-to-day operational fires (vendor sourcing, facilities issues, repairs, security needs, and multi-office logistics). This role exists to own operational execution, solve problems independently, and keep the offices running smoothly – so leadership can stay focused on growth.

This is a hands-on execution role – not a strategy or HR leadership role – and it reports directly to senior leadership; there are no direct reports initially, with the opportunity to grow into people management over time.

What you’ll do:

• Daily Operations Troubleshooting: Be the go-to problem solver for day-to-day operational issues across offices – solve issues without escalating everything to leadership.

• Vendor Coordination: Source vendors, request and compare quotes, schedule work, coordinate access, and ensure work is completed correctly and on time.

• Facilities & Security: Coordinate repairs, maintenance, and security needs (including urgent issues) across multiple offices.

• Multi-Office Presence: Be physically present when issues arise; travel to Queens and White Plains as needed.

• Administrative Support (HR-adjacent): Provide administrative support to keep HR processes moving (scheduling, tracking deadlines, ensuring steps are completed on time), without owning HR policy.

Work Schedule & Location: This is a fully in-office role based in Manhattan (NYC). Hours are 9:00 AM – 5:45 PM, with a 45-minute lunch and one additional 15-minute break. You must be willing to travel to our Queens and White Plains offices as issues arise.

What we’re looking for:

• Hands-on operations background: Office Coordinator / Operations Coordinator / Office Manager-type experience, ideally in a multi-site environment

• Vendor + facilities comfort: You can source vendors, compare quotes, coordinate access, and follow through to completion

• Calm under pressure: You stay level-headed, make practical decisions, and move quickly when unexpected issues arise

• Independent executor: You don’t need constant direction; you escalate only when necessary

• Strong follow-through: You track details, close loops, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks

• Communication strength: Comfortable communicating with vendors and internal stakeholders at all levels

• Travel flexibility: Willing to travel to Queens and White Plains as needed

Why you should work here:

• Career Growth: Opportunity to grow into a leadership role as the operations function expands.

• Impactful Work: Directly influence the efficiency of multi-office operations, making a tangible difference in a growing law firm.

• Collaborative Environment: Work closely with senior leadership, gaining insight and learning from experienced professionals.

• Autonomy and Challenge: Enjoy meaningful autonomy in problem-solving, taking ownership of operational tasks and initiatives.

Compensation & Benefits

• Compensation is competitive and aligned with the Manhattan market. Benefits and final package details will be shared during the interview process.

If you are a proactive and resourceful professional eager to contribute to a dynamic and impactful legal team, we invite you to apply for the Operations Coordinator role at Omrani & Taub PC. Join us in our mission to provide exceptional legal advocacy while supporting the operational efficiency that drives our firm's success.

jobs.title: Quality Inspector
jobs.description:
Summary

Performs inspections and audits on aircraft interior components, materials, and processes to ensure compliance with engineering specifications, FAA regulations, and company quality standards. Utilizes precision measuring instruments and quality assurance methodologies to identify defects and ensure traceability.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Inspects incoming products to verify proper documentation and conformance to purchase orders and engineering specifications.

• Inspects aircraft assemblies to ensure compliance with design specifications and regulatory standards.

• Performs receiving inspections and generates formal inspection reports.

• Completes FAA and customer-required certification documents.

• Creates and maintains First Article Inspection (FAI) reports in accordance with AS9102 or equivalent.

• Verify inclusion of all material and process certificates for traceability.

• Coordinates with stakeholders as required to accurately describe nonconforming conditions for rejected parts.

• Works closely with FAA DAR. Assists as required with part marking and packaging.

• Keeps management informed of inspection findings, quality issues, and corrective action progress.

• Maintains a neat, organized work area and helps with the general daily housekeeping of the department.

• Meets target hours and completes schedules as set by Supervisor.

• Maintains regular attendance including being at work, being on time to work and working full shifts.

• Other duties as assigned.

Competencies

To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies:

Greenpoint Core Competencies

• Adaptability – Adapts to changes in the work environment, manages competing demands, and accepts constructive criticism/feedback and changes approach or method to best fit the situation.

• Communications – Expresses ideas and thoughts effectively in verbal and written form, exhibits good listening and comprehension, and keeps others informed and uses appropriate communication methods.

• Dependability – Responds to requests for service and assistance, follows instruction and responds to management direction, takes responsibility for own actions and doing the best job possible, keeps commitments, and maintains reliable attendance.

• Initiative – Sets and achieves challenging goals, demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles, measures self against standard of excellence, recognizes and acts on opportunities, and takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.

• Teamwork – Balances team and individual responsibilities, exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views, gives and welcomes feedback, contributes to building a positive team spirit, and puts success of team above own interests.

• Work Quality – Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness, displays commitment to excellence, looks for ways to improve and promote quality, applies feedback to improve performance, and monitors own work to ensure quality.

• Safety –Observes safety and security procedures, determines appropriate action beyond guidelines, uses equipment and materials properly, and reports potentially unsafe conditions.

Summary of Education, Experience & Certification

High school diploma or equivalent, minimum of 3 years of experience in aircraft interior inspection or related aerospace quality role, or equivalent combination of education and experience.

This safety-sensitive position is covered by the Department of Transportation's (DOT) Drug and Alcohol Testing Program. Any applicant selected for this position will be subject to pre-employment drug testing. Persons occupying a "safety-sensitive” position will be subject to random drug and/or alcohol testing. Post-accident, reasonable cause, and return-to-duty tests may also be required based on specific circumstances.

Employees working on programs subject to International Traffic in Arms Regulations must qualify as a US Person which is defined as a US Citizen, a Permanent Resident who does not work for a foreign company/foreign government/foreign governmental agency or organization, or a political asylee for legal compliance purposes.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Working knowledge of various measuring devices such as calipers, micrometers, depth gauges, etc.

• Familiarity with Quality and inspection concepts and processes.

• Ability to read blueprints, pack slips, invoices, and other customer supplied data.

• Ability to read measuring instruments.

• Familiarity with engineering programs.

• Ability to determine sample size for lots.

• Familiarity with AS9100 preferred.

• Ability to communicate effectively at all levels within the department and with other groups.

• Ability to work independently and cross-functionally as part of an established and growing team.

• Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

• Strong time management and organizational skills.

• Ability to coordinate and handle multiple priorities within deadlines and take initiative to produce results with minimal supervision.

• Ability to sit for extended periods of time, use hands to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and have close/color vision ability to adjust focus.

• Ability to travel as required.

• Ability to work overtime as required.

About Greenpoint Technologies
Greenpoint delivers nose-to-tail VIP Jet aircraft interiors for private clients and Heads-of-State.  We are proud to be known in the aerospace industry for our design and engineering innovation, award-winning company culture, and on-time delivery of our beautiful products. We use leading-edge tools and employee-built processes to deliver extraordinary, one-of-a-kind custom aircraft interiors.  It’s complex work, but we work smart.  In return for hard work, collaboration, and creativity, our people experience a culture custom built for high achievers:

• Big jobs and stretch assignments.

• High accountability environment, with transparent decisions aligned to values, open communication, and engaged leadership.

• Ability to make a big, visible impact on the end product.

We welcome diverse contributions and provide equal employment opportunities to all individuals without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Mental Health Specialist II - Acute Behavioral Services * Up to $3000 Bonus *
jobs.description:
About the Program:

Our Acute Behavioral Services (ABS) group homes support individuals with complex mental health and behavioral needs. Many of the people we serve have experienced frequent crises, hospital stays, or legal involvement. They may have a history of failed placements and need a highly structured environment to succeed.

Our homes are specially designed for safety, and our approach is consistent, person-centered, and focused on helping individuals reach their goals while maintaining safety for everyone. Due to the challenging nature of this work, staff receive training in behavioral support and crisis response, including the use of manual restraints when necessary.

What You’ll Do:

• Provide direct support to individuals with intensive behavioral and mental‑health needs, using person‑centered approaches focused on safety, skill‑building, and positive engagement.
• Support individuals in accordance with behavior support plans, treatment plans, crisis-prevention strategies, de-escalation techniques, and manual restraint procedures as trained.
• Maintain a clean, safe, structured living environment; assist with daily living skills, household tasks, activities, transportation, and community engagement.
• Accurately document services, behavioral observations, health concerns, and program activities using electronic systems (T‑logs, Therap, health tracking).
• Monitor behavioral changes, identify escalation indicators, and communicate proactively with supervisors and team members during crisis or safety situations.

jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is trusted by the leading law firms and in-house teams to help them harness AI.

Our Legal Innovation Partners provide strategic counsel to law firm and legal department leaders as they define and execute AI transformation within their organizations. They serve as a bridge between Harvey and the legal innovation community, representing Harvey and bringing the community’s needs and perspectives into Harvey’s strategy and product development.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Advise customers on AI transformation. You’ll draw on your experience driving change in legal organizations to help customers design and execute their AI strategies. You’ll tailor this advice to each customer’s priorities and identify practical next steps.

 - Help customers evaluate the value of AI initiatives, define practical measures of success, and use what they learn to inform adoption and investment decisions.

 - Help firms and their clients develop new ways to collaborate on legal work.

 - Help law firms adapt pricing, staffing, and client service, and help legal departments improve how legal services are delivered as AI changes legal work.

 - Advance Legal AI thought leadership, including representing Harvey in industry forums, publishing analyses on emerging issues in legal innovation, and developing practical guides and frameworks.

 - Build relationships and facilitate knowledge exchange across the legal innovation community. Design and lead workshops and educational sessions with law firms, corporate legal teams, and professional organizations.




WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 7+ years of relevant experience across legal practice, legal innovation, or transformation at a top tier law firm, corporate legal team, or legal tech organization. Qualified lawyers are strongly preferred.

 - Strong point of view on AI transformation in legal organizations, grounded in practical experience using generative AI and an ability to translate its capabilities and limitations into strategic guidance.

 - Credibility with senior legal, innovation, and business leaders, with the ability to build alignment and translate between technical and legal/business audiences.

 - A track record of putting legal innovation strategy into practice, including aligning stakeholders, overcoming adoption barriers, and demonstrating improved outcomes. Experience translating that work into practical approaches that inform product direction or service design.

 - Exceptional communication and facilitation skills, including executive advising, workshop facilitation, teaching, industry speaking, and clear written guidance.




COMPENSATION

$254,600 - $381,800 USD OTE (75/25 split)
